-- Cfx.re Lua runtime (client and server): CfxLua extensions of the Lua 5.4
-- standard library (citizenfx/lua, GRIT_POWER_* and LUA_C99_MATHLIB build
-- options). The standard tables (`table`, `string`, `utf8`, `math`) are
-- declared by the Lua 5.4 standard library stubs; this file only adds members.
--
-- Differences that cannot be expressed here: `dofile` and `loadfile` are nil,
-- `require` only returns already loaded libraries (plus 'glm' and 'lmprof'),
-- `print` prefixes its output with the resource name, and `io` / `os` only
-- exist on the server (see server/server_os_io.lua).

---
--- Computes the Jenkins one-at-a-time hash of `text`, as used by the game for
--- model names and other identifiers. The text is lowercased first unless
--- `keepCase` is `true`. The result is a signed 32-bit integer.
---
--- The backtick literal `` `adder` `` computes the same hash at compile time.
---
--- ```lua
--- print(joaat('adder') == `adder`)
--- ```
---@overload fun(text:string):integer
---@param text string @The text to hash.
---@param keepCase boolean @`true` to hash the text without lowercasing it.
---@return integer @The signed 32-bit hash.
function joaat(text, keepCase) end

---
--- Generic iteration: returns the iterator of `t` given by its `__iter`
--- metamethod, falling back to `__pairs` and then to `next` (like `pairs`).
---
--- ```lua
--- for key, value in each(t) do
---     print(key, value)
--- end
--- ```
---@generic K, V
---@param t table<K, V>|V[] @The value to iterate.
---@return fun(tbl: table<K, V>):K, V @The iterator function.
function each(t) end

---
--- Returns a to-be-closed object that calls `callback` when it goes out of
--- scope (normally or because of an error).
---
--- ```lua
--- local _ <close> = defer(function()
---     print('leaving the block')
--- end)
--- ```
---@param callback fun(closed:table, err:any) @Called when the object is closed, with the error object if the scope is left by an error.
---@return table @The to-be-closed object.
function defer(callback) end

---
--- Returns its arguments, with every table, function, userdata and thread
--- replaced by `nil` (only numbers, strings, booleans and `nil` are kept).
---@vararg any
---@return any @The scrubbed arguments.
function scrub(...) end

---
--- Returns the layout of table `t`: `'empty'`, `'array'`, `'hash'` or
--- `'mixed'`. Returns `nil` for values that are not tables.
---@param t any @The value to inspect.
---@return string|nil @The table type.
function table.type(t) end

---
--- Creates a table with preallocated space for `narray` array elements and
--- `nhash` hash elements (`lua_createtable`).
---@param narray integer @Number of array slots to preallocate.
---@param nhash integer @Number of hash slots to preallocate.
---@return table @The new table.
function table.create(narray, nhash) end

---
--- Alias of `table.create`: creates a table with preallocated space.
---@param narray integer @Number of array slots to preallocate.
---@param nhash integer @Number of hash slots to preallocate.
---@return table @The new table.
function table.new(narray, nhash) end

---
--- Removes every entry of `t`, keeping its allocated space, and returns it.
---@generic T
---@param t T @The table to clear.
---@return T @The same table.
function table.wipe(t) end

---
--- Alias of `table.wipe`: removes every entry of `t` and returns it.
---@generic T
---@param t T @The table to clear.
---@return T @The same table.
function table.clear(t) end

---
--- Returns a shallow copy of `t` (without its metatable). When `destination`
--- is given, its previous content is replaced by the copy and it is returned
--- (it keeps its own metatable).
---@overload fun(t:table):table
---@generic T
---@param t T @The table to copy.
---@param destination table @Optional table receiving the copy.
---@return T @The copy.
function table.clone(t, destination) end

---
--- Removes the characters of `chars` (by default the whitespace characters
--- `"\t\n\v\f\r "`) from both ends of `s`.
---
--- ```lua
--- print(string.strtrim('  hello  ')) -- 'hello'
--- ```
---@overload fun(s:string):string
---@param s string @The string to trim.
---@param chars string @The set of characters to remove.
---@return string @The trimmed string.
function string.strtrim(s, chars) end

---
--- Splits `s` at every character contained in `delimiters` and returns the
--- pieces as multiple values. With `limit`, at most `limit` pieces are
--- returned (the last one holds the rest of the string).
---
--- ```lua
--- local a, b, c = string.strsplit(',', 'one,two,three')
--- ```
---@overload fun(delimiters:string, s:string):string
---@param delimiters string @The set of delimiter characters.
---@param s string @The string to split.
---@param limit integer @Maximum number of pieces (0 for no limit).
---@return string @The pieces, as multiple return values.
function string.strsplit(delimiters, s, limit) end

---
--- Joins the remaining arguments with `delimiter` between them.
---
--- ```lua
--- print(string.strjoin(', ', 'a', 'b', 'c')) -- 'a, b, c'
--- ```
---@param delimiter string @The separator.
---@vararg string|number
---@return string @The joined string.
function string.strjoin(delimiter, ...) end

---
--- Concatenates all the arguments (like the `..` operator).
---@vararg string|number
---@return string @The concatenated string.
function string.strconcat(...) end

---
--- Returns all its arguments converted with `tostring`.
---@vararg any
---@return string @The converted arguments, as multiple return values.
function string.tostringall(...) end

---
--- Creates a blob: a mutable, non-interned byte string. A number creates a
--- zero-filled blob of that size; a string is copied into a new blob.
---@param value integer|string @The blob size, or the string to copy.
---@return string @The blob.
function string.blob(value) end

---
--- Returns `true` if `value` is a blob created by `string.blob`.
---@param value any @The value to test.
---@return boolean @Whether the value is a blob.
function string.isblob(value) end

---
--- Writes values into `blob` like `string.pack`, starting at `position`
--- (default 1). Returns the blob, or a new larger blob if the data does not
--- fit.
---@overload fun(blob:string, format:string, ...:any):string
---@param blob string @The blob to write into.
---@param position integer @The position to start writing at.
---@param format string @A `string.pack` format.
---@vararg any
---@return string @The written blob.
function string.blob_pack(blob, position, format, ...) end

---
--- Reads values from `blob` like `string.unpack`, starting at `position`
--- (default 1). Returns the values followed by the position after them.
---@overload fun(blob:string, format:string):any
---@param blob string @The blob to read from.
---@param position integer @The position to start reading at.
---@param format string @A `string.unpack` format.
---@return any @The read values, then the next position.
function string.blob_unpack(blob, position, format) end

---
--- Alias of `utf8.len`: returns the number of UTF-8 characters in `s`.
---@overload fun(s:string):integer
---@param s string @The string.
---@param i integer @Start position (default 1).
---@param j integer @End position (default -1).
---@return integer @The number of characters, or `nil` plus the position of the first invalid byte.
function utf8.strlenutf8(s, i, j) end

---
--- Compares two UTF-8 strings by code point (case-sensitive, despite the
--- name). Returns `-1`, `0` or `1`.
---@param a string @First string.
---@param b string @Second string.
---@return integer @The comparison result.
function utf8.strcmputf8i(a, b) end

---
--- Returns the number of UTF-16 code units needed to encode the UTF-8 string
--- `s` (characters outside the BMP count twice), or `-1` if `s` is not valid
--- UTF-8.
---@overload fun(s:string):integer
---@param s string @The string.
---@param i integer @Start position (default 1).
---@param j integer @End position (default -1).
---@return integer @The UTF-16 length.
function utf8.len16(s, i, j) end

---
--- Returns the arc tangent of `y / x` (in radians), using the signs of both
--- arguments to find the quadrant (Lua 5.3 compatibility).
---@param y number @The y coordinate.
---@param x number @The x coordinate.
---@return number @The angle in radians.
function math.atan2(y, x) end

---
--- Returns the hyperbolic cosine of `x` (Lua 5.3 compatibility).
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.cosh(x) end

---
--- Returns the hyperbolic sine of `x` (Lua 5.3 compatibility).
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.sinh(x) end

---
--- Returns the hyperbolic tangent of `x` (Lua 5.3 compatibility).
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.tanh(x) end

---
--- Returns `x` raised to the power `y` (Lua 5.3 compatibility; same as
--- `x ^ y`).
---@param x number @The base.
---@param y number @The exponent.
---@return number @The result.
function math.pow(x, y) end

---
--- Splits `x` into a normalized fraction and an exponent such that
--- `x = m * 2 ^ e` (Lua 5.3 compatibility).
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number, integer @The fraction `m` and the exponent `e`.
function math.frexp(x) end

---
--- Returns `m * 2 ^ e` (Lua 5.3 compatibility).
---@param m number @The fraction.
---@param e integer @The exponent.
---@return number @The result.
function math.ldexp(m, e) end

---
--- Returns the base-10 logarithm of `x` (Lua 5.3 compatibility).
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.log10(x) end

---
--- Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.asinh(x) end

---
--- Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.acosh(x) end

---
--- Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.atanh(x) end

---
--- Returns the cube root of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.cbrt(x) end

---
--- Returns a value with the magnitude of `x` and the sign of `y`.
---@param x number @The magnitude.
---@param y number @The sign source.
---@return number @The result.
function math.copysign(x, y) end

---
--- Returns the error function of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.erf(x) end

---
--- Returns the complementary error function of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.erfc(x) end

---
--- Returns `2 ^ x`.
---@param x number @The exponent.
---@return number @The result.
function math.exp2(x) end

---
--- Returns `e ^ x - 1`, accurate for small `x`.
---@param x number @The exponent.
---@return number @The result.
function math.expm1(x) end

---
--- Returns the positive difference between `x` and `y` (`x - y` if positive,
--- `0` otherwise).
---@param x number @First value.
---@param y number @Second value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.fdim(x, y) end

---
--- Returns the gamma function of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.gamma(x) end

---
--- Returns `sqrt(x * x + y * y)` without intermediate overflow.
---@param x number @First value.
---@param y number @Second value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.hypot(x, y) end

---
--- Returns `true` if `x` is neither infinite nor NaN.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return boolean @Whether `x` is finite.
function math.isfinite(x) end

---
--- Returns `true` if `x` is positive or negative infinity.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return boolean @Whether `x` is infinite.
function math.isinf(x) end

---
--- Returns `true` if `x` is NaN.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return boolean @Whether `x` is NaN.
function math.isnan(x) end

---
--- Returns `true` if `x` is a normal floating-point number (not zero,
--- subnormal, infinite or NaN).
---@param x number @The value.
---@return boolean @Whether `x` is normal.
function math.isnormal(x) end

---
--- Returns the natural logarithm of the absolute value of the gamma function
--- of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.lgamma(x) end

---
--- Returns `log(1 + x)`, accurate for small `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.log1p(x) end

---
--- Returns the binary exponent of `x`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.logb(x) end

---
--- Rounds `x` to an integral value using the current rounding mode.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The result.
function math.nearbyint(x) end

---
--- Returns the next representable floating-point value after `x` in the
--- direction of `y`.
---@param x number @The start value.
---@param y number @The direction.
---@return number @The result.
function math.nextafter(x, y) end

---
--- Returns the IEEE remainder of `x / y`.
---@param x number @The dividend.
---@param y number @The divisor.
---@return number @The result.
function math.remainder(x, y) end

---
--- Rounds `x` to the nearest integral value, halfway cases away from zero.
--- The result is a float.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The rounded value.
function math.round(x) end

---
--- Returns `x * 2 ^ n`.
---@param x number @The value.
---@param n integer @The exponent.
---@return number @The result.
function math.scalbn(x, n) end

---
--- Truncates `x` towards zero. The result is a float.
---@param x number @The value.
---@return number @The truncated value.
function math.trunc(x) end

---
--- Clamps `x` between `min` and `max`. The three arguments must have the same
--- type: all integers, all floats, or vectors of the same size. Mixing
--- integers and floats, or a vector and numbers, raises an error. Numbers are
--- returned as floats.
---
--- ```lua
--- local alpha = math.clamp(value, 0.0, 1.0)
--- ```
---@param x number|vector2|vector3|vector4 @The value to clamp.
---@param min number|vector2|vector3|vector4 @The lower bound.
---@param max number|vector2|vector3|vector4 @The upper bound.
---@return number|vector2|vector3|vector4 @The clamped value.
function math.clamp(x, min, max) end

---
--- The machine epsilon of Lua floats (`DBL_EPSILON`).
---@type number
math.eps = nil

---
--- The machine epsilon of single-precision floats (`FLT_EPSILON`), the
--- precision of vector components.
---@type number

-- ta-movie-player サーバースクリプト
-- 共有・上映（同期再生）・参加の申請・空間スクリーンの検証と中継
-- クライアントから届く値は全て信用せず、送信者・URL・相手・数値・頻度をサーバ側で検証する

local lastShareAt = {}   -- [送信者のサーバーID] = 最後に共有した時刻（GetGameTimer）
local pendingOffers = {} -- [受信者のサーバーID] = { from = 送信者, sessionId = 上映ID, expires = 有効期限 }

-- 上映（同じ動画をいっしょに観ている集まり）。ホストの再生位置に参加者を合わせる
local sessions = {}      -- [上映ID] = { id, host, hostName, media, members = { [サーバーID] = true }, count, state }
local playerSession = {} -- [サーバーID] = 上映ID
local nextSessionId = 0

-- 参加の申請
local joinRequests = {}       -- [申請者のサーバーID] = { sessionId, host, expires }
local lastJoinRequestAt = {}  -- [申請者のサーバーID] = 時刻
local lastListAt = {}         -- [サーバーID] = 上映一覧を最後に返した時刻
local lastHostStateAt = {}    -- [ホストのサーバーID] = 再生位置の報告を最後に受けた時刻

-- 空間スクリーン（再起動で消える）
local screens = {}            -- [スクリーンID] = { id, owner, ownerSrc, ownerName, x, y, z, heading, width, media, state }
local nextScreenId = 0
local lastScreenActionAt = {} -- [サーバーID] = 時刻

-- 受信者が返せる応答の種類
local RESPONSE_STATUSES = {
    accepted = true,
    declined = true,
    timeout = true,
    invalid = true,
}

local MAX_POSITION = 60 * 60 * 24 -- 再生位置として受け付ける上限（秒）

-- ================== 共通 ==================

local function now()
    return GetGameTimer()
end

-- 通知を送る（kind: 'error' | 'info' | 'success'）
local function notify(target, kind, message)
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:notify', target, kind, message)
end

local function playerName(src)
    return MoviePlayer.SanitizeName(GetPlayerName(tostring(src)))
end

local function isOnline(src)
    return GetPlayerName(tostring(src)) ~= nil
end

-- 数値として正しい（NaN・無限大でない）値だけを返す
local function finiteNumber(value)
    value = tonumber(value)
    if not value or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
        return nil
    end
    return value
end

local function clamp(value, low, high)
    return math.max(low, math.min(high, value))
end

-- プレイヤーの座標。OneSync が無効などで取れなければ nil
local function getPlayerCoords(src)
    -- GetPlayerPed はプレイヤーの source を「文字列」で受け取る（公式ドキュメントの仕様）
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(tostring(src))
    if not ped or ped == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        return nil
    end
    return GetEntityCoords(ped)
end

-- 2人のプレイヤーが距離内にいるかを返す
-- OneSync が無効などでサーバから座標を取れない場合は検証できないので通す
local function isWithinRange(sourceA, sourceB)
    if not Config.ServerDistanceCheck then
        return true
    end

    local a, b = getPlayerCoords(sourceA), getPlayerCoords(sourceB)
    if not a or not b then
        return true
    end
    return #(a - b) <= (Config.NearbyDistance + Config.ServerDistanceMargin)
end

-- プレイヤーが座標の近くにいるかを返す（座標を取れない環境では通す）
local function isNearPoint(src, point, distance)
    if not Config.ServerDistanceCheck then
        return true
    end

    local coords = getPlayerCoords(src)
    if not coords then
        return true
    end
    return #(coords - point) <= distance + Config.ServerDistanceMargin
end

-- 再生状態 { playing, position, at } の「いま」の再生位置
local function currentPosition(state)
    if state.playing then
        return state.position + (now() - state.at) / 1000
    end
    return state.position
end

-- クライアントへ送る再生状態（送る時点の位置に直して送る）
local function syncPayload(state)
    return { playing = state.playing, position = currentPosition(state) }
end

-- 共有・上映・スクリーンの再生に使うメディア情報（クライアントでも検証し直す）
local function publicMedia(media)
    return { url = media.url, platform = media.platform, kind = media.kind, id = media.id }
end

-- ================== 上映（同期再生） ==================

local function sessionInfo(session, member)
    return {
        sessionId = session.id,
        isHost = member == session.host,
        hostId = session.host,
        hostName = session.hostName,
        memberCount = session.count,
        platform = session.media.platform,
    }
end

-- 参加者全員に、人数などの情報を送り直す
local function broadcastSessionInfo(session)
    for member in pairs(session.members) do
        TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:sessionInfo', member, sessionInfo(session, member))
    end
end

-- ホスト以外の参加者に再生状態を送る
local function broadcastSessionSync(session)
    local payload = syncPayload(session.state)
    payload.sessionId = session.id
    for member in pairs(session.members) do
        if member ~= session.host then
            TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:sessionSync', member, payload)
        end
    end
end

-- 申請中の参加を取り消す（上映が終わった・申請者が退出したなど）
local function cancelJoinRequest(requester, reason)
    local request = joinRequests[requester]
    if not request then
        return
    end
    joinRequests[requester] = nil

    if isOnline(request.host) then
        TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:joinRequestEnd', request.host, requester)
    end
    if reason and isOnline(requester) then
        notify(requester, 'info', reason)
    end
end

local function endSession(session, reason)
    sessions[session.id] = nil
    for member in pairs(session.members) do
        if playerSession[member] == session.id then
            playerSession[member] = nil
        end
        if member ~= session.host and isOnline(member) then
            TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:sessionEnded', member, session.id, reason)
        end
    end
    for requester, request in pairs(joinRequests) do
        if request.sessionId == session.id then
            cancelJoinRequest(requester, 'ホストが上映を終えたため、参加の申請を取り消しました')
        end
    end
    MoviePlayer.Log(('session %d ended'):format(session.id))
end

-- 今の上映から抜ける。ホストが抜けたら上映を終える
local function leaveSession(src)
    local id = playerSession[src]
    if not id then
        return
    end
    playerSession[src] = nil

    local session = sessions[id]
    if not session then
        return
    end

    if session.host == src then
        endSession(session, 'host_left')
        return
    end

    if session.members[src] then
        session.members[src] = nil
        session.count = session.count - 1
        broadcastSessionInfo(session)
    end
end

local function addMember(session, src)
    if session.members[src] then
        return true
    end
    if session.count >= Config.MaxSessionMembers then
        return false
    end

    leaveSession(src)
    session.members[src] = true
    session.count = session.count + 1
    playerSession[src] = session.id
    broadcastSessionInfo(session)

    local payload = syncPayload(session.state)
    payload.sessionId = session.id
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:sessionSync', src, payload)
    return true
end

-- ホストとして新しい上映を始める（前の上映からは抜ける）
local function startSession(src, media)
    leaveSession(src)

    nextSessionId = nextSessionId + 1
    local session = {
        id = nextSessionId,
        host = src,
        hostName = playerName(src),
        media = media,
        members = { [src] = true },
        count = 1,
        state = { playing = true, position = 0, at = now() },
    }
    sessions[session.id] = session
    playerSession[src] = session.id
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:sessionInfo', src, sessionInfo(session, src))
    MoviePlayer.Log(('session %d started by %d (%s)'):format(session.id, src, media.platform))
    return session
end

-- ひとりで再生を始めたとき（共有なし）も上映として扱い、近くの人が参加を申請できるようにする
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:startSession', function(url)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then
        return
    end

    local media = MoviePlayer.ParseMedia(url)
    if not media then
        return
    end
    startSession(src, media)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:leaveSession', function()
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if src then
        leaveSession(src)
    end
end)

-- ホストの再生位置の報告（定期と、一時停止・シークしたとき）
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:hostState', function(playing, position)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then
        return
    end

    local session = sessions[playerSession[src] or -1]
    if not session or session.host ~= src then
        return
    end

    position = finiteNumber(position)
    if type(playing) ~= 'boolean' or not position then
        return
    end

    -- 報告の頻度を抑える（操作の直後に続けて届くことがあるので、ごく短い間隔だけ弾く）
    local t = now()
    if lastHostStateAt[src] and (t - lastHostStateAt[src]) < 250 then
        return
    end
    lastHostStateAt[src] = t

    session.state = { playing = playing, position = clamp(position, 0, MAX_POSITION), at = t }
    broadcastSessionSync(session)
end)

-- 参加者が再生を始めたときに、今の再生状態を問い合わせる
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:requestSync', function()
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then
        return
    end

    local session = sessions[playerSession[src] or -1]
    if not session or session.host == src then
        return
    end

    local payload = syncPayload(session.state)
    payload.sessionId = session.id
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:sessionSync', src, payload)
end)

-- ================== 共有（ホストから近くの人へ） ==================

-- 引数は url と targetPlayers のみ。送信者の名前と ID は source から取得する
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:shareVideo', function(url, targetPlayers)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then
        return
    end

    -- URL（正規化したものだけを中継する）
    local media, reason = MoviePlayer.ParseMedia(url)
    if not media then
        notify(src, 'error', reason)
        return
    end

    -- 共有した本人はすでに再生を始めているので、検証で弾いても上映は作っておく
    local session = startSession(src, media)

    if type(targetPlayers) ~= 'table' then
        notify(src, 'error', '共有先が不正です')
        return
    end

    -- 連続送信の制限
    local t = now()
    local last = lastShareAt[src]
    if last and (t - last) < Config.ShareCooldownMs then
        notify(src, 'error', '共有の間隔が短すぎます。少し待ってからもう一度お試しください')
        return
    end

    -- 共有先の検証（型・人数上限・在線・重複・距離）
    local targets = {}
    local seen = {}
    local skipped = 0

    for index, raw in ipairs(targetPlayers) do
        if index > Config.MaxShareTargets then
            notify(src, 'error', ('一度に共有できるのは%d人までです'):format(Config.MaxShareTargets))
            return
        end

        local id = tonumber(raw)
        if id and id > 0 and id == math.floor(id) and id ~= src and not seen[id] then
            seen[id] = true
            if isOnline(id) and isWithinRange(src, id) then
                targets[#targets + 1] = id
            else
                skipped = skipped + 1
            end
        end
    end

    if #targets == 0 then
        notify(src, 'error', '共有できるプレイヤーがいません（離れた、または退出した可能性があります）')
        return
    end

    lastShareAt[src] = t
    MoviePlayer.Log(('player %d shares %s to %d players'):format(src, media.platform, #targets))

    for _, targetId in ipairs(targets) do
        pendingOffers[targetId] = {
            from = src,
            sessionId = session.id,
            expires = t + Config.ShareRequestTimeoutMs + 5000,
        }
        TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:receiveShare', targetId, media.url, session.hostName, src)
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:shareResult', src, #targets, skipped)
end)

-- 受信者の応答（視聴する / 辞退 / 時間切れ）を送信者へ伝える
-- 直前にこの受信者へ共有した送信者がいる場合だけ有効。視聴するなら上映に加える
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:shareResponse', function(status)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then
        return
    end
    if type(status) ~= 'string' or not RESPONSE_STATUSES[status] then
        return
    end

    local offer = pendingOffers[src]
    if not offer then
        return
    end
    pendingOffers[src] = nil

    if now() > offer.expires or not isOnline(offer.from) then
        return
    end

    if status == 'accepted' then
        local session = sessions[offer.sessionId]
        if session and session.host == offer.from and not addMember(session, src) then
            notify(src, 'info', '上映の人数が上限に達しているため、同期せずに再生します')
        end
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:shareReply', offer.from, playerName(src), status)
end)

-- ================== 参加の申請（近くの人からホストへ） ==================

-- 近くで上映している上映の一覧（自分が参加していないもの）
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:listSessions', function()
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src or not Config.JoinRequestEnabled then
        return
    end

    local t = now()
    if lastListAt[src] and (t - lastListAt[src]) < 1000 then
        return
    end
    lastListAt[src] = t

    local list = {}
    local mine = playerSession[src]
    for id, session in pairs(sessions) do
        if id ~= mine and session.host ~= src and isWithinRange(src, session.host) then
            list[#list + 1] = {
                sessionId = id,
                hostId = session.host,
                hostName = session.hostName,
                platform = session.media.platform,
                memberCount = session.count,
                full = session.count >= Config.MaxSessionMembers,
                pending = joinRequests[src] ~= nil and joinRequests[src].sessionId == id,
            }
        end
    end
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:sessionList', src, list)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:requestJoin', function(sessionId)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src or not Config.JoinRequestEnabled then
        return
    end

    sessionId = tonumber(sessionId)
    local session = sessionId and sessions[sessionId]
    if not session then
        notify(src, 'error', 'この上映は終わりました')
        return
    end
    if session.host == src or session.members[src] then
        return
    end
    if session.count >= Config.MaxSessionMembers then
        notify(src, 'error', 'この上映は人数が上限に達しています')
        return
    end
    if not isWithinRange(src, session.host) then
        notify(src, 'error', 'ホストから離れているため、申請できません')
        return
    end

    local t = now()
    if lastJoinRequestAt[src] and (t - lastJoinRequestAt[src]) < Config.JoinRequestCooldownMs then
        notify(src, 'error', '申請の間隔が短すぎます。少し待ってからもう一度お試しください')
        return
    end
    lastJoinRequestAt[src] = t

    -- 申請は同時に1件だけ（前の申請は取り消す）
    cancelJoinRequest(src)

    local expires = t + Config.JoinRequestTimeoutMs
    joinRequests[src] = { sessionId = session.id, host = session.host, expires = expires }
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:joinRequest', session.host, src, playerName(src), Config.JoinRequestTimeoutMs)
    notify(src, 'info', ('%sさんに参加を申請しました'):format(session.hostName))

    SetTimeout(Config.JoinRequestTimeoutMs + 1000, function()
        local request = joinRequests[src]
        if request and request.expires == expires then
            cancelJoinRequest(src, ('%sさんから応答がありませんでした'):format(session.hostName))
        end
    end)
end)

-- ホストの答え（許可 / 拒否）
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:joinResponse', function(requester, approved)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    requester = tonumber(requester)
    if not src or not requester or type(approved) ~= 'boolean' then
        return
    end

    local request = joinRequests[requester]
    if not request or request.host ~= src then
        return
    end
    joinRequests[requester] = nil

    local session = sessions[request.sessionId]
    if not session or session.host ~= src or not isOnline(requester) then
        return
    end

    local hostName = session.hostName
    if not approved then
        notify(requester, 'info', ('%sさんは参加の申請を断りました'):format(hostName))
        return
    end

    if not addMember(session, requester) then
        notify(requester, 'error', 'この上映は人数が上限に達しています')
        notify(src, 'info', '人数が上限に達しているため、参加できませんでした')
        return
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:joinApproved', requester, session.media.url, hostName)
    notify(src, 'success', ('%sさんが参加しました'):format(playerName(requester)))
end)

-- ================== 空間スクリーン ==================

local function licenseOf(src)
    local license = GetPlayerIdentifierByType(tostring(src), 'license')
    return license or ('src:' .. tostring(src))
end

-- IsPlayerAceAllowed は許可のとき true ではなく 1 を返す（2026-11-11 に実機で確認）。どちらでも通す
-- Lua では 0 も真になるので、真偽をそのまま使わずに true か 1 かで見る
local function isAdmin(src)
    local allowed = IsPlayerAceAllowed(tostring(src), Config.Screens.AdminAce)
    return allowed == true or allowed == 1
end

local function canManageScreen(src, screen)
    return isAdmin(src) or screen.owner == licenseOf(src)
end

-- クライアントへ送るスクリーンの情報（持ち主の license は送らない）
local function publicScreen(screen)
    return {
        id = screen.id,
        ownerSrc = screen.ownerSrc,
        ownerName = screen.ownerName,
        x = screen.x,
        y = screen.y,
        z = screen.z,
        heading = screen.heading,
        width = screen.width,
        media = screen.media and publicMedia(screen.media) or nil,
        sync = screen.media and syncPayload(screen.state) or nil,
    }
end

local function broadcastScreen(screen)
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:screenUpsert', -1, publicScreen(screen))
end

-- 置く・動かす・動画の変更の頻度を抑える
local function screenActionAllowed(src)
    local t = now()
    if lastScreenActionAt[src] and (t - lastScreenActionAt[src]) < Config.Screens.ActionCooldownMs then
        notify(src, 'error', '操作の間隔が短すぎます。少し待ってからもう一度お試しください')
        return false
    end
    lastScreenActionAt[src] = t
    return true
end

-- 位置・向き・幅を検証して返す。不正なら nil とエラーメッセージ
local function readPlacement(src, data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then
        return nil, '配置の情報が不正です'
    end

    local x, y, z = finiteNumber(data.x), finiteNumber(data.y), finiteNumber(data.z)
    local heading, width = finiteNumber(data.heading), finiteNumber(data.width)
    if not (x and y and z and heading and width) then
        return nil, '配置の情報が不正です'
    end
    if math.abs(x) > 20000 or math.abs(y) > 20000 or z < -500 or z > 3000 then
        return nil, '置けない場所です'
    end

    local point = vector3(x, y, z)
    if not isNearPoint(src, point, Config.Screens.PlaceDistance) then
        return nil, '離れすぎているため置けません'
    end

    return {
        x = x,
        y = y,
        z = z,
        heading = heading % 360,
        width = clamp(width, Config.Screens.MinWidth, Config.Screens.MaxWidth),
    }
end

local function countScreensOf(owner)
    local count = 0
    for _, screen in pairs(screens) do
        if screen.owner == owner then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function setScreenMedia(screen, media)
    screen.media = media
    screen.state = { playing = true, position = 0, at = now() }
end

-- 置く（url を付けると、置いたスクリーンでそのまま再生する）
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:placeScreen', function(data, url)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src or not Config.Screens.Enabled then
        return
    end

    local placement, reason = readPlacement(src, data)
    if not placement then
        notify(src, 'error', reason)
        return
    end

    local media
    if url ~= nil and url ~= '' then
        local err
        media, err = MoviePlayer.ParseMedia(url)
        if not media then
            notify(src, 'error', err)
            return
        end
    end

    local owner = licenseOf(src)
    if not isAdmin(src) and countScreensOf(owner) >= Config.Screens.MaxPerPlayer then
        notify(src, 'error', ('置けるスクリーンは%d枚までです。撤去してから置いてください'):format(Config.Screens.MaxPerPlayer))
        return
    end
    if not screenActionAllowed(src) then
        return
    end

    nextScreenId = nextScreenId + 1
    local screen = {
        id = nextScreenId,
        owner = owner,
        ownerSrc = src,
        ownerName = playerName(src),
    }
    for key, value in pairs(placement) do
        screen[key] = value
    end
    if media then
        setScreenMedia(screen, media)
    end

    screens[screen.id] = screen
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    notify(src, 'success', 'スクリーンを置きました。心の目（ALT）で操作できます')
    MoviePlayer.Log(('screen %d placed by %d'):format(screen.id, src))
end)

-- 位置・大きさを変える
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:moveScreen', function(id, data)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    local screen = screens[tonumber(id) or -1]
    if not src or not screen then
        return
    end
    if not canManageScreen(src, screen) then
        notify(src, 'error', 'このスクリーンを動かす権限がありません')
        return
    end

    local placement, reason = readPlacement(src, data)
    if not placement then
        notify(src, 'error', reason)
        return
    end
    if not screenActionAllowed(src) then
        return
    end

    for key, value in pairs(placement) do
        screen[key] = value
    end
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    notify(src, 'success', 'スクリーンを動かしました')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:removeScreen', function(id)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    local screen = screens[tonumber(id) or -1]
    if not src or not screen then
        return
    end
    if not canManageScreen(src, screen) then
        notify(src, 'error', 'このスクリーンを撤去する権限がありません')
        return
    end

    screens[screen.id] = nil
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:screenRemove', -1, screen.id)
    notify(src, 'success', 'スクリーンを撤去しました')
end)

-- 動画を変える（空の URL なら止める）
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:setScreenMedia', function(id, url)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    local screen = screens[tonumber(id) or -1]
    if not src or not screen then
        return
    end
    if not canManageScreen(src, screen) then
        notify(src, 'error', 'このスクリーンの動画を変える権限がありません')
        return
    end

    local media
    if url ~= nil and url ~= '' then
        local err
        media, err = MoviePlayer.ParseMedia(url)
        if not media then
            notify(src, 'error', err)
            return
        end
    end
    if not screenActionAllowed(src) then
        return
    end

    if media then
        setScreenMedia(screen, media)
    else
        screen.media = nil
        screen.state = nil
    end
    broadcastScreen(screen)
end)

-- 再生・一時停止・シーク（置いた人と管理者だけ。音量は各自がクライアントで変える）
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:screenControl', function(id, action, position)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    local screen = screens[tonumber(id) or -1]
    if not src or not screen or not screen.media then
        return
    end
    if not canManageScreen(src, screen) then
        notify(src, 'error', 'このスクリーンを操作する権限がありません')
        return
    end

    local current = currentPosition(screen.state)
    position = finiteNumber(position)

    if action == 'pause' then
        screen.state = { playing = false, position = position or current, at = now() }
    elseif action == 'play' then
        screen.state = { playing = true, position = position or current, at = now() }
    elseif action == 'seek' and position then
        screen.state = { playing = screen.state.playing, position = clamp(position, 0, MAX_POSITION), at = now() }
    else
        return
    end

    local payload = syncPayload(screen.state)
    payload.screenId = screen.id
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:screenSync', -1, payload)
end)

-- 参加したときに、置かれているスクリーンを全部送る
RegisterNetEvent('ta-movie-player:requestScreens', function()
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then
        return
    end

    local list = {}
    for _, screen in pairs(screens) do
        list[#list + 1] = publicScreen(screen)
    end
    TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:screensInit', src, list, isAdmin(src))
end)

-- 再接続した持ち主を、スクリーンの持ち主として表示し直す
AddEventHandler('playerJoining', function()
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then
        return
    end

    local owner = licenseOf(src)
    for _, screen in pairs(screens) do
        if screen.owner == owner then
            screen.ownerSrc = src
            screen.ownerName = playerName(src)
            broadcastScreen(screen)
        end
    end
end)

-- ================== 退出 ==================

-- 退出したプレイヤーの状態を片付ける（サーバーIDは再利用されるため）
AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then
        return
    end

    -- 上映を終える前に、このホストへの申請を「退出したため」として取り消す
    for requester, request in pairs(joinRequests) do
        if request.host == src then
            cancelJoinRequest(requester, 'ホストが退出したため、参加の申請を取り消しました')
        end
    end
    cancelJoinRequest(src)
    leaveSession(src)

    lastShareAt[src] = nil
    lastJoinRequestAt[src] = nil
    lastListAt[src] = nil
    lastHostStateAt[src] = nil
    lastScreenActionAt[src] = nil
    pendingOffers[src] = nil
    for targetId, offer in pairs(pendingOffers) do
        if offer.from == src then
            pendingOffers[targetId] = nil
        end
    end

    for id, screen in pairs(screens) do
        if screen.ownerSrc == src then
            screen.ownerSrc = nil
            if Config.Screens.RemoveOnOwnerDrop then
                screens[id] = nil
                TriggerClientEvent('ta-movie-player:screenRemove', -1, id)
            else
                broadcastScreen(screen)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- リソース開始時のログ
AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resourceName)
    if GetCurrentResourceName() == resourceName then
        print('[ta-movie-player] Resource started')
    end
end)

-- Cfx.re Lua runtime (client and server): the `Citizen` scheduler / native
-- invocation table and its global aliases. Sources: citizen-scripting-lua
-- `LuaScriptRuntime.cpp` (g_citizenLib) and `scheduler.lua`.
--
-- The global `Wait` alias is declared in `server/server_citizen.lua` only: on the
-- client it is provided by the game natives (SYSTEM::WAIT), which the runtime
-- overrides with `Citizen.Wait`.

---
--- The CfxLua scheduler and native invocation API.
---
--- Every resource script runs inside a cooperative scheduler: use
--- `Citizen.CreateThread` (or the global `CreateThread`) to start a thread and
--- `Citizen.Wait` (or `Wait`) to yield it.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/client-functions/)
---@class Citizen
Citizen = {}

---
--- Creates a new scheduler thread (a coroutine) that starts running on the next
--- scheduler tick. `Wait` can be used inside it.
---
--- The routine is called without arguments. The returned id is a scheduler
--- bookmark: passing it to `ClearTimeout` before the thread starts cancels it.
---
--- ```lua
--- Citizen.CreateThread(function()
---     while true do
---         Citizen.Wait(0)
---     end
--- end)
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.CreateThread/)
---@param routine fun() @The function to run in the new thread.
---@return integer @The scheduler bookmark id of the new thread.
function Citizen.CreateThread(routine) end

---
--- Creates a new scheduler thread and runs it immediately, in the current tick,
--- until it finishes or yields for the first time (for example with `Wait`).
---
--- There is no global alias for this function.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.CreateThreadNow/)
---@overload fun(routine:fun()):boolean
---@param routine fun() @The function to run in the new thread.
---@param name string @Optional thread name, shown in profiler and error output.
---@return boolean @`true` if the thread yielded and is still alive, `false` if it already finished.
function Citizen.CreateThreadNow(routine, name) end

---
--- Pauses the current scheduler thread for `ms` milliseconds. `0` (or no
--- argument) resumes the thread on the next tick.
---
--- Must run inside a scheduler thread. The main chunk of each resource script,
--- `CreateThread` and `SetTimeout` callbacks, event handlers, NUI callbacks and
--- exports all run in one; plain coroutines created with `coroutine.create` do
--- not.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.Wait/)
---@overload fun()
---@param ms integer @Number of milliseconds to wait.
function Citizen.Wait(ms) end

---
--- Runs `callback` in a new scheduler thread after `msec` milliseconds.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.SetTimeout/)
---@param msec integer @Delay in milliseconds.
---@param callback fun() @The function to run.
---@return integer @Timeout id, usable with `ClearTimeout`.
function Citizen.SetTimeout(msec, callback) end

---
--- Cancels a pending `SetTimeout` (or a `CreateThread` that has not started
--- yet).
---@param id integer @The id returned by `SetTimeout` or `CreateThread`.
---@return boolean @`true` if a pending timeout was removed.
function Citizen.ClearTimeout(id) end

---
--- Writes `message` to the console (F8 on the client, the server console on
--- FXServer). No newline is appended.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.Trace/)
---@param message string @The text to print.
function Citizen.Trace(message) end

---
--- Waits for a promise to settle and returns its value. Raises the rejection
--- value as an error if the promise is rejected.
---
--- Must run inside a scheduler thread (the main chunk of a resource script,
--- `CreateThread`, an event handler, ...).
---
--- ```lua
--- local p = promise.new()
--- SetTimeout(1000, function() p:resolve('done') end)
--- print(Citizen.Await(p))
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.Await/)
---@param p promise @The promise to wait for.
---@return any @The resolved value.
function Citizen.Await(p) end

---
--- Calls a native function by hash. Prefer the generated native functions
--- (`GetPlayerName(PlayerId())`, ...) whenever they exist.
---
--- Vector arguments are expanded into their components. Out-parameters and the
--- result type are selected with the marker functions passed as extra
--- arguments: `Citizen.PointerValueInt()`, `Citizen.PointerValueFloat()`,
--- `Citizen.PointerValueVector()`, `Citizen.ResultAsInteger()`,
--- `Citizen.ResultAsFloat()`, `Citizen.ResultAsString()`,
--- `Citizen.ResultAsVector()`, `Citizen.ReturnResultAnyway()`, ...
---
--- Example with the GTA V native `GET_PLAYER_NAME`:
---
--- ```lua
--- local name = Citizen.InvokeNative(0x6D0DE6A7B5DA71F8, PlayerId(), Citizen.ResultAsString())
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.InvokeNative/)
---@param hash integer @The native hash.
---@vararg any
---@return any @The native result followed by the requested pointer values.
function Citizen.InvokeNative(hash, ...) end

---
--- Creates a function reference string for `func`, so it can be passed to other
--- resources or runtimes (for example as a native argument).
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.GetFunctionReference/)
---@param func function|table @A function, or a function reference table received from another resource.
---@return string|nil @The canonical function reference, or `nil` if `func` cannot be referenced.
function Citizen.GetFunctionReference(func) end

---
--- **Internal.** Calls a function reference with msgpack-serialized arguments
--- and returns the msgpack-serialized results. Used by the runtime when a
--- funcref received from another resource is called.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.InvokeFunctionReference/)
---@param ref string @The function reference.
---@param argsSerialized string @The msgpack-packed argument array.
---@return string @The msgpack-packed results.
function Citizen.InvokeFunctionReference(ref, argsSerialized) end

---
--- **Internal.** Converts a local function reference index into its canonical,
--- globally unique reference string.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.CanonicalizeRef/)
---@param refIdx integer @The local reference index.
---@return string @The canonical reference string.
function Citizen.CanonicalizeRef(refIdx) end

---
--- **Internal.** Resolves a native by its Lua name. Used by the lazy native
--- loader that backs the global native functions.
---@param nativeName string @The Lua name of the native, for example `GetPlayerPed`.
---@return any @The native implementation, or `nil` if no such native exists.
function Citizen.LoadNative(nativeName) end

---
--- Native argument marker: declares an `int*` output parameter. The value it
--- receives is appended to the return values of `Citizen.InvokeNative`.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.PointerValueInt/)
---@return userdata @The argument marker.
function Citizen.PointerValueInt() end

---
--- Native argument marker: declares an `int*` in/out parameter initialized with
--- `value`. The resulting value is appended to the return values.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.PointerValueIntInitialized/)
---@param value integer @The initial value.
---@return userdata @The argument marker.
function Citizen.PointerValueIntInitialized(value) end

---
--- Native argument marker: declares a `float*` output parameter. The value it
--- receives is appended to the return values.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/Citizen.PointerValueFloat/)
---@return userdata @The argument marker.
function Citizen.PointerValueFloat() end

-- Cfx.re Lua runtime (client and server): event handling, from `scheduler.lua`.
-- CancelEvent, WasEventCanceled, GetInvokingResource and GetCurrentResourceName
-- are natives and come from the generated native libraries.

---
--- Handle returned by `AddEventHandler` and `RegisterNetEvent`. Pass it to
--- `RemoveEventHandler` to unregister the handler.
---@class EventHandlerData
---@field key integer @Internal handler key.
---@field name string @Name of the event the handler is registered for.
local EventHandlerDataType = {}

---
--- Registers `eventRoutine` as a handler for the event `eventName` and returns
--- a handle for `RemoveEventHandler`.
---
--- Each handler call runs in its own scheduler thread, so `Wait` can be used in
--- it. During the call, the global `source` holds the event source (the player
--- server id for events sent by a client, on the server).
---
--- Events coming from the network are only delivered when the event has been
--- registered with `RegisterNetEvent`.
---
--- Built-in events include:
---
--- * shared: `onResourceStart`, `onResourceStarting`, `onResourceStop`
--- * server: `onServerResourceStart`, `onServerResourceStop`,
---   `onResourceListRefresh`, `playerConnecting`, `playerJoining`,
---   `playerDropped`, `playerEnteredScope`, `playerLeftScope`,
---   `entityCreating`, `entityCreated`, `entityRemoved`,
---   `onPlayerBucketChange`, `onEntityBucketChange`, `weaponDamageEvent`,
---   `startProjectileEvent`, `ptFxEvent`, `removeAllWeaponsEvent`,
---   `respawnPlayerPedEvent`, `vehicleComponentControlEvent`
--- * client: `onClientResourceStart`, `onClientResourceStop`,
---   `gameEventTriggered`, `entityDamaged`, `populationPedCreating`,
---   `mumbleConnected`, `mumbleDisconnected`
---
--- ```lua
--- AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resourceName)
---     if resourceName == GetCurrentResourceName() then
---         print('started')
---     end
--- end)
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/AddEventHandler/),
--- [event list](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/events/list/)
---@param eventName string @The event name.
---@param eventRoutine function @The handler, called with the event arguments.
---@return EventHandlerData @Handle usable with `RemoveEventHandler`.
function AddEventHandler(eventName, eventRoutine) end

---
--- Removes an event handler registered with `AddEventHandler` or
--- `RegisterNetEvent`. Raises an error if `eventData` is not a valid handle.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/RemoveEventHandler/)
---@param eventData EventHandlerData @The handle returned when the handler was registered.
function RemoveEventHandler(eventData) end

---
--- Marks the event `eventName` as safe to be triggered from the network
--- (`TriggerServerEvent` on the client, `TriggerClientEvent` on the server).
--- Network events that were not registered this way are dropped.
---
--- When `eventRoutine` is given, it is also registered as a handler, like
--- `AddEventHandler`.
---
--- ```lua
--- RegisterNetEvent('myResource:hello', function(message)
---     print(('player %s says %s'):format(source, message))
--- end)
--- ```
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/RegisterNetEvent/)
---@overload fun(eventName:string)
---@param eventName string @The event name.
---@param eventRoutine function @Optional handler, called with the event arguments.
---@return EventHandlerData|nil @The handler handle when `eventRoutine` is given, `nil` otherwise.
function RegisterNetEvent(eventName, eventRoutine) end

---
--- Triggers the event `eventName` locally (on the same side, in every resource
--- that handles it). Arguments are serialized with msgpack: functions become
--- function references and tables are copied.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-reference/runtimes/lua/functions/TriggerEvent/)
---@param eventName string @The event name.
---@vararg any
function TriggerEvent(eventName, ...) end

-- ta-movie-player 共通処理（client / server の両方から読み込まれる）
-- URLの検証は必ずここを通す。受け取った文字列をそのまま信用せず、
-- 許可したホストと形式に一致したものだけを「正規化したURL」に作り直して使う。
MoviePlayer = {}

-- 許可するホスト（完全一致。部分一致は使わない）
local YOUTUBE_HOSTS = {
    ['youtube.com'] = true,
    ['www.youtube.com'] = true,
    ['m.youtube.com'] = true,
    ['music.youtube.com'] = true,
}

local TWITCH_HOSTS = {
    ['twitch.tv'] = true,
    ['www.twitch.tv'] = true,
    ['m.twitch.tv'] = true,
}

-- チャンネル名として扱わない Twitch の予約パス
local TWITCH_RESERVED = {
    videos = true, directory = true, p = true, settings = true, downloads = true,
    jobs = true, turbo = true, wallet = true, subscriptions = true, inventory = true,
    drops = true, friends = true, following = true, search = true, store = true,
}

local MSG_UNSUPPORTED = 'YouTubeまたはTwitchのURLを入力してください'
local MSG_BAD_FORMAT = 'URLの形式が正しくありません（動画・配信・クリップのURLを指定してください）'

-- デバッグ時だけログを出す
function MoviePlayer.Log(...)
    if Config.Debug then
        print('[ta-movie-player]', ...)
    end
end

-- 表示名を安全な長さ・文字に整える
function MoviePlayer.SanitizeName(name)
    name = tostring(name or '')
    name = name:gsub('%c', '')
    -- UTF-8 の途中で切らないように、33文字目の位置までで切り詰める
    local ok, position = pcall(utf8.offset, name, 33)
    if ok and position then
        name = name:sub(1, position - 1)
    end
    if name == '' then
        name = '不明'
    end
    return name
end

-- URLを「ホスト」「パス」「クエリ」に分解する。許可できない形なら nil
local function splitUrl(url)
    -- スキームが無ければ https とみなす
    if not url:match('^%a[%w+.-]*://') then
        url = 'https://' .. url
    end

    local scheme, rest = url:match('^(%a[%w+.-]*)://(.*)$')
    if not scheme then
        return nil
    end
    scheme = scheme:lower()
    if scheme ~= 'http' and scheme ~= 'https' then
        return nil
    end

    -- ユーザー情報（user@host）、ポート、空白を含むホストは拒否
    local authority, tail = rest:match('^([^/?#]*)(.*)$')
    if authority == '' or authority:find('[@:%s]') then
        return nil
    end

    local pathPart, queryPart = tail:match('^([^?#]*)%??([^#]*)')
    return authority:lower(), pathPart or '', queryPart or ''
end

local function splitPath(pathPart)
    local segments = {}
    for segment in pathPart:gmatch('[^/]+') do
        segments[#segments + 1] = segment
    end
    return segments
end

local function getQueryParam(query, key)
    for name, value in query:gmatch('([^&=]+)=?([^&]*)') do
        if name == key then
            return value
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function parseYouTube(host, segments, query)
    local id
    if host == 'youtu.be' then
        id = segments[1]
    elseif segments[1] == 'watch' then
        id = getQueryParam(query, 'v')
    elseif segments[1] == 'shorts' or segments[1] == 'embed' or segments[1] == 'live' then
        id = segments[2]
    end

    if id and #id == 11 and id:match('^[%w_-]+$') then
        return {
            platform = 'youtube',
            kind = 'video',
            id = id,
            url = 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' .. id,
        }
    end
    return nil
end

local function parseTwitch(host, segments)
    if host == 'clips.twitch.tv' then
        local slug = segments[1]
        if slug and #slug <= 100 and slug:match('^[%w_-]+$') then
            return { platform = 'twitch', kind = 'clip', id = slug, url = 'https://clips.twitch.tv/' .. slug }
        end
        return nil
    end

    local first, second, third = segments[1], segments[2], segments[3]

    if first == 'videos' then
        if second and #second <= 20 and second:match('^%d+$') then
            return { platform = 'twitch', kind = 'video', id = second, url = 'https://www.twitch.tv/videos/' .. second }
        end
    elseif first and second == 'clip' then
        if third and #third <= 100 and third:match('^[%w_-]+$') then
            return { platform = 'twitch', kind = 'clip', id = third, url = 'https://clips.twitch.tv/' .. third }
        end
    elseif first and #segments == 1 then
        local channel = first:lower()
        if #channel <= 25 and channel:match('^[%w_]+$') and not TWITCH_RESERVED[channel] then
            return { platform = 'twitch', kind = 'channel', id = channel, url = 'https://www.twitch.tv/' .. channel }
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- URL文字列を検証して、正規化したメディア情報を返す
-- 成功: { platform = 'youtube'|'twitch', kind = 'video'|'channel'|'clip', id = '...', url = '正規化したURL' }
-- 失敗: nil, 'エラーメッセージ'
function MoviePlayer.ParseMedia(url)
    if type(url) ~= 'string' then
        return nil, 'URLが不正です'
    end

    url = url:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
    if url == '' then
        return nil, 'URLを入力してください'
    end
    if #url > (Config.MaxUrlLength or 300) then
        return nil, 'URLが長すぎます'
    end
    if url:find('%c') then
        return nil, 'URLに使用できない文字が含まれています'
    end

    local host, pathPart, query = splitUrl(url)
    if not host then
        return nil, MSG_UNSUPPORTED
    end

    local segments = splitPath(pathPart)

    if host == 'youtu.be' or YOUTUBE_HOSTS[host] then
        local media = parseYouTube(host, segments, query)
        if media then
            return media
        end
        return nil, MSG_BAD_FORMAT
    end

    if host == 'clips.twitch.tv' or TWITCH_HOSTS[host] then
        local media = parseTwitch(host, segments)
        if media then
            return media
        end
        return nil, MSG_BAD_FORMAT
    end

    return nil, MSG_UNSUPPORTED
end

local COMMANDS = { prev = 'callhud_prev', next = 'callhud_next', attach = 'callhud_attach', details = 'callhud_details' }
local list, index, details, changedAt = {}, nil, false, 0

local function keyOf(action)
  local raw = GetControlInstructionalButton(0, GetHashKey(COMMANDS[action]) | 0x80000000, true)
  return Pure.keyLabel(raw, Config.callHud.keys[action])
end

local function render()
  local view = Pure.hudView(list, index)
  if not view then return SendNUIMessage({ type = 'callhud:hide' }) end
  SendNUIMessage({
    type = 'callhud:show',
    view = view,
    details = details,
    keys = { prev = keyOf('prev'), next = keyOf('next'), attach = keyOf('attach'), details = keyOf('details') },
    labels = {
      title = L('callhud_title'),
      attach = L('callhud_attach'),
      attached = L('callhud_attached'),
      details = L('callhud_details'),
      units = L('callhud_units'),
    },
  })
end

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:callHud', function(incoming)
  if type(incoming) ~= 'table' then return end
  local before = index and list[index]
  local clean = {}
  for _, c in ipairs(incoming) do
    if type(c) == 'table' and Pure.isCallNumber(c.number) then clean[#clean + 1] = c end
  end
  list = clean
  index = Pure.hudSelect(list, before and before.number, index)
  local after = index and list[index]
  if (before and before.number) ~= (after and after.number) then
    changedAt = GetGameTimer()
    details = false
  end
  render()
end)

local function move(step)
  local nextIndex = Pure.hudMove(list, index, step)
  if not nextIndex or nextIndex == index then return end
  index = nextIndex
  details = false
  render()
end

local function attach()
  local c = index and list[index]
  if not c or c.attached or GetGameTimer() - changedAt < 1000 then return end
  TriggerServerEvent('statewide:callHud', c.number)
end

local function toggleDetails()
  if not (index and list[index]) then return end
  details = not details
  render()
end

if Config.callHud.enabled then
  RegisterCommand(COMMANDS.prev, function() move(-1) end, false)
  RegisterCommand(COMMANDS.next, function() move(1) end, false)
  RegisterCommand(COMMANDS.attach, attach, false)
  RegisterCommand(COMMANDS.details, toggleDetails, false)
  for action, command in pairs(COMMANDS) do
    RegisterKeyMapping(command, L('cmd_callhud_' .. action), 'keyboard', Config.callHud.keys[action])
  end
  CreateThread(function()
    Wait(1000)
    for _, command in pairs(COMMANDS) do TriggerEvent('chat:removeSuggestion', '/' .. command) end
  end)
end

local open = nil

local function close()
  if not open then return end
  open = nil
  SetNuiFocus(false, false)
  SendNUIMessage({ type = 'citation:hide' })
end

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:citation', function(p)
  if type(p) ~= 'table' or type(p.citation) ~= 'table' or not Pure.isRecordId(p.citation.id) then return end
  open = p.citation.id
  SetNuiFocus(true, true)
  SendNUIMessage({ type = 'citation:show', citation = p.citation, total = p.total, labels = p.labels, canSign = p.canSign == true })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:citationHide', close)

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:citationIdle', function()
  if open then SendNUIMessage({ type = 'citation:idle' }) end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('citation', function(data, cb)
  cb({})
  if type(data) ~= 'table' or not open or data.id ~= open then return end
  local action = Pure.citationAction(data)
  if not action then return end
  if action.kind == 'close' then close() end
  TriggerServerEvent('statewide:citation', { action = action.kind, id = action.id, signature = action.signature })
end)

-- Cfx.re Lua runtime (client and server): the global `exports` object, from
-- `scheduler.lua`. The exports of the individual resources are not described
-- here.

---
--- Type of the global `exports` object: index it with a resource name to get
--- the exports of that resource, and call it to define an export of the
--- current resource. Every export is called with a colon:
--- `exports.myresource:SayHello('world')`.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-manual/runtimes/lua/#using-exports)
---@class CfxExports
local CfxExportsType = {}

---
--- The global `exports` object, used to call functions exported by other
--- resources and to define the exports of the current resource.
---
--- **Calling an export.** Index `exports` with the resource name, then call the
--- export with a colon:
---
--- ```lua
--- local core = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()
--- exports.myresource:SayHello('world')
--- ```
---
--- The colon matters: the export function receives the resource table as its
--- first argument, so `exports.myresource.SayHello('world')` silently drops
--- `'world'`. Calling an export that does not exist raises
--- `No such export ... in resource ...`, and errors raised inside the export
--- are re-raised in the caller.
---
--- **Defining an export.** Call `exports` with the export name and the
--- function. Exports can also be declared in `fxmanifest.lua` with `export`
--- (client) or `server_export` (server); those export global functions.
---
--- ```lua
--- exports('SayHello', function(name)
---     print('Hello, ' .. tostring(name) .. '!')
--- end)
--- ```
---
--- Assigning fields (`exports.x = value`) raises an error.
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-manual/runtimes/lua/#using-exports)
---@type CfxExports|fun(exportName:string, exportFunction:function)
exports = nil

-- Cfx.re Lua runtime (client and server): the global `json` library. The
-- runtime uses citizenfx/lua-rapidjson, a dkjson-compatible C implementation
-- (the dkjson 2.5 mentioned by the documentation is not loaded).

---
--- JSON encoder and decoder (a dkjson-compatible implementation based on
--- RapidJSON), available as the global `json` and through `require 'json'`.
---
--- The runtime enables the `empty_table_as_array` and `with_hole` options, so
--- `{}` encodes as `[]` and arrays with a few `nil` holes are still encoded as
--- JSON arrays (with `null` in the holes).
---
--- [Documentation](https://docs.fivem.net/docs/scripting-manual/runtimes/lua/#external-libraries)
---@class json
---@field null function @Sentinel representing a JSON `null` (compare with `==`; `type(json.null)` is `'function'`).
---@field version string @Library version (same as `_VERSION`).
---@field using_lpeg boolean @Always `false` (dkjson compatibility).
---@field _NAME string @Library name.
---@field _VERSION string @Library version.
---@field _COPYRIGHT string @Copyright notice.
---@field _DESCRIPTION string @Library description.
---@field _COMPAT boolean @Whether strict dkjson compatibility is enabled (`false` in the Cfx runtime).
json = {}

---
--- Options accepted by `json.encode` (the same names can be set globally with
--- `json.setoption`). Flags are booleans unless stated otherwise.
---@class JsonEncodeOptions
---@field indent boolean @Pretty-print the output (alias: `pretty`).
---@field pretty boolean @Pretty-print the output (alias: `indent`).
---@field sort_keys boolean @Sort object keys.
---@field null boolean @Use the `json.null` sentinel for JSON `null` values.
---@field nesting boolean @Encode tables nested deeper than `max_depth` as `null` instead of raising an error.
---@field unsigned boolean @Encode integers as unsigned values.
---@field nan boolean @Allow `NaN` and infinite numbers (alias: `inf`).
---@field inf boolean @Allow `NaN` and infinite numbers (alias: `nan`).
---@field bit32 boolean @Encode integers as 32-bit values.
---@field lua_format_float boolean @Format floats with Lua's number formatting.
---@field lua_round_float boolean @Format floats with the shortest round-trip representation.
---@field vectorarray boolean @Encode vectors and quaternions as JSON arrays.
---@field single_line boolean @Keep arrays on a single line when pretty-printing.
---@field empty_table_as_array boolean @Encode empty tables as `[]` (enabled globally by the runtime).
---@field with_hole boolean @Encode sparse arrays as arrays with `null` holes (enabled globally by the runtime).
---@field max_depth integer @Maximum table nesting depth.
---@field decimal_count integer @Maximum number of decimals written for floats.
---@field indent_char integer @Indentation character when pretty-printing: 0 space, 1 tab, 2 newline, 3 carriage return.
---@field indent_count integer @Number of indentation characters per level (alias: `level`).
---@field level integer @Number of indentation characters per level (alias: `indent_count`).
---@field keyorder string[] @Object keys to write first, in this order.
---@field exception function @Handler called when a value cannot be encoded.
local JsonEncodeOptionsType = {}

---
--- Encodes a Lua value as a JSON string. Raises an error if the value cannot
--- be encoded (functions, recursive tables, ...).
---
--- ```lua
--- print(json.encode({ name = 'adder', seats = 2 }))
--- print(json.encode(data, { indent = true }))
--- ```
---@overload fun(value:any):string
---@param value any @The value to encode.
---@param options JsonEncodeOptions|table @Encoding options.
---@return string @The JSON text.
function json.encode(value, options) end

---
--- Decodes a JSON string. On success returns the decoded value and the
--- position after it; on failure returns `nil`, the error offset and an error
--- message. An empty string or `nil` decodes to `nil` with an error message.
---
--- ```lua
--- local data = json.decode(LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'data.json'))
--- ```
---@overload fun(text:string|nil):any, integer, string
---@param text string|nil @The JSON text.
---@param position integer @Position to start decoding at (default 1).
---@param nullValue any @Value used for JSON `null` (default `nil`).
---@param objectMeta table @Metatable set on decoded objects.
---@param arrayMeta table @Metatable set on decoded arrays.
---@return any, integer, string @The decoded value and the next position, or `nil`, the error offset and the error message.
function json.decode(text, position, nullValue, objectMeta, arrayMeta) end

---
--- Sets a global encoder/decoder option (see `JsonEncodeOptions` for the
--- names), or the decoder preset with `'decoder_preset'`
--- (`'default'` or `'extended'`).
---@param option string @The option name.
---@param value any @The option value.
function json.setoption(option, value) end

---
--- Returns the current value of a global option.
---@param option string @The option name.
---@return any @The option value.
function json.getoption(option) end

---
--- Marks `t` (or a new table) as a JSON object, so it encodes as `{}` even
--- when empty.
---@overload fun():table
---@param t table @The table to mark.
---@return table @The marked table.
function json.object(t) end

---
--- Marks `t` (or a new table) as a JSON array.
---@overload fun():table
---@param t table @The table to mark.
---@return table @The marked table.
function json.array(t) end

---
--- Returns `true` if `value` is a table marked as a JSON object.
---@param value any @The value to test.
---@return boolean @Whether the value is a JSON object.
function json.isobject(value) end

---
--- Returns `true` if `value` is a table marked as a JSON array.
---@param value any @The value to test.
---@return boolean @Whether the value is a JSON array.
function json.isarray(value) end

---
--- dkjson compatibility only: raises an error in the Cfx runtime.
---@deprecated LPeg is not supported; this function raises an error.
function json.use_lpeg() end

local card, closeAt = nil, 0

local function statusWord(status)
  return Locale['idcard_status_' .. tostring(status)] or status
end

local function hide()
  if not card then return end
  card = nil
  if Config.idCard.nui ~= false then SendNUIMessage({ type = 'idcard:hide' }) end
end

local function watch(payload)
  CreateThread(function()
    while card == payload do
      DisableControlAction(0, 200, true)
      local escapeHeld = IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 200)
      if GetGameTimer() >= closeAt and not escapeHeld then return hide() end
      if IsControlJustPressed(0, 174) or IsControlJustPressed(0, 175) then SendNUIMessage({ type = 'idcard:flip' }) end
      if IsDisabledControlJustReleased(0, 200) or IsControlJustPressed(0, 194) then
        hide()
        if payload.own then TriggerServerEvent('statewide:idcard') end
        return
      end
      Wait(0)
    end
  end)
end

local function chatCard(payload)
  local l = payload.license
  Notify.show(L('id_card', payload.name, payload.dob or '?'), 'info')
  Notify.show(L('id_license', l.name or '', l.number or '', statusWord(l.status) or ''), 'info')
end

local function show(payload)
  if Config.idCard.nui == false or type(payload.card) ~= 'table' then return chatCard(payload) end
  card, closeAt = payload, GetGameTimer() + Config.idCard.seconds * 1000
  SendNUIMessage({ type = 'idcard:show', card = payload.card, theme = payload.theme, handed = payload.own ~= true,
    hosts = Config.photoHosts, devHttp = Config.photoDevHttp == true,
  })
  watch(payload)
end

local function handOver()
  local dict = 'mp_common'
  RequestAnimDict(dict)
  local deadline = GetGameTimer() + 1000
  while not HasAnimDictLoaded(dict) and GetGameTimer() < deadline do Wait(10) end
  if HasAnimDictLoaded(dict) then
    TaskPlayAnim(PlayerPedId(), dict, 'givetake1_a', 8.0, -8.0, 1500, 48, 0.0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(dict)
  end
end

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:idcard', function(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= 'table' or type(payload.name) ~= 'string' or type(payload.license) ~= 'table' then return end
  if payload.handover then CreateThread(handOver) end
  show(payload)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:idcardGiven', function()
  CreateThread(handOver)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:hideid', function(p)
  if type(p) == 'table' and card and card.from == p.from then hide() end
end)
