function Pure.normalizePlate(raw)
  if type(raw) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local plate = raw:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$'):upper()
  if plate == '' or #plate > Pure.PLATE_MAX or plate:find('[^A-Z0-9 ]') then return nil end
  if PLATE_PLACEHOLDERS[plate] or PLATE_PLACEHOLDERS[plate:gsub(' ', '')] then return nil end
  return plate
end

function Pure.plateKey(plate)
  local p = Pure.normalizePlate(plate)
  if not p then return nil end
  p = p:gsub(' ', '')
  return p
end

function Pure.alprCam(cam)
  return type(cam) == 'string' and Pure.ALPR_CAMS[cam] == true
end

function Pure.alprFlags(entry, alertOn, now)
  if type(entry) ~= 'table' or type(entry.flags) ~= 'table' or type(alertOn) ~= 'table' then return {} end
  if now and type(entry.expiresAt) == 'number' and entry.expiresAt <= now then return {} end
  local present = {}
  for _, f in ipairs(entry.flags) do
    if ALPR_RANK[f] and alertOn[f] == true then present[f] = true end
  end
  local out = {}
  for _, f in ipairs(Pure.ALPR_FLAGS) do
    if present[f] then out[#out + 1] = f end
  end
  return out
end

function Pure.alprSeverity(flags)
  local top
  for _, f in ipairs(type(flags) == 'table' and flags or {}) do
    if ALPR_RANK[f] and (not top or ALPR_RANK[f] < ALPR_RANK[top]) then top = f end
  end
  return top, top and Pure.ALPR_SOUNDS[top] or nil
end

function Pure.alprSignature(flags)
  local list = {}
  for _, f in ipairs(type(flags) == 'table' and flags or {}) do list[#list + 1] = tostring(f) end
  table.sort(list)
  return table.concat(list, ',')
end

function Pure.dedupKey(netId, plate)
  local id = tonumber(netId)
  local key = Pure.plateKey(plate)
  if not id or id ~= id // 1 or id <= 0 or not key then return nil end
  return ('%d:%s'):format(id, key)
end

function Pure.windowAllow(store, now, limit, seconds)
  if type(store) ~= 'table' or type(limit) ~= 'number' or limit < 1 then return false end
  if not store.start or now - store.start >= seconds then store.start, store.n = now, 0 end
  if store.n >= limit then return false end
  store.n = store.n + 1
  return true
end

function Pure.callerKey(number)
  if type(number) == 'number' then number = tostring(math.tointeger(number) or number) end
  if type(number) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local digits = number:gsub('%D', '')
  if digits == '' then return nil end
  return 'phone:' .. digits
end

function Pure.callerWindowOpen(last, now, seconds)
  return type(last) == 'number' and now - last < seconds
end

function Pure.isServerSource(src)
  return src == '' or src == 0
end

Pure.ALPR_ALERT_COOLDOWN = 300

function Pure.shouldAlert(last, now, flags, seconds)
  if type(flags) ~= 'table' or #flags == 0 then return false end
  if type(last) ~= 'table' or type(last.at) ~= 'number' then return true end
  if last.signature ~= Pure.alprSignature(flags) then return true end
  return now - last.at >= (seconds or Pure.ALPR_ALERT_COOLDOWN)
end

function Pure.canAutoLock(camState, plate)
  if type(camState) ~= 'table' or camState.locked == true then return false end
  local want, seen = Pure.plateKey(plate), Pure.plateKey(camState.plate)
  return want ~= nil and want == seen
end

function Pure.alprText(cam, plate, flags, words)
  words = words or {}
  local names = {}
  for _, f in ipairs(flags or {}) do names[#names + 1] = words[f] or f:upper() end
  return ('%s ALPR %s: %s'):format(words[cam] or tostring(cam):upper(), plate, table.concat(names, ', '))
end

Pure.ALPR_CRITICAL = { stolen = true, ownerWarrant = true, bolo = true }
Pure.ALPR_ALERT_TEXT_MAX = 80
Pure.ALPR_ALERT_LINES_MAX = 6

function Pure.radarNative(version)
  return type(version) == 'string' and version:find('%-statewide%.%d+$') ~= nil
end

local function finite(v)
  return type(v) == 'number' and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge
end

local function wholeIn(v, low, high)
  return finite(v) and v % 1 == 0 and v >= low and v <= high
end

local function radarPoint(c)
  local kind = type(c)
  local x, y, z
  if kind == 'table' then
    x, y, z = rawget(c, 'x'), rawget(c, 'y'), rawget(c, 'z')
  elseif kind == 'vector3' then
    x, y, z = c.x, c.y, c.z
  else
    return nil
  end
  if not (finite(x) and finite(y) and finite(z)) then return nil end
  return { x = x, y = y, z = z }
end

function Pure.radarInfo(info)
  if type(info) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local out = {}
  local v, class, netId, model = rawget(info, 'v'), rawget(info, 'class'), rawget(info, 'netId'), rawget(info, 'model')
  if wholeIn(v, 1, 1000) then out.v = math.tointeger(v) end
  if wholeIn(class, 0, 22) then out.class = math.tointeger(class) end
  if wholeIn(netId, 1, 2147483647) then out.netId = math.tointeger(netId) end
  if wholeIn(model, -2147483648, 4294967295) then out.model = math.tointeger(model) end
  out.coords = radarPoint(rawget(info, 'coords'))
  out.plate = Pure.normalizePlate(rawget(info, 'plate'))
  return out
end

function Pure.alprAlertSeverity(flags)
  local level = 'info'
  for _, f in ipairs(type(flags) == 'table' and flags or {}) do
    if Pure.ALPR_CRITICAL[f] then return 'critical' end
    if ALPR_RANK[f] then level = 'warning' end
  end
  return level
end

local function alertText(s)
  s = tostring(s)
  local max = Pure.ALPR_ALERT_TEXT_MAX
  if not utf8.len(s) then return s:sub(1, max) end
  local stop = utf8.offset(s, max + 1)
  return stop and s:sub(1, stop - 1) or s
end

function Pure.alprAlert(cam, plate, flags, words)
  words = words or {}
  local names = {}
  for _, f in ipairs(type(flags) == 'table' and flags or {}) do
    if ALPR_RANK[f] then names[#names + 1] = alertText(words[f] or f:upper()) end
  end
  if #names == 0 then return nil end
  local lines = {}
  for i = 2, math.min(#names, Pure.ALPR_ALERT_LINES_MAX + 1) do lines[#lines + 1] = names[i] end
  return {
    cam = Pure.alprCam(cam) and cam or nil,
    plate = alertText(plate),
    title = names[1],
    lines = lines,
    severity = Pure.alprAlertSeverity(flags),
  }
end

function Pure.flaggedEntry(row)
  if type(row) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local key = Pure.plateKey(row.plate)
  if not key or type(row.flags) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local flags = {}
  for _, f in ipairs(row.flags) do
    if ALPR_RANK[f] then flags[#flags + 1] = f end
  end
  return key, { flags = flags, expiresAt = Pure.isoSeconds(row.expiresAt) }
end

Pure.PHONE_LIST_MAX = 25
Pure.PHONE_NOTES_MAX = 10
Pure.PHONE_TEXT_MAX = 200
Pure.PHONE_NAME_MAX = 40
Pure.PHONE_PLATE_MAX = 8
Pure.PHONE_CODE_MAX = 20

local function phoneSsn(v)
  if type(v) ~= 'string' or #v > 11 then return nil end
  local ssn = v:gsub('-', '')
  return ssn:match('^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') and ssn or nil
end

local function phoneWord(max)
  return function(v)
    if type(v) ~= 'string' or #v > max * 4 then return nil end
    local cleaned = Pure.clean(v, max + 1)
    if not cleaned or unitCount(codepoints(cleaned)) > max then return nil end
    return cleaned
  end
end

Pure.PHONE_ACTIONS = {
  me = {},
  characters = {},
  setActive = { args = { ssn = phoneSsn } },
  profile = { args = { ssn = phoneSsn } },
  my911 = {},
  call = { officer = true },
  statusCodes = { officer = true },
  status = { officer = true, args = { code = phoneWord(Pure.PHONE_CODE_MAX) } },
  panic = { officer = true, urgent = true },
  plate = { officer = true, args = { plate = phoneWord(Pure.PHONE_PLATE_MAX) } },
  name = { officer = true, args = { first = phoneWord(Pure.PHONE_NAME_MAX), last = phoneWord(Pure.PHONE_NAME_MAX) } },
}

function Pure.validatePhoneAction(action, args)
  if type(action) ~= 'string' or #action > 32 then return nil, 'unknown_action' end
  local spec = Pure.PHONE_ACTIONS[action]
  if not spec then return nil, 'unknown_action' end
  if args == nil then args = {} end
  if type(args) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'bad_args' end
  local fields = spec.args or {}
  local n = 0
  for k in pairs(args) do
    n = n + 1
    if n > 4 or type(k) ~= 'string' or not fields[k] then return nil, 'bad_args' end
  end
  local out = {}
  for k, check in pairs(fields) do
    local v = check(args[k])
    if v == nil then return nil, 'bad_args' end
    out[k] = v
  end
  return out, spec
end

local function phoneText(v, max)
  if type(v) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  return Pure.clean(v, max or Pure.PHONE_TEXT_MAX)
end

local function phoneNumber(v)
  return math.type(v) == 'integer' and v or (type(v) == 'number' and math.floor(v)) or 0
end

local function phoneName(c)
  return phoneText(table.concat({ phoneText(c.firstName, Pure.PHONE_NAME_MAX) or '', phoneText(c.lastName, Pure.PHONE_NAME_MAX) or '' }, ' ')) or '?'
end

function Pure.phoneViewCharacters(characters)
  local out = {}
  if type(characters) ~= 'table' then return out end
  for i = 1, math.min(#characters, Pure.PHONE_LIST_MAX) do
    local c = characters[i]
    local ssn = type(c) == 'table' and phoneSsn(c.ssn)
    if ssn then
      out[#out + 1] = { ssn = ssn, name = phoneName(c), dob = phoneText(c.dob, 10), status = phoneText(c.status, 20), active = c.isActive == true }
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function eachOf(list, fn)
  local out = {}
  if type(list) ~= 'table' then return out end
  for i = 1, math.min(#list, Pure.PHONE_LIST_MAX) do
    local v = type(list[i]) == 'table' and fn(list[i])
    if v then out[#out + 1] = v end
  end
  return out
end

function Pure.phoneViewProfile(profile)
  if type(profile) ~= 'table' or type(profile.character) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local c = profile.character
  local ssn = phoneSsn(c.ssn)
  if not ssn then return nil end
  return {
    character = { ssn = ssn, name = phoneName(c), dob = phoneText(c.dob, 10), active = c.isActive == true },
    vehicles = eachOf(profile.vehicles, function(v)
      return {
        plate = phoneText(v.plate, 16) or '?', make = phoneText(v.make, 40), model = phoneText(v.model, 40), color = phoneText(v.color, 40),
        registration = phoneText(v.registrationStatus, 20), insurance = phoneText(v.insuranceStatus, 20), stolen = v.stolen == true,
      }
    end),
    licenses = eachOf(profile.licenses, function(l)
      return {
        name = phoneText(l.name, 60) or phoneText(l.type, 20) or '?', number = phoneText(l.number, 30), status = phoneText(l.status, 20),
        expiresOn = phoneText(l.expiresOn, 10), points = phoneNumber(l.points),
      }
    end),
    citations = eachOf(profile.citations, function(t)
      return {
        number = phoneText(t.number, 20) or '?', date = phoneText(t.occurredAt, 10), fine = phoneNumber(t.fineTotal), points = phoneNumber(t.points),
        courtDate = phoneText(t.courtDate, 10), courtLocation = phoneText(t.courtLocation, 80), plea = phoneText(t.plea, 20), caseStatus = phoneText(t.caseStatus, 20),
      }
    end),
  }
end

function Pure.phoneView911(calls)
  return eachOf(calls, function(c)
    if not Pure.isCallNumber(c.number) then return nil end
    return { number = c.number, status = phoneText(c.status, 20), units = phoneNumber(c.unitCount) }
  end)
end

function Pure.phoneViewCall(detail)
  if type(detail) ~= 'table' or type(detail.call) ~= 'table' or not Pure.isCallNumber(detail.call.number) then return nil end
  local call = detail.call
  local notes = {}
  local list = type(detail.notes) == 'table' and detail.notes or {}
  for i = #list, math.max(1, #list - Pure.PHONE_NOTES_MAX + 1), -1 do
    local n = list[i]
    local body = type(n) == 'table' and phoneText(n.body)
    if body then notes[#notes + 1] = { author = phoneText(n.author, 40), body = body, at = phoneText(n.at, 20) } end
  end
  return {
    number = call.number, nature = phoneText(call.nature, 80), location = phoneText(call.location, Pure.LOCATION_MAX),
    postal = phoneText(call.postal, 10), status = phoneText(call.status, 20), priority = phoneNumber(call.priority), notes = notes,
  }
end

function Pure.phoneViewStatusCodes(codes)
  return eachOf(codes, function(c)
    local code = phoneText(c.code, Pure.PHONE_CODE_MAX)
    if not code then return nil end
    return { code = code, label = phoneText(c.label, 40) or code, meaning = phoneText(c.meaning, 20) }
  end)
end

function Pure.phoneViewUnit(unit)
  if type(unit) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local status = type(unit.status) == 'table' and unit.status or {}
  local dep = type(unit.department) == 'table' and unit.department or {}
  return {
    callsign = phoneText(unit.callsign, 20), department = phoneText(dep.abbreviation, 20), status = phoneText(status.code, 20),
    statusLabel = phoneText(status.label, 40), callNumber = Pure.isCallNumber(unit.callNumber) and unit.callNumber or nil, panic = unit.isPanic == true,
  }
end

function Pure.phoneUnitKey(view)
  if type(view) ~= 'table' then return 'off' end
  local parts = {}
  for _, k in ipairs({ 'callsign', 'department', 'status', 'statusLabel', 'callNumber' }) do parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(view[k] or '') end
  parts[#parts + 1] = view.panic and '1' or '0'
  return table.concat(parts, '\31')
end

function Pure.phoneResult(messages, data)
  local ok = true
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, math.min(#messages, 6) do
    local m = messages[i]
    if m.kind == 'error' then ok = false end
    out[#out + 1] = { text = phoneText(m.text, 400) or '', kind = m.kind }
  end
  return { ok = ok, messages = out, data = data }
end

Pure.WITNESS_KINDS = { 'shots', 'crash', 'reckless', 'wreck' }
Pure.WITNESS_INCIDENT_MAX = 128

function Pure.witnessKind(v)
  if type(v) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  for i = 1, #Pure.WITNESS_KINDS do
    if Pure.WITNESS_KINDS[i] == v then return v end
  end
  return nil
end

function Pure.witnessChance(chance, roll)
  chance = tonumber(chance) or 0
  if chance <= 0 then return false end
  if chance >= 100 then return true end
  return roll <= chance
end

function Pure.witnessWindow(store, now, max, seconds)
  local n = 0
  for i = 1, #store do
    if now - store[i] < seconds then
      n = n + 1
      store[n] = store[i]
    end
  end
  for i = #store, n + 1, -1 do store[i] = nil end
  if n >= (max or 0) then return false end
  store[n + 1] = now
  return true
end

function Pure.witnessIncident(store, kind, x, y, now, radius, seconds)
  local n = 0
  for i = 1, #store do
    local e = store[i]
    if now - e.at < seconds then
      n = n + 1
      store[n] = e
    end
  end
  for i = #store, n + 1, -1 do store[i] = nil end
  local r2 = radius * radius
  for i = 1, n do
    local e = store[i]
    local dx, dy = e.x - x, e.y - y
    if e.kind == kind and dx * dx + dy * dy <= r2 then return false end
  end
  if n >= Pure.WITNESS_INCIDENT_MAX then
    table.remove(store, 1)
    n = n - 1
  end
  store[n + 1] = { kind = kind, x = x, y = y, at = now }
  return true
end

function Pure.inQuietZone(zones, x, y)
  if type(zones) ~= 'table' then return false end
  for _, z in ipairs(zones) do
    if type(z) == 'table' and type(z.x) == 'number' and type(z.y) == 'number' and type(z.radius) == 'number' then
      local dx, dy = z.x - x, z.y - y
      if dx * dx + dy * dy <= z.radius * z.radius then return true end
    end
  end
  return false
end

function Pure.ambientPed(populationType)
  return type(populationType) == 'number' and populationType >= 1 and populationType <= 5
end

function Pure.partialPlate(plate, n)
  if type(plate) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  plate = plate:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', ''):upper()
  if #plate <= n or not plate:match('^[%w]+$') then return nil end
  return plate:sub(1, n)
end

function Pure.witnessVehicle(v, t, showPlate)
  if type(v) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local kind = t.types[v.vtype] or t.types.default or 'vehicle'
  local out = type(v.color) == 'string' and t.vehicle:format(v.color:lower(), kind) or kind
  local part = showPlate and Pure.partialPlate(v.plate, 3)
  if part then out = t.plate:format(out, part) end
  return out
end

function Pure.witnessText(template, location, postal, vehicle, t)
  local place = postal and t.place:format(location, postal) or location
  local out = template:format(place)
  if vehicle then out = out .. ' ' .. t.seen:format(vehicle) end
  return Pure.clean(out, 1000)
end

function Pure.witness911Body(o)
  local pos = Pure.position(o.coords)
  return {
    description = Pure.clean(o.description, 1000),
    location = placeOf(o.location),
    postal = o.postal,
    anonymous = true,
    origin = 'witness',
    x = pos and pos.x,
    y = pos and pos.y,
    zoneCode = o.zoneCode,
  }
end

function Pure.witnessSample(list, sample, max)
  list[#list + 1] = sample
  while #list > max do table.remove(list, 1) end
end

local function dropped(high, current, damage)
  return type(high) == 'number' and type(current) == 'number' and high - current >= damage
end

function Pure.crashSeen(list, now, current, damage, window, minSpeed)
  if type(list) ~= 'table' or type(current) ~= 'table' then return false end
  local body, engine, fast
  minSpeed = tonumber(minSpeed) or 0
  for i = 1, #list do
    local s = list[i]
    if now - s.at <= window then
      if type(s.body) == 'number' and (not body or s.body > body) then body = s.body end
      if type(s.engine) == 'number' and (not engine or s.engine > engine) then engine = s.engine end
      if type(s.speed) == 'number' and s.speed >= minSpeed then fast = true end
    end
  end
  if not fast then return false end
  return dropped(body, current.body, damage) or dropped(engine, current.engine, damage)
end

function Pure.sustained(list, now, minSpeed, need, window)
  if type(list) ~= 'table' then return false end
  local n = 0
  for i = 1, #list do
    local s = list[i]
    if now - s.at <= window then
      if s.speed < minSpeed then return false end
      n = n + 1
    end
  end
  return n >= need
end

function Pure.corroborated(store, now, need, window)
  local n = 0
  for i = 1, #store do
    if now - store[i] < window then
      n = n + 1
      store[n] = store[i]
    end
  end
  for i = #store, n + 1, -1 do store[i] = nil end
  store[n + 1] = now
  if n + 1 < need then return false end
  for i = #store, 1, -1 do store[i] = nil end
  return true
end

function Pure.wrecked(engine, body, cfg)
  return (type(engine) == 'number' and engine <= cfg.engineHealth) or (type(body) == 'number' and body <= cfg.bodyHealth)
end

Pure.MUGSHOT_MAX_BASE64 = 2796204

function Pure.mugshotMode(setting, state)
  if setting == false or setting == 'off' then return 'off' end
  if state ~= 'started' then return 'absent' end
  return 'on'
end

function Pure.mugshotTarget(arg)
  if type(arg) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  if arg:match('^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then return { ssn = arg } end
  local id = arg:match('^%d%d?%d?%d?$')
  if id and tonumber(id) > 0 then return { id = tonumber(id) } end
  return nil
end

function Pure.withinReach(a, b, maxDist, bucketA, bucketB)
  if type(a) ~= 'table' or type(b) ~= 'table' or bucketA ~= bucketB then return false end
  local limit = tonumber(maxDist)
  if not limit or limit <= 0 then return false end
  local dx, dy, dz = (a.x or 0) - (b.x or 0), (a.y or 0) - (b.y or 0), (a.z or 0) - (b.z or 0)
  return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= limit * limit
end

function Pure.mugshotOrder(client)
  if client == 'officer' then return { 'officer' } end
  return { 'suspect', 'officer' }
end

function Pure.mugshotQuality(q)
  q = tonumber(q)
  if not q or q ~= q then return 0.85 end
  return math.max(0.5, math.min(0.95, q))
end

function Pure.mugshotImage(data, maxBase64)
  if type(data) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local b64 = data:match('^data:image/jpeg;base64,(.+)$') or data:match('^data:image/png;base64,(.+)$') or data:match('^data:image/webp;base64,(.+)$')
  if not b64 or #b64 > (maxBase64 or Pure.MUGSHOT_MAX_BASE64) then return nil end
  if not b64:match('^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=?=?$') then return nil end
  return b64
end


Pure.SYNC_PUSH_MAX = 100
Pure.SYNC_QUEUE_MAX = 5000
Pure.SYNC_ENTITIES = { 'characters', 'vehicles', 'licenses' }
Pure.SYNC_FIELDS = {
  characters = { 'firstName', 'middleName', 'lastName', 'dob', 'gender', 'heightCm', 'weightKg', 'phone' },
  vehicles = { 'plate', 'make', 'model', 'color', 'year' },
  licenses = { 'type', 'class', 'expiresOn' },
}

function Pure.syncIdent(name)
  if type(name) ~= 'string' or #name > 64 or not name:match('^[%a_][%w_]*$') then return nil end
  return name
end

function Pure.syncColumns(entity, map)
  local fields = Pure.SYNC_FIELDS[entity]
  if not fields or type(map) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'unknown entity' end
  local cols = {}
  for _, key in ipairs({ 'id', 'owner' }) do
    if not Pure.syncIdent(map[key]) then return nil, ('%s.%s is not a column name'):format(entity, key) end
    cols[#cols + 1] = map[key]
  end
  for i = 1, #fields do
    local col = map[fields[i]]
    if col ~= nil and col ~= false then
      if not Pure.syncIdent(col) then return nil, ('%s.%s is not a column name'):format(entity, fields[i]) end
      cols[#cols + 1] = col
    end
  end
  return cols
end

function Pure.syncSelect(entity, map)
  local cols, err = Pure.syncColumns(entity, map)
  if not cols then return nil, err end
  if not Pure.syncIdent(map.table) then return nil, entity .. '.table is not a table name' end
  local quoted = {}
  for i = 1, #cols do quoted[i] = '`' .. cols[i] .. '`' end
  return ('SELECT %s FROM `%s` ORDER BY `%s` LIMIT ? OFFSET ?'):format(table.concat(quoted, ', '), map.table, map.id)
end

function Pure.syncOwner(value)
  if type(value) == 'number' and value == math.floor(value) then value = ('%.0f'):format(value) end
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
  local discord = value:match('^discord:(%d+)$') or value:match('^(%d+)$')
  if discord and #discord >= 15 and #discord <= 22 then return { discordId = discord } end
  local hex = value:match('^license:(%x+)$') or value:match('^char%d+:(%x+)$') or value:match('^(%x+)$')
  if hex and #hex == 40 then return { license = 'license:' .. hex:lower() } end
  return nil
end

function Pure.syncDate(value, order)
  if type(value) == 'number' then
    if value ~= value or value < -2208988800000 or value > 32503680000000 then return nil end
    local s = math.abs(value) >= 100000000000 and value / 1000 or value
    return os.date('!%Y-%m-%d', math.floor(s))
  end
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local y, m, d = value:match('^%s*(%d%d%d%d)%-(%d%d?)%-(%d%d?)')
  if not y then
    local a, b, c = value:match('^%s*(%d%d?)[/%.%-](%d%d?)[/%.%-](%d%d%d%d)%s*$')
    if not a then return nil end
    y = c
    if order == 'mdy' then m, d = a, b else d, m = a, b end
  end
  y, m, d = tonumber(y), tonumber(m), tonumber(d)
  if m < 1 or m > 12 or d < 1 or d > 31 then return nil end
  return ('%04d-%02d-%02d'):format(y, m, d)
end

local function syncText(value, max)
  if type(value) == 'number' then value = tostring(value) end
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
  if value == '' then return nil end
  return value:sub(1, max)
end

local function syncId(value)
  if type(value) == 'number' and value == math.floor(value) and value >= 0 then return ('%.0f'):format(value) end
  local id = syncText(value, 100)
  if not id or not id:match('^[\33-\126]+$') then return nil end
  return id
end

local function syncWhole(value, low, high)
  value = tonumber(value)
  if not value or value ~= math.floor(value) or value < low or value > high then return nil end
  return math.floor(value)
end

function Pure.syncGender(value, genders)
  local gender = syncText(value, 40)
  if not gender then return nil end
  return (genders or {})[gender:lower()] or gender
end

function Pure.syncItem(entity, row, map, opts)
  if type(row) ~= 'table' or type(map) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'invalid' end
  opts = opts or {}
  local id = syncId(row[map.id])
  if not id then return nil, 'no id' end
  local function col(field)
    local c = map[field]
    if c == nil or c == false then return nil end
    return row[c]
  end
  if entity == 'characters' then
    local owner = Pure.syncOwner(row[map.owner])
    if not owner then return nil, 'no owner identifier' end
    local item = {
      externalId = id,
      discordId = owner.discordId,
      license = owner.license,
      firstName = syncText(col('firstName'), 40),
      middleName = syncText(col('middleName'), 40),
      lastName = syncText(col('lastName'), 40),
      dob = Pure.syncDate(col('dob'), opts.dateOrder),
      gender = Pure.syncGender(col('gender'), opts.genders),
      heightCm = syncWhole(col('heightCm'), 50, 250),
      weightKg = syncWhole(col('weightKg'), 20, 350),
      phone = syncText(col('phone'), 20),
    }
    if not item.firstName or not item.lastName or not item.dob then return nil, 'missing name or date of birth' end
    return item
  end
  local owner = syncId(row[map.owner])
  if not owner then return nil, 'no owner' end
  if entity == 'vehicles' then
    local plate = syncText(col('plate'), 20)
    local model = syncText(col('model'), 40)
    if not plate or not model then return nil, 'missing plate or model' end
    return {
      externalId = id,
      ownerExternalId = owner,
      plate = plate:upper():gsub('%s+', ''),
      model = model,
      make = syncText(col('make'), 40),
      color = syncText(col('color'), 40),
      year = syncWhole(col('year'), 1900, 2100),
    }
  end
  if entity == 'licenses' then
    local kind = syncText(col('type'), 60)
    if not kind then return nil, 'missing type' end
    return { externalId = id, ownerExternalId = owner, type = kind, class = syncText(col('class'), 10), expiresOn = Pure.syncDate(col('expiresOn'), opts.dateOrder) }
  end
  return nil, 'unknown entity'
end

function Pure.syncQueueNew()
  local q = {}
  for i = 1, #Pure.SYNC_ENTITIES do q[Pure.SYNC_ENTITIES[i]] = { order = {}, byId = {}, n = 0 } end
  return q
end

function Pure.syncEnqueue(q, entity, item, max)
  local bucket = q[entity]
  if not bucket or type(item) ~= 'table' or not item.externalId then return false end
  if bucket.byId[item.externalId] == nil then
    if bucket.n >= (max or Pure.SYNC_QUEUE_MAX) then return false end
    bucket.order[#bucket.order + 1] = item.externalId
    bucket.n = bucket.n + 1
  end
  bucket.byId[item.externalId] = item
  return true
end

function Pure.syncTake(q, entity, n)
  local bucket = q[entity]
  local items, rest = {}, {}
  for i = 1, #bucket.order do
    local id = bucket.order[i]
    if #items < n then
      items[#items + 1] = bucket.byId[id]
      bucket.byId[id] = nil
    else
      rest[#rest + 1] = id
    end
  end
  bucket.order, bucket.n = rest, #rest
  return items
end

function Pure.syncRequeue(q, entity, items)
  local bucket = q[entity]
  local front = {}
  for i = 1, #items do
    local id = items[i].externalId
    if bucket.byId[id] == nil then
      bucket.byId[id] = items[i]
      front[#front + 1] = id
    end
  end
  for i = 1, #bucket.order do front[#front + 1] = bucket.order[i] end
  bucket.order, bucket.n = front, #front
end

function Pure.syncTransient(status)
  return status == 0 or status == 429 or status >= 500
end

function Pure.syncTally(into, results)
  for i = 1, #(results or {}) do
    local o = results[i].outcome
    if type(o) == 'string' then into[o] = (into[o] or 0) + 1 end
  end
  return into
end


Pure.FRAMEWORK_REASONS = { not_allowed = true, not_connected = true, no_discord = true, validation = true }

local DAYS_IN_MONTH = { 31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31 }

function Pure.parseDob(value, order, today)
  local iso = Pure.syncDate(value, order)
  if not iso then return nil end
  local y, m, d = iso:match('^(%d+)%-(%d+)%-(%d+)$')
  y, m, d = tonumber(y), tonumber(m), tonumber(d)
  local leap = (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 ~= 0) or y % 400 == 0
  local max = (m == 2 and leap) and 29 or DAYS_IN_MONTH[m]
  if y < 1900 or d > max then return nil end
  if type(today) == 'string' and iso > today then return nil end
  return iso
end

local function frameworkName(value)
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
  if value == '' or #value > 40 or value:find('[%c<>]') then return nil end
  return value
end

local function frameworkId(value)
  if type(value) == 'number' and value == math.floor(value) and value >= 0 and value < 1e15 then return ('%.0f'):format(value) end
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
  if #value < 1 or #value > 100 or not value:match('^[\33-\126]+$') then return nil end
  return value
end

local function frameworkKey(value)
  if type(value) == 'number' then value = tostring(value) end
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
  if value == '' or #value > 60 then return nil end
  return value
end

local function frameworkCallsign(value)
  if type(value) == 'number' then value = tostring(value) end
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$'):upper()
  if value == '' or #value > 12 or not value:match('^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9 %-]*$') then return nil end
  return value
end

function Pure.frameworkDiscord(value)
  if type(value) == 'number' and value == math.floor(value) then value = ('%.0f'):format(value) end
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
  local d = value:match('^discord:(%d+)$') or value:match('^(%d+)$')
  if d and #d >= 15 and #d <= 22 then return d end
  return nil
end

local function frameworkCharacter(source, id, first, last, dob, gender, departmentKey, callsign, order)
  local c = {
    externalSource = source,
    externalId = frameworkId(id),
    firstName = frameworkName(first),
    lastName = frameworkName(last),
    dob = Pure.parseDob(dob, order),
    gender = Pure.syncGender(gender, { m = 'Male', f = 'Female', male = 'Male', female = 'Female' }),
    departmentKey = frameworkKey(departmentKey),
    callsign = frameworkCallsign(callsign),
  }
  if c.gender and #c.gender > 40 then c.gender = nil end
  if not c.externalId then return nil, 'id' end
  if not c.firstName or not c.lastName then return nil, 'name' end
  if not c.dob then return nil, 'dob' end
  return c
end

function Pure.normalizeNat(row, order)
  if type(row) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'row' end
  return frameworkCharacter('nat', row.id, row.first_name, row.last_name, row.dob, row.gender, row.level, nil, order)
end

function Pure.normalizeC7(char, order)
  if type(char) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'character' end
  local c, why = frameworkCharacter('c7fw', char.char_id, char.char_first_name, char.char_last_name, char.char_dob, char.char_gender, char.char_department,
      char.char_callsign, order)
  if not c then return nil, why end
  c.discordId = Pure.frameworkDiscord(char.char_discord)
  return c
end

function Pure.validateFrameworkCharacter(data, resource)
  if type(data) ~= 'table' or type(resource) ~= 'string' or not resource:match('^[%w_%.%-]+$') or #resource > 60 then return nil, 'validation' end
  local c = frameworkCharacter('resource:' .. resource, data.id, data.firstName, data.lastName, data.dob, data.gender, nil, nil, nil)
  if not c then return nil, 'validation' end
  return c
end

function Pure.frameworkDutyArgs(data)
  if type(data) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local department = frameworkKey(data.department)
  if not department then return nil end
  local callsign = nil
  if data.callsign ~= nil then
    callsign = frameworkCallsign(data.callsign)
    if not callsign then return nil end
  end
  return department, callsign
end

function Pure.mapDepartment(map, key)
  if key == nil then return 'civilian' end
  if type(map) ~= 'table' or type(key) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local hit = map[key]
  if hit == nil then
    local lower = key:lower()
    for k, v in pairs(map) do
      if type(k) == 'string' and k:lower() == lower then
        hit = v
        break
      end
    end
  end
  if type(hit) ~= 'string' or hit == '' then return nil end
  if hit:lower() == 'civilian' then return 'civilian' end
  return hit
end

function Pure.frameworkSession(nextChar, map)
  if nextChar == nil then return nil end
  local department = Pure.mapDepartment(map, nextChar.departmentKey)
  if not department then return nil, 'unmapped' end
  local s = { externalSource = nextChar.externalSource, externalId = nextChar.externalId, character = nextChar }
  if department == 'civilian' then
    s.role = 'civilian'
  else
    s.role, s.department, s.callsign = 'department', department, nextChar.callsign
  end
  return s
end

local function sameSession(a, b)
  if a == nil or b == nil then return a == b end
  if a.role ~= b.role or a.externalSource ~= b.externalSource or a.externalId ~= b.externalId then return false end
  if a.role == 'department' then return a.department == b.department and a.callsign == b.callsign end
  local x, y = a.character or {}, b.character or {}
  return x.firstName == y.firstName and x.lastName == y.lastName and x.dob == y.dob and x.gender == y.gender
end

function Pure.frameworkTransition(prev, nextChar, map, autoDuty)
  local nextSession, why = Pure.frameworkSession(nextChar, map)
  if why == 'unmapped' then return { { kind = 'unmapped', key = nextChar.departmentKey } }, prev end
  if sameSession(prev, nextSession) then return {}, prev end
  local actions = {}
  if prev and prev.signedOn then actions[#actions + 1] = { kind = 'signOff' } end
  if nextSession == nil then
    if prev and prev.role == 'civilian' then actions[#actions + 1] = { kind = 'clearCharacter' } end
    return actions, nil
  end
  if nextSession.role == 'civilian' then
    actions[#actions + 1] = { kind = 'activate', character = nextSession.character }
    return actions, nextSession
  end
  if not (prev and prev.role == 'department') then actions[#actions + 1] = { kind = 'clearCharacter' } end
  if autoDuty ~= false then actions[#actions + 1] = { kind = 'signOn', department = nextSession.department, callsign = nextSession.callsign } end
  return actions, nextSession
end

function Pure.callable(value)
  if type(value) == 'function' then return true end
  if type(value) ~= 'table' then return false end
  local mt = getmetatable(value)
  return type(mt) == 'table' and mt.__call ~= nil
end

return Pure

lib.callback.register('douro_carwash:pay', function(source, station)
    local coords = Config.Stations[station]
    if not coords then return false end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
    if vehicle == 0 or GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) ~= ped then return false end

    -- Small margin for latency between client and server positions.
    if #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - coords) > Config.Radius + 2.0 then return false end

    local now = os.time()
    if lastWash[source] and now - lastWash[source] < Config.Cooldown then
        notify(source, 'error', locale('cooldown'))
        return false
    end

    local player = exports.qbx_core:GetPlayer(source)
    if not player then return false end

    local money = player.PlayerData.money
    local account

    if money.cash >= Config.Price then
        account = 'cash'
    elseif money.bank >= Config.Price then
        account = 'bank'
    end

    if not account or not player.Functions.RemoveMoney(account, Config.Price, 'car-wash') then
        notify(source, 'error', locale('no_money', Config.Price))
        return false
    end

    lastWash[source] = now
    return true
end)

end)

C7fw = {}

local cfg = Config.c7fw or {}
local resource = cfg.resource or 'c7-scripts-framework-v3'
local warned = {}

local function warnOnce(key, line)
  if warned[key] then return end
  warned[key] = true
  print(('^3[statewide] %s^7'):format(line))
end

local function options()
  return { label = 'c7fw', map = cfg.departments, autoDuty = cfg.autoDuty ~= false }
end

local function copyOf(src)
  local ok, char = pcall(function() return exports[resource]:GetCharCopy(src) end)
  if not ok then
    warnOnce('export', ('c7fw module: %s GetCharCopy failed: %s'):format(resource, tostring(char)))
    return nil
  end
  if type(char) == 'string' then
    local decoded, value = pcall(json.decode, char)
    char = decoded and value or nil
  end
  if type(char) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  return char
end

function C7fw.load(src)
  src = tonumber(src)
  if not src or src <= 0 or not Modules.active.c7fw then return end
  local char = copyOf(src)
  if not char then return Framework.apply(src, nil, options()) end
  local character = Pure.normalizeC7(char, cfg.dateOrder)
  if not character then return Framework.refused('c7fw', src, 'validation') end
  local discord = Framework.discordOf(src)
  if not discord then return Notify.player(src, L('no_discord'), 'error') end
  if character.discordId ~= discord then return Framework.refused('c7fw', src, 'not_owner') end
  character.discordId = nil
  Framework.apply(src, character, options())
end

function C7fw.unload(src)
  src = tonumber(src)
  if not src or src <= 0 or not Modules.active.c7fw then return end
  Framework.apply(src, nil, options())
end

local function trigger(fn)
  return function(src)
    if not Pure.isServerSource(source) then return end
    CreateThread(function()
      local ok, err = pcall(fn, src)
      if not ok then print(('^1[statewide] c7fw module: %s^7'):format(tostring(err))) end
    end)
  end
end

function C7fw.start()
  local players = GetPlayers()
  for i = 1, #players do
    local src = tonumber(players[i])
    CreateThread(function()
      local ok, err = pcall(C7fw.load, src)
      if not ok then print(('^1[statewide] c7fw module: %s^7'):format(tostring(err))) end
    end)
  end
end

AddEventHandler('C7FW:PLAYER_LOADED', trigger(C7fw.load))
AddEventHandler('C7FW:PLAYER_UNLOADED', trigger(C7fw.unload))
AddEventHandler('c7fw:CharacterModified', trigger(C7fw.load))

Modules.resolve('c7fw', C7fw.start, ('[statewide] c7fw module: not detected (%s is not started)'):format(resource))

ErsMap = {}

ErsMap.RAW_MAX = 256
ErsMap.KEYS_MAX = 200

ErsMap.LICENSE_FIELDS = { 'License_Car', 'License_Bike', 'License_Truck', 'License_Boat', 'License_Pilot' }

local TRUE_WORDS = { ['true'] = true, yes = true, y = true, ['1'] = true, valid = true }
local FALSE_WORDS = { ['false'] = true, no = true, n = true, ['0'] = true, invalid = true }

function ErsMap.bool(v)
  if type(v) == 'boolean' then return v end
  if type(v) == 'number' then return v ~= 0 end
  if type(v) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local w = v:lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
  if TRUE_WORDS[w] then return true end
  if FALSE_WORDS[w] then return false end
  return nil
end

function ErsMap.oversized(t)
  if type(t) ~= 'table' then return true end
  local n = 0
  for k, v in pairs(t) do
    n = n + 1
    if n > ErsMap.KEYS_MAX then return true end
    if type(k) == 'string' and #k > ErsMap.RAW_MAX then return true end
    if type(v) == 'string' and #v > ErsMap.RAW_MAX then return true end
  end
  return false
end

local function text(v, max)
  if type(v) == 'number' then v = tostring(v) end
  if type(v) ~= 'string' or #v > ErsMap.RAW_MAX then return nil end
  return Pure.clean(v, max)
end
ErsMap.text = text

local STATUS_WORDS = {
  { 'revoked', 'revoked' }, { 'stolen', 'revoked' }, { 'suspend', 'suspended' }, { 'disqualif', 'suspended' },
  { 'expired', 'expired' }, { 'valid', 'valid' }, { 'international', 'valid' }, { 'active', 'valid' },
}

function ErsMap.licenseStatus(word, isValid)
  local status
  if type(word) == 'string' then
    local w = word:lower()
    if w:find('invalid', 1, true) or w:find('none', 1, true) or w:find('no licen', 1, true) then
      status = w:find('invalid', 1, true) and 'suspended' or nil
    else
      for _, pair in ipairs(STATUS_WORDS) do
        if w:find(pair[1], 1, true) then status = pair[2] break end
      end
    end
  elseif word == true then
    status = 'valid'
  end
  local valid = ErsMap.bool(isValid)
  if status == nil and valid == true then status = 'valid' end
  if status == 'valid' and valid == false then status = 'suspended' end
  return status
end

function ErsMap.licenses(ped, codes)
  local out = {}
  for _, field in ipairs(ErsMap.LICENSE_FIELDS) do
    local code = codes and codes[field]
    if type(code) == 'string' and code:match('^[%w_%-]+$') and #code <= 16 then
      local status = ErsMap.licenseStatus(ped[field], ped[field .. '_Is_Valid'])
      if status then out[#out + 1] = { code = code, status = status } end
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function realDate(y, m, d)
  if not y or not m or not d or y < 1900 or y > 2100 or m < 1 or m > 12 or d < 1 then return nil end
  local days = { 31, (y % 4 == 0 and (y % 100 ~= 0 or y % 400 == 0)) and 29 or 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31 }
  if d > days[m] then return nil end
  return ('%04d-%02d-%02d'):format(y, m, d)
end

function ErsMap.dob(v, order)
  if type(v) ~= 'string' or #v > 32 then return nil end
  local y, m, d = v:match('^%s*(%d%d%d%d)[-/.](%d%d?)[-/.](%d%d?)')
  if y then return realDate(tonumber(y), tonumber(m), tonumber(d)) end
  local a, b, c = v:match('^%s*(%d%d?)[-/.](%d%d?)[-/.](%d%d%d%d)')
  if not a then return nil end
  a, b, c = tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c)
  if order == 'mdy' then return realDate(c, a, b) or realDate(c, b, a) end
  return realDate(c, b, a) or realDate(c, a, b)
end

function ErsMap.flags(v)
  local out, seen = {}, {}
  local function add(s)
    local f = text(s, 40)
    if f and not seen[f:lower()] and #out < 8 then
      seen[f:lower()] = true
      out[#out + 1] = f
    end
  end
  if type(v) == 'string' then
    for part in v:gmatch('[^,;|]+') do add(part) end
  elseif type(v) == 'table' then
    local keys = {}
    for k in pairs(v) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
    table.sort(keys, function(x, y) return tostring(x) < tostring(y) end)
    for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
      local x = v[k]
      if type(k) == 'number' then
        if type(x) == 'string' then add(x) elseif type(x) == 'table' then add(x.label or x.name or x.text) end
      elseif type(k) == 'string' and (x == true or ErsMap.bool(x) == true) then
        add(k)
      elseif type(k) == 'string' and type(x) == 'table' and (x.active == true or x.enabled == true) then
        add(x.label or k)
      end
    end
  end
  return out
end

function ErsMap.person(ped, cfg)
  if ErsMap.oversized(ped) then return nil, 'shape' end
  cfg = cfg or {}
  local first, last = text(ped.FirstName, 40), text(ped.LastName, 40)
  local dob = ErsMap.dob(ped.DOB, cfg.dateOrder)
  if not first or not last or utf8.len(first) < 2 or utf8.len(last) < 2 then return nil, 'name' end
  if not dob then return nil, 'dob' end
  local postal = text(ped.PostalCode, 10)
  if postal and not postal:match('^[%w%-]+$') then postal = nil end
  return {
    firstName = first,
    lastName = last,
    dob = dob,
    gender = text(ped.Gender, 20),
    address = text(ped.Address, 120),
    city = text(ped.City, 40),
    postal = postal,
    phone = text(ped.PhoneNumber, 20),
    licenses = ErsMap.licenses(ped, cfg.licenses),
    flags = ErsMap.flags(ped.FlagsOrMarkers),
  }
end

function ErsMap.plate(v)
  if type(v) ~= 'string' or #v > 32 then return nil end
  local p = v:upper():gsub('[^A-Z0-9]', '')
  if p == '' or #p > 8 then return nil end
  return p
end

function ErsMap.ownerName(v)
  local name = text(v, 81)
  if not name then return nil end
  local first, last = name:match('^(%S+)%s+(.+)$')
  first, last = text(first, 40), text(last, 40)
  if not first or not last then return nil end
  return { firstName = first, lastName = last }
end

function ErsMap.vehicle(veh)
  if ErsMap.oversized(veh) then return nil, 'shape' end
  local plate = ErsMap.plate(veh.license_plate)
  if not plate then return nil, 'plate' end
  local make, model, color = text(veh.make, 40), text(veh.model, 40), text(veh.color, 40)
  if not make or not model or not color then return nil, 'vehicle' end
  local year = tonumber(veh.build_year)
  if year and (year ~= math.floor(year) or year < 1900 or year > 2100) then year = nil end
  local tax, mot = ErsMap.bool(veh.tax), ErsMap.bool(veh.mot)
  local registration
  if tax == false or mot == false then registration = 'expired' elseif tax == true or mot == true then registration = 'valid' end
  local bolo
  if ErsMap.bool(veh.bolo) == true then
    bolo = text(veh.bolo_description, 500) or 'Flagged by ERS'
    if #bolo < 5 then bolo = 'BOLO: ' .. bolo end
  end
  return {
    plate = plate,
    make = make,
    model = model,
    color = color,
    year = year,
    owner = ErsMap.ownerName(veh.owner_name),
    insured = ErsMap.bool(veh.insurance),
    registration = registration,
    stolen = ErsMap.bool(veh.stolen) == true,
  }, nil, bolo
end

function ErsMap.coords(v)
  if v == nil then return nil end
  local ok, x, y, z = pcall(function() return v.x, v.y, v.z end)
  if not ok or type(x) ~= 'number' or type(y) ~= 'number' then return nil end
  local pos = Pure.position({ x = x, y = y })
  if pos and type(z) == 'number' and z == z and z > -1000 and z < 3000 then pos.z = z end
  return pos
end

local COORD_KEYS = { 'Coordinates', 'coordinates', 'Coords', 'coords', 'Location', 'location', 'Position', 'position' }

function ErsMap.callout(data)
  if ErsMap.oversized(data) then return nil, 'shape' end
  local nature = text(data.CalloutName, 60) or text(data.calloutName, 60) or text(data.Name, 60) or text(data.name, 60)
  if not nature then return nil, 'nature' end
  local pos
  for _, k in ipairs(COORD_KEYS) do
    pos = ErsMap.coords(data[k])
    if pos then break end
  end
  local description = text(data.Description, 2000) or text(data.description, 2000)
  local id = text(data.calloutId, 64) or text(data.CalloutId, 64) or text(data.id, 64)
  return { nature = nature, description = description, pos = pos, id = id }
end

function ErsMap.callBody(c, discordId, labels, priority)
  local location = Pure.locationText(labels)
  if not location or #location < 3 then location = 'Unknown location' end
  return {
    nature = c.nature,
    priority = (priority == 1 or priority == 2 or priority == 3) and priority or 2,
    location = location,
    postal = labels and labels.postal,
    description = c.description,
    origin = 'ers',
    x = c.pos and c.pos.x,
    y = c.pos and c.pos.y,
    zoneCode = labels and labels.zone,
    units = { discordId },
  }
end

ErsMap.SERVICES = { police = true, fire = true, ambulance = true, tow = true }
ErsMap.MEDICAL = { EMS = true, FIRE = true }

function ErsMap.dutyDepartment(dutySync, service)
  if type(dutySync) ~= 'table' or not ErsMap.SERVICES[service] then return nil end
  local d = dutySync[service]
  if type(d) ~= 'string' or not d:match('^[%w%-_ ]+$') or #d > 60 then return nil end
  return d
end

function ErsMap.serviceFor(dutySync, abbreviation)
  if type(dutySync) ~= 'table' or type(abbreviation) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local want = abbreviation:upper()
  for _, s in ipairs({ 'police', 'fire', 'ambulance', 'tow' }) do
    local d = dutySync[s]
    if type(d) == 'string' and d:upper() == want then return s end
  end
  return nil
end

function ErsMap.mode(setting, state)
  if setting == false or setting == 'off' then return 'off' end
  if setting == true or setting == 'on' then return 'on' end
  if state == 'started' or state == 'starting' then return 'on' end
  return 'absent'
end

function ErsMap.offerReason(ok, reason)
  if ok then return nil end
  local r = type(reason) == 'string' and reason:gsub('[^%w_:%. %-]', ''):sub(1, 80) or ''
  if r == '' then return 'unknown' end
  return r
end

return ErsMap

local function now()

local function warn(src, what)

  if warnedAt[src] and t - warnedAt[src] < 60 then return end

  print(('^3[statewide] ERS event dropped for player %s: %s^7'):format(tostring(src), Pure.truncate(what, 80)))
end

local function officer(src)
  local p = State.peek(src)
  local account = Identity.getAccount(src)
  if not account or not (p and p.unit) then return nil end
  return p, account
end

local function onShift(src, service)
  local current = shift[src]
  if current == false then return false end
  return current == nil or service == nil or current == service
end

local function lawUnit(p)
  return p.unit.department ~= nil and p.unit.department.type == 'LEO'
end

local function allowed(src, bucket, seconds)
  lastUse[src] = lastUse[src] or {}
  return (Pure.useCooldown(lastUse[src], bucket, now(), seconds or cfg.cooldown))
end

local function firstSight(src, key)
  keyed[src] = keyed[src] or {}
  return (Pure.useKeyedCooldown(keyed[src], key, now(), 30, Pure.KEYED_COOLDOWN_MAX))
end

local function serial(src, fn, ...)
  if not Modules.active.ers then return end
  local args = table.pack(...)
  CreateThread(function()
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + 15000
    while busy[src] and GetGameTimer() < deadline do Wait(50) end
    busy[src] = true
    local ok, err = pcall(fn, src, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
    busy[src] = nil
    if not ok then print(('^1[statewide] ERS: %s^7'):format(err)) end
  end)
end

local function fromClient(name, fn)
  RegisterNetEvent(name, function(...)
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src or src <= 0 then return end
    serial(src, fn, ...)
  end)
end

local function fromServer(name, fn)
  AddEventHandler(name, function(target, ...)
    local origin = tonumber(source)
    local src = tonumber(target)
    if origin and origin > 0 and src ~= origin then return warn(origin, name .. ' for another player') end
    if not src or src <= 0 then return end
    serial(src, fn, ...)
  end)
end

local function slot(src)
  Ers.calls[src] = Ers.calls[src] or {}
  return Ers.calls[src]
end

local function gone(res)
  local code = res.problem and res.problem.code
  return code == 'call_closed' or code == 'not_found'
end

function Ers.note(number, account, text)
  if not number then return end
  local body = account and Pure.withPlayer(account, { body = text }) or { body = text }
  return api('POST', '/calls/{number}/notes', 'calls', { params = { number = number }, body = body, as = account })
end

function Ers.close(number)
  local res = api('POST', '/calls/{number}/close', 'calls', { params = { number = number }, body = { disposition = cfg.disposition, note = L('ers_close_note') } })
  if res.problem and res.problem.code == 'validation_failed' then
    print(('^3[statewide] ERS could not close %s: set Config.ers.disposition to a disposition in the CAD (now %s).^7'):format(number, tostring(cfg.disposition)))
  end
  return res
end

local function setStatus(src, account, body)
  local res = api('PATCH', '/units/{discordId}/status', 'units', { params = { discordId = Pure.playerSlot(account) }, body = body, as = account })
  if res.status == 200 and res.data then State.setUnit(src, res.data.unit) end
  return res
end

local function unsure(before, from)
  return { before = before, from = from, to = os.time() }
end

local function adopt(p, account, s, field, want)
  local pending = s[field]
  if pending == nil then return nil end
  s[field] = nil
  local current = p and p.unit and p.unit.callNumber
  if not current or current == pending.before then return nil end
  local res = api('GET', '/calls/{number}', 'calls', { params = { number = current } })
  local call = res.status == 200 and type(res.data) == 'table' and res.data.call or nil
  local me = { discordId = account and account.discordId, callsign = p.unit.callsign }
  return Pure.adoptCall(pending.before, current, call, want, pending, me)
end

local function calloutNumber(p, account, s)
  if not s.callout then s.callout = adopt(p, account, s, 'calloutUnsure', 'ers') end
  return s.callout
end

local function offerAnswer(src, o, body)
  body.offerId = o.offerId
  local params = { discordId = Pure.playerSlot(o.account) }
  local res = api('POST', '/units/{discordId}/ers-offer', 'units', { params = params, as = o.account, body = body })
  if body.stage == nil or not (res.problem and res.problem.code == 'validation_failed') then return end
  api('POST', '/units/{discordId}/ers-offer', 'units', { params = params, as = o.account, body = { offerId = o.offerId, ok = body.ok, reason = body.reason } })
end

local function offerAccepted(src, calloutId)
  local o = offers[src]
  if not o or (o.calloutId and calloutId and o.calloutId ~= calloutId) then return end
  o.accepted = true
  if not o.delivered then return end
  offers[src] = nil
  offerAnswer(src, o, { ok = true, stage = 'accepted' })
end

local function accepted(src, data)
  local c, why = ErsMap.callout(data)
  if c then offerAccepted(src, c.id) end
  local p, account = officer(src)
  if not p then return warn(src, 'callout accepted while not on duty in the CAD') end
  if not onShift(src) then return warn(src, 'callout accepted while off shift in ERS') end
  if not c then return warn(src, 'callout payload refused (' .. why .. ')') end
  local s = slot(src)
  if calloutNumber(p, account, s) then return end
  lastUse[src] = lastUse[src] or {}
  local ready, left = Pure.cooldown(lastUse[src].calloutCreated, now(), cfg.calloutCooldown or 0)
  if not ready then return Notify.player(src, L('cooldown', left), 'error') end
  if not allowed(src, 'callout') then return end
  local before = p.unit.callNumber
  local startedAt = os.time()
  local place = p.labels
  if c.pos then
    place = Locations.labelsAt(src, c.pos) or {}
    place.postal = Locations.serverPostal(c.pos)
  end
  local body = ErsMap.callBody(c, Pure.playerItem(account), place, cfg.calloutPriority)
  local res = api('POST', '/calls', 'calls', { body = body })
  if res.problem and res.problem.code == 'validation_failed' and (body.postal or body.zoneCode) then
    local plain = {}
    for k, v in pairs(body) do plain[k] = v end
    plain.postal, plain.zoneCode = nil, nil
    res = api('POST', '/calls', 'calls', { body = plain })
  end
  if res.status ~= 201 then
    if Pure.outcomeUnknown(res) then s.calloutUnsure = unsure(before, startedAt) end
    return Notify.problem(src, res)
  end
  s.calloutUnsure = nil
  lastUse[src].calloutCreated = now()
  s.callout = res.data.call.number
  Notify.player(src, L('ers_call_created', s.callout), 'info')
end

local function arrived(src)
  local p, account = officer(src)
  local s = slot(src)
  local number = p and calloutNumber(p, account, s)
  if not number or s.arrived == number then return end
  if not onShift(src) then return warn(src, 'arrival while off shift in ERS') end
  if not allowed(src, 'arrived') then return end
  s.arrived = number
  setStatus(src, account, { meaning = 'on_scene' })
  if gone(Ers.note(number, account, L('ers_note_arrived'))) then s.callout = nil end
end

local function completed(src)
  local p, account = officer(src)
  local s = slot(src)
  local number = calloutNumber(p, account, s)
  if not number then return end
  s.callout = nil
  if cfg.closeOnComplete then return Ers.close(number) end
  Ers.note(number, account, L('ers_note_completed'))
end

local function ended(src)
  local p, account = officer(src)
  local s = slot(src)
  local number = calloutNumber(p, account, s)
  if not number then return end
  s.callout = nil
  if cfg.closeOnEnd then return Ers.close(number) end
  if not account then return end
  Ers.note(number, account, L('ers_note_cleared'))
  api('DELETE', '/calls/{number}/units/{discordId}', 'calls', { params = { number = number, discordId = Pure.playerSlot(account) }, as = account })
end

local function pullover(src, _, vehicleData)
  local p, account = officer(src)
  if not p then return warn(src, 'pullover while not on duty in the CAD') end
  if not lawUnit(p) or not onShift(src, 'police') then return warn(src, 'pullover outside a police shift') end
  if vehicleData ~= nil and ErsMap.oversized(vehicleData) then return warn(src, 'pullover payload refused (shape)') end
  if not allowed(src, 'pullover', Config.cooldowns.ts) then return end
  local s = slot(src)
  if s.stop then return end
  local plate = type(vehicleData) == 'table' and ErsMap.plate(vehicleData.license_plate) or nil
  local before = p.unit.callNumber
  local startedAt = os.time()
  local res = api('POST', '/calls/traffic-stop', 'calls', { body = Pure.withPlayer(account, Pure.trafficStopBody(nil, plate, Locations.fetchLabels(src),
      State.readCoords(src))), as = account })
  if res.status ~= 201 then
    if Pure.outcomeUnknown(res) then s.stopUnsure = unsure(before, startedAt) end
    return Notify.problem(src, res)
  end
  s.stopUnsure = nil
  s.stop = res.data.number
  local patch = {}
  if cfg.pulloverNature then patch.nature = ErsMap.text(cfg.pulloverNature, 60) end
  if cfg.pulloverPriority then patch.priority = cfg.pulloverPriority end
  if next(patch) then api('PATCH', '/calls/{number}', 'calls', { params = { number = s.stop }, body = patch }) end
  Notify.player(src, L('ers_stop_created', s.stop), 'success')
  if res.data.vehicleReturn then Commands.showVehicle(src, res.data.vehicleReturn) end
end

local function pulloverEnded(src)
  local p, account = officer(src)
  local s = slot(src)
  local number = s.stop or adopt(p, account, s, 'stopUnsure', 'traffic_stop')
  s.stopUnsure = nil
  if not number then return end
  s.stop = nil
  if cfg.closeOnPulloverEnd then return Ers.close(number) end
  if not account then return end
  Ers.note(number, account, L('ers_note_pullover_end'))
  api('DELETE', '/calls/{number}/units/{discordId}', 'calls', { params = { number = number, discordId = Pure.playerSlot(account) }, as = account })
end

local function activeCall(src, p)
  local s = slot(src)
  return s.stop or s.callout or (p and p.unit and p.unit.callNumber)
end

local function pursuitStarted(src)
  local p, account = officer(src)
  if not p then return warn(src, 'pursuit while not on duty in the CAD') end
  if not lawUnit(p) or not onShift(src, 'police') then return warn(src, 'pursuit outside a police shift') end
  if pursuit[src] ~= nil or not allowed(src, 'pursuit') then return end
  local open = true
  local status = ErsMap.text(cfg.pursuitStatus, 20)
  if status then
    local before = p.unit.status and p.unit.status.code
    if setStatus(src, account, { code = status }).status == 200 and before then open = before end
  end
  pursuit[src] = open
  Ers.note(activeCall(src, p), account, L('ers_note_pursuit'))
end

local function pursuitEnded(src)
  local before = pursuit[src]
  if before == nil then return end
  pursuit[src] = nil
  local p, account = officer(src)
  if not p then return end
  if type(before) == 'string' then setStatus(src, account, { code = before }) end
  Ers.note(activeCall(src, p), account, L('ers_note_pursuit_end'))
end

local function closeOnShiftEnd(src)
  local s = slot(src)
  s.callout, s.arrived, s.calloutUnsure, s.stopUnsure = nil, nil, nil, nil
  local before = pursuit[src]
  if before == nil then return end
  pursuit[src] = nil
  local p, account = officer(src)
  local status = ErsMap.text(cfg.pursuitStatus, 20)
  local current = p and p.unit.status and p.unit.status.code
  if type(before) == 'string' and status and current == status then setStatus(src, account, { code = before }) end
end

local function hospital(src, pedData)
  if not cfg.hospitalNote then return end
  local p, account = officer(src)
  if not p or not p.unit.department or not ErsMap.MEDICAL[p.unit.department.type] then return end
  local name = '?'
  if type(pedData) == 'table' and not ErsMap.oversized(pedData) then
    name = ErsMap.text(((pedData.FirstName or '') .. ' ' .. (pedData.LastName or '')), 81) or '?'
  end
  Ers.note(activeCall(src, p), account, L('ers_note_hospital', name))
end

local function remember(kind, key)
  if seen.n >= SEEN_MAX then seen.people, seen.plates, seen.n = {}, {}, 0 end
  seen[kind][key] = true
  seen.n = seen.n + 1
end

local function firstPed(src, pedData)
  if not cfg.registerRecords then return end
  local _, account = officer(src)
  if not account then return end
  local body, why = ErsMap.person(pedData, cfg)
  if not body then
    if why == 'shape' then warn(src, 'ped payload refused (shape)') end
    return
  end
  local key = ('%s|%s|%s'):format(body.firstName:lower(), body.lastName:lower(), body.dob)
  if seen.people[key] or not firstSight(src, 'ped:' .. key) then return end
  Pure.withPlayer(account, body)
  local res = api('POST', '/ers/people', 'lookup', { body = body, as = account })
  if res.status == 200 or res.status == 201 then remember('people', key) end
end

local function firstVehicle(src, vehicleData)
  if not cfg.registerRecords then return end
  local _, account = officer(src)
  if not account then return end
  local body, why, bolo = ErsMap.vehicle(vehicleData)
  if not body then
    if why == 'shape' then warn(src, 'vehicle payload refused (shape)') end
    return
  end
  if seen.plates[body.plate] or not firstSight(src, 'veh:' .. body.plate) then return end
  Pure.withPlayer(account, body)
  local res = api('POST', '/ers/vehicles', 'lookup', { body = body, as = account })
  if res.status ~= 200 and res.status ~= 201 then return end
  remember('plates', body.plate)
  if res.status == 201 and bolo then
    api('POST', '/bolos', 'calls', { body = { kind = 'vehicle', plate = body.plate, description = bolo, origin = 'ers' } })
  end
end

local function toggleShift(src, isOnShift, serviceType)
  if type(isOnShift) ~= 'boolean' or type(serviceType) ~= 'string' or not ErsMap.SERVICES[serviceType] then return end
  shift[src] = isOnShift and serviceType or false
  if not isOnShift then closeOnShiftEnd(src) end
  local department = ErsMap.dutyDepartment(cfg.dutySync, serviceType)
  if not department or not allowed(src, 'shift') then return end
  local account = Identity.getAccount(src)
  if not account then return end
  local unit = (State.peek(src) or {}).unit
  if isOnShift then
    if unit then return end
    local res = api('POST', '/units/duty', 'units', { body = Pure.withPlayer(account, { department = department }), as = account })
    if res.status == 201 then
      local p = State.get(src)
      p.discordId, p.account, p.membershipId = account.discordId, account, res.data.unit.membershipId
      State.setUnit(src, res.data.unit)
      State.claim(account.discordId)
      return Notify.player(src, L('ers_duty_on', res.data.unit.callsign, res.data.unit.department.abbreviation), 'success')
    end
    if res.problem and res.problem.code == 'validation_failed' then
      return Notify.player(src, L('ers_duty_callsign', department, Config.commands.duty.name, department), 'error')
    end
    return Notify.problem(src, res)
  end
  local abbreviation = unit and unit.department and unit.department.abbreviation
  if type(abbreviation) ~= 'string' or abbreviation:upper() ~= department:upper() then return end
  local res = Commands.offDuty(src, account, 'manual')
  if res.status == 204 then Notify.player(src, L('ers_duty_off'), 'success') end
end

function Ers.cadDuty(src, unit)
  if not Modules.active.ers or not cfg.pushShift then return end
  local service = unit and ErsMap.serviceFor(cfg.dutySync, unit.department and unit.department.abbreviation)
  local target = unit and service or nil
  local current = shift[src] or nil
  if target == current or (unit and not service) then return end
  local ok = pcall(function()
    if current then exports[Ers.RESOURCE]:toggleShift(src, current) end
    if target then exports[Ers.RESOURCE]:toggleShift(src, target) end
  end)
  if ok then shift[src] = target end
end

local function offered(payload)
  if not Modules.active.ers then return end
  if type(payload) ~= 'table' or type(payload.offerId) ~= 'string' then return end
  if type(payload.discordId) ~= 'string' and type(payload.membershipId) ~= 'string' then return end
  if not payload.offerId:match('^%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+$') then return end
  local calloutId = payload.calloutId
  if calloutId ~= nil and (type(calloutId) ~= 'string' or not calloutId:match('^[%w_%-]+$') or #calloutId > 64) then calloutId = nil end
  local src, account
  for s, p in pairs(State.all()) do
    if p.unit and Pure.namesPlayer(payload.membershipId, payload.discordId, p) then src, account = s, Pure.accountOfState(p) end
  end
  if not src or not account then return end
  CreateThread(function()
    local o = { offerId = payload.offerId, account = account, calloutId = calloutId }
    offers[src] = o
    local called, ok, reason = pcall(function() return exports[Ers.RESOURCE]:SendCalloutOfferToPlayer(src, calloutId, cfg.offerTimeout) end)
    if not (called and ok == true) then
      if offers[src] == o then offers[src] = nil end
      return offerAnswer(src, o, { ok = false, reason = ErsMap.offerReason(false, called and reason or 'offer_failed') })
    end
    offerAnswer(src, o, { ok = true, stage = 'delivered' })
    if o.accepted then
      if offers[src] == o then offers[src] = nil end
      return offerAnswer(src, o, { ok = true, stage = 'accepted' })
    end
    if offers[src] ~= o then return end
    o.delivered = true
    SetTimeout((tonumber(cfg.offerTimeout) or 15000) + OFFER_GRACE_MS, function()
      if offers[src] ~= o or o.accepted then return end
      offers[src] = nil
      offerAnswer(src, o, { ok = false, stage = 'no_answer', reason = 'no_answer' })
    end)
  end)
end

function Ers.register()
  fromClient('ErsIntegration::OnAcceptedCalloutOffer', accepted)
  fromClient('ErsIntegration::OnArrivedAtCallout', arrived)
  fromClient('ErsIntegration::OnCalloutCompletedSuccesfully', completed)
  fromClient('ErsIntegration::OnEndedACallout', ended)
  fromClient('ErsIntegration::OnPullover', pullover)
  fromClient('ErsIntegration::OnPulloverEnded', pulloverEnded)
  fromClient('ErsIntegration::OnPursuitStarted', pursuitStarted)
  fromClient('ErsIntegration::OnPursuitEnded', pursuitEnded)
  fromServer('ErsIntegration::OnPersonDeliveredToHospital', hospital)
  fromServer('ErsIntegration::OnFirstNPCInteraction', firstPed)
  fromServer('ErsIntegration::OnFirstVehicleInteraction', firstVehicle)
  fromServer('ErsIntegration::OnToggleShift', toggleShift)
  AddEventHandler('statewide:ersOffer', offered)
end

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
  local src = tonumber(source)
  if not src then return end
  Ers.calls[src], lastUse[src], keyed[src], warnedAt[src], busy[src], pursuit[src], shift[src], offers[src] = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end)

Modules.resolve('ers', Ers.register)

LbPhonePure = {}

local PHONE_MAX = 20

function LbPhonePure.company(companies, name)
  if type(companies) ~= 'table' or type(name) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local label = companies[name]
  if label == nil or label == false then return nil end
  return name
end

function LbPhonePure.text(value, max)
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local spaced = value:gsub('%c', ' '):gsub('%s+', ' ')
  return Pure.clean(spaced, max)
end

function LbPhonePure.describe(company, value, max)
  local text = LbPhonePure.text(value, max)
  if not text then return nil end
  return ('[TEXT %s] %s'):format(company, text)
end

function LbPhonePure.location(labels, postal, unknown)
  local street = type(labels) == 'table' and Pure.locationText(labels) or nil
  if street then return street end
  if type(postal) == 'string' and postal ~= '' then return ('Near postal %s'):format(postal) end
  return unknown
end

function LbPhonePure.noteGate(entry, now, cooldown, max)
  entry.count = entry.count or 0
  if entry.count >= max then
    if entry.told then return 'silent' end
    entry.told = true
    return 'capped'
  end
  if entry.last and now - entry.last < cooldown then return 'cooldown' end
  entry.last = now
  entry.count = entry.count + 1
  return 'ok'
end

function LbPhonePure.phone(value)
  if type(value) == 'number' then value = tostring(math.tointeger(value) or value) end
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
  if value == '' or #value > PHONE_MAX or not value:match('^[%d %(%)%+%-]+$') or not value:find('%d') then return nil end
  return value
end

function LbPhonePure.point(v)
  local kind = type(v)
  if kind ~= 'table' and kind ~= 'userdata' and kind ~= 'vector3' and kind ~= 'vector2' and kind ~= 'vector4' then return nil end
  local ok, x, y = pcall(function() return v.x, v.y end)
  if not ok or type(x) ~= 'number' or type(y) ~= 'number' then
    if kind ~= 'table' then return nil end
    x, y = v[1], v[2]
  end
  if type(x) ~= 'number' or type(y) ~= 'number' then return nil end
  return Pure.position({ x = x, y = y })
end

LbPhonePure.INPUT_MAX = 2000
LbPhonePure.TAG_REACH = 500.0

function LbPhonePure.sharedLocation(value)
  if type(value) ~= 'string' then return value, nil end
  if #value > LbPhonePure.INPUT_MAX then value = value:sub(1, LbPhonePure.INPUT_MAX) end
  local at
  local rest = value:gsub('<!SENT%-LOCATION%-([^!]*)!>', function(inner)
    if not at then
      local x, y = inner:match('^X=([%d%.%-eE+]+)Y=([%d%.%-eE+]+)$')
      at = Pure.position({ x = tonumber(x), y = tonumber(y) })
    end
    return ' '
  end)
  rest = rest:gsub('<![^>]*$', '')
  return rest, at
end

function LbPhonePure.placeFor(read, tagged)
  if not read or not tagged then return read or tagged end
  local dx, dy = tagged.x - read.x, tagged.y - read.y
  if dx * dx + dy * dy <= LbPhonePure.TAG_REACH * LbPhonePure.TAG_REACH then return tagged end
  return read
end

local ICONS = { attached = 'warning', panic = 'danger' }

function LbPhonePure.officerNotice(kind, payload, labels)
  local icon = ICONS[kind]
  if not icon or type(payload) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local content
  if kind == 'panic' then
    content = Pure.joinParts(' · ', payload.callNumber, payload.postal)
  else
    content = Pure.joinParts(' · ', payload.number, payload.nature, payload.postal)
  end
  if content == '' then content = labels[kind] end
  return { title = labels[kind], content = content, icon = icon }
end

function LbPhonePure.newBook(max)
  return { max = max, order = {}, entries = {} }
end

function LbPhonePure.remember(book, number, entry)
  if book.entries[number] == nil then book.order[#book.order + 1] = number end
  book.entries[number] = entry
  while #book.order > book.max do
    local oldest = table.remove(book.order, 1)
    book.entries[oldest] = nil
  end
end

function LbPhonePure.recall(book, number)
  return number and book.entries[number] or nil
end

function LbPhonePure.forget(book, number)
  if book.entries[number] == nil then return end
  book.entries[number] = nil
  for i = 1, #book.order do
    if book.order[i] == number then
      table.remove(book.order, i)
      return
    end
  end
end

return LbPhonePure
