LbPhone = {}

local cfg = Config.lbPhone
local P = LbPhonePure
local BOOK_MAX = 256
local NOTE_MAX = 500
local TEXT_MAX = 900
local REPLY_MAX = 300
local PENDING_WAIT_MS = 250
local PENDING_TRIES = 40
local book = P.newBook(BOOK_MAX)
local notes, pending, synced, warned = {}, {}, {}, {}

local function clock()
  return GetGameTimer() / 1000
end

local function ready()
  return Modules.active.lbphone == true and GetResourceState(cfg.resource) == 'started'
end

local function warnOnce(key, line)
  if warned[key] then return end
  warned[key] = true
  print(line)
end

function LbPhone.call(name, ...)
  local res = exports[cfg.resource]
  local ok, result = pcall(function(...) return res[name](res, ...) end, ...)
  if ok then return true, result end
  warnOnce('export:' .. name, '^3' .. L('lbphone_export_failed', name, tostring(result)) .. '^7')
  return false
end

function LbPhone.tell(phone, body)
  if type(phone) ~= 'string' or type(body) ~= 'string' or body == '' or not ready() then return nil end
  local ok, sent = LbPhone.call('SendMessage', cfg.dispatchNumber, phone, body)
  if ok and sent ~= nil then
    warnOnce('path:message', '[statewide] LB Phone reply sent as a message from ' .. tostring(cfg.dispatchNumber))
    return 'message'
  end
  ok = LbPhone.call('SendNotification', phone, { app = 'Messages', title = L('lbphone_title'), content = body })
  if not ok then return nil end
  warnOnce('path:notification', '[statewide] LB Phone reply sent as a notification')
  return 'notification'
end

local function textLimit()
  return math.min(tonumber(cfg.maxTextLength) or NOTE_MAX, TEXT_MAX)
end

local ANONYMOUS_SECONDS = 30
local newCall
local anonymousAt = {}

local function placeAt(src, coords, shared)
  local p = src and State.peek(src)
  local labels = not shared and p and p.labels or nil
  if not labels and src and coords then labels = Locations.labelsAt(src, coords) end
  local postal = Pure.preferPostal(coords and Locations.serverPostal(coords), labels)
  local street = type(labels) == 'table' and Pure.locationText(labels) or nil
  return P.location(labels, postal, L('lbphone_unknown_location')), postal, labels, street
end

local function placed(call)
  if type(call) ~= 'table' or type(call.location) ~= 'string' or call.location == '' then return nil end
  local postal = type(call.postal) == 'string' and call.postal ~= '' and call.postal or nil
  if not postal or call.location == P.location(nil, postal) then return call.location end
  return L('lbphone_place', call.location, postal)
end

local function moveCall(number, src, coords)
  local location, postal, _, street = placeAt(src, coords, true)
  local at = Pure.position(coords)
  local named = (street or postal) and Pure.clean(location, 120) or nil
  if not named and not at then return nil end
  local params = { number = number }
  local res = api('PATCH', '/calls/{number}', 'calls', { params = params, body = { location = named, postal = postal, x = at and at.x, y = at and at.y }, retry = false })
  if res.problem and res.problem.code == 'validation_failed' and named and (postal or at) then
    postal = nil
    res = api('PATCH', '/calls/{number}', 'calls', { params = params, body = { location = named }, retry = false })
  end
  if res.status ~= 200 then return named end
  return placed(type(res.data) == 'table' and res.data.call) or (street and postal and L('lbphone_place', street, postal)) or named
end

local function addNote(number, key, sender, src, company, msg)
  Callers.touch(key)
  local text = P.text(msg.text, math.min(textLimit(), NOTE_MAX))
  if not text and not msg.shared then return end
  local entry = notes[number] or {}
  notes[number] = entry
  local gate = P.noteGate(entry, clock(), tonumber(cfg.noteCooldownSeconds) or 10, tonumber(cfg.maxCallerNotes) or 20)
  if gate == 'capped' then return LbPhone.tell(sender, L('lbphone_notes_capped', number)) end
  if gate ~= 'ok' then return end
  if msg.shared then
    local place = moveCall(number, src, msg.coords)
    text = text or (place and L('lbphone_shared_note', place)) or L('lbphone_shared')
  end
  local res = api('POST', '/calls/{number}/notes', 'calls', { params = { number = number }, body = { body = Pure.clean(text, NOTE_MAX), kind = 'caller' }, retry = false })
  if res.status == 201 then return end
  local code = res.problem and res.problem.code
  if code == 'limit_reached' then
    entry.count = math.huge
    if entry.told then return end
    entry.told = true
    return LbPhone.tell(sender, L('lbphone_notes_capped', number))
  end
  if code == 'call_closed' or code == 'not_found' then
    Callers.clear(key)
    notes[number] = nil
    return newCall(key, sender, src, company, msg)
  end
end

local function bodyFor(src, company, msg)
  local text = P.text(msg.text, textLimit()) or (msg.shared and L('lbphone_shared')) or nil
  local description = text and P.describe(company, text, textLimit())
  if not description then return nil end
  local location, postal, labels, street = placeAt(src, msg.coords, msg.shared)
  local body = Pure.call911Body({
    text = description, location = location, postal = postal, anonymous = msg.anonymous, coords = msg.coords,
    zoneCode = labels and labels.zone,
  })
  if not street and not postal and body.x then body.location = nil end
  return body, location, description
end

local function post911(body, account)
  local res = Commands.post911(body, account)
  if body.location or not (res.problem and res.problem.code == 'validation_failed') then return res end
  body.location = L('lbphone_unknown_location')
  return Commands.post911(body, account)
end

local function claimAnonymous(company)
  local held = anonymousAt[company]
  if not Pure.cooldown(held, clock(), ANONYMOUS_SECONDS) then return false, held end
  anonymousAt[company] = clock()
  return true, held
end

newCall = function(key, sender, src, company, msg)
  local account, held
  if msg.anonymous then
    local ok
    ok, held = claimAnonymous(company)
    if not ok then return end
  else
    account = Identity.getAccount(src)
    if not account then return LbPhone.tell(sender, L('lbphone_not_sent')) end
    if not Commands.cooldownReady(src, Pure.callBucket('911')) then return end
  end
  local body, location, description = bodyFor(src, company, msg)
  if not body then
    if msg.anonymous then anonymousAt[company] = held end
    return
  end
  body.clientRef = Pure.clientRef(account and account.discordId, os.time(), math.random(0, 0xffffff))
  if account then
    Pure.withPlayer(account, body)
    body.callerPhone = sender
  end
  if key then pending[key] = true end
  local ok, res = pcall(post911, body, account)
  if key then pending[key] = nil end
  local created = ok and res.status == 201 and type(res.data) == 'table' and type(res.data.number) == 'string'
  if msg.anonymous and not created then anonymousAt[company] = held end
  if not ok then error(res, 0) end
  if not created then
    if src and not Pure.retryable(res.status) then Notify.problem(src, res) end
    return LbPhone.tell(sender, L('lbphone_not_sent'))
  end
  local number = res.data.number
  if msg.anonymous then return Commands.after911(nil, res, location, description, '911', msg.coords) end
  Commands.cooldownStart(src, Pure.callBucket('911'))
  Callers.open(key, number)
  P.remember(book, number, { phone = sender, key = key })
  Commands.after911(src, res, location, description, '911', msg.coords)
end

local function settle(key)
  for _ = 1, PENDING_TRIES do
    if not pending[key] then return end
    Wait(PENDING_WAIT_MS)
  end
end

local function companyMessage(company, sender, msg)
  if msg.anonymous then return newCall(nil, nil, nil, company, msg) end
  local found, from = LbPhone.call('GetSourceFromNumber', sender)
  local src = found and tonumber(from) or nil
  if not src or src <= 0 then return end
  local key = Pure.callerKey(sender)
  settle(key)
  if pending[key] then return end
  local open = Callers.find(key)
  if open then return addNote(open, key, sender, src, company, msg) end
  newCall(key, sender, src, company, msg)
end

local function onCompanyMessage(message)
  if not Pure.isServerSource(source) or not ready() then return end
  if type(message) ~= 'table' or message.sentByEmployee ~= false then return end
  local company = P.company(cfg.companies, message.company)
  if not company then return end
  local anonymous = message.anonymous == true
  local sender = not anonymous and P.phone(message.sender) or nil
  if not anonymous and not Pure.callerKey(sender) then return end
  local rest, tagged = P.sharedLocation(message.message)
  if not P.text(rest, TEXT_MAX) and not tagged then return end
  local msg = { text = rest, coords = P.placeFor(P.point(message.coords), tagged), shared = tagged ~= nil, anonymous = anonymous }
  CreateThread(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(companyMessage, company, sender, msg)
    if not ok then print(('^1[statewide] LB Phone text: %s^7'):format(err)) end
  end)
end

local function callerOf(payload)
  local entry = P.recall(book, payload.number)
  if entry then return entry.phone end
  return P.phone(payload.callerPhone)
end

local function fromServer(fn)
  return function(payload)
    if not Pure.isServerSource(source) or not ready() or type(payload) ~= 'table' or type(payload.number) ~= 'string' then return end
    CreateThread(function()
      local ok, err = pcall(fn, payload)
      if not ok then print(('^1[statewide] LB Phone reply: %s^7'):format(err)) end
    end)
  end
end

local function opened(payload)
  LbPhone.tell(callerOf(payload), L('lbphone_opened', payload.number))
end

local function closed(payload)
  LbPhone.tell(callerOf(payload), L('lbphone_closed', payload.number))
  P.forget(book, payload.number)
  notes[payload.number] = nil
end

local function callerMessage(payload)
  LbPhone.tell(callerOf(payload), P.text(payload.body, REPLY_MAX))
end

local OFFICER_LABELS = { attached = L('lbphone_officer_attached'), panic = L('lbphone_officer_panic') }

local function officerSink(src, name, payload)
  if not ready() then return end
  local notice = P.officerNotice(name, payload, OFFICER_LABELS)
  if notice then LbPhone.call('EmergencyNotification', src, notice) end
end

local function syncPhone(src, phone)
  if cfg.syncPhoneNumber ~= true or not ready() then return end
  src = tonumber(src)
  if not src or src <= 0 then return end
  if phone == nil then
    local ok, equipped = LbPhone.call('GetEquippedPhoneNumber', src)
    phone = ok and equipped or nil
  end
  phone = P.phone(phone)
  local p = State.peek(src)
  local character = p and p.character
  if not phone or type(character) ~= 'table' or not character.id then return end
  local mark = character.id .. '|' .. phone
  if synced[src] == mark then return end
  local account = Identity.getAccount(src)
  if not account then return end
  synced[src] = mark
  local res = api('PUT', '/characters/active/phone', 'civilian', { body = Pure.withPlayer(account, { phone = phone }), as = account, retry = false })
  if res.status ~= 200 and synced[src] == mark then synced[src] = nil end
end

local function syncLater(src, phone)
  CreateThread(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(syncPhone, src, phone)
    if not ok then print(('^1[statewide] LB Phone number: %s^7'):format(err)) end
  end)
end

local function onNumber(player, number)
  if not Pure.isServerSource(source) then return end
  syncLater(player, number)
end

function LbPhone.register()
  AddEventHandler('lb-phone:newCompanyMessage', onCompanyMessage)
  AddEventHandler('lb-phone:numberChanged', onNumber)
  AddEventHandler('lb-phone:phoneNumberGenerated', onNumber)
  AddEventHandler('statewide:callOpened', fromServer(opened))
  AddEventHandler('statewide:callClosed', fromServer(closed))
  AddEventHandler('statewide:callerMessage', fromServer(callerMessage))
  Notify.addSink(officerSink)
  State.onCharacterChange(function(src, character)
    if character then syncLater(src) end
  end)
  AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if src then synced[src] = nil end
  end)
end

Modules.resolve('lbphone', LbPhone.register, L('lbphone_absent', cfg.resource))

-- SCRIPT//GO demo: InventoryKit, EventBus Kit and PermissionsKit running inside a LÖVE game.
-- The server side and the local client (player 1) run in this process; the screen draws the
-- client's inventory mirror, and the keys go through the same paths a real game would use.
--
--   love examples/love2d/demo                    play
--   lovec examples/love2d/demo --scriptgo-verify <resourceDir> --search sdk/packages --report out.json
local scriptgoLove = require("scriptgo_love")
if scriptgoLove.verify(arg) then return end

local SDK = scriptgoLove.normalize(love.filesystem.getSource() .. "/../../../sdk")
local PLAYER = 1
local ITEMS = { "water", "bread", "bandage", "rope", "scrap", "coin", "toolbox" }

local function rgb(hex) return { tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16) / 255, tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16) / 255, tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16) / 255 } end
local CREAM, INK, COBALT, YELLOW = rgb("F4EFE4"), rgb("111111"), rgb("1F3FD1"), rgb("FFD23F")

local sg
local fonts = {}
local view = { state = nil, roles = {}, refusal = nil, admin = false, poll = 0 }

function love.load()
    love.keyboard.setKeyRepeat(true)
    fonts.title = love.graphics.newFont(30)
    fonts.body = love.graphics.newFont(14)
    fonts.small = love.graphics.newFont(12)
    sg = scriptgoLove.new({
        resources = { "sg_inventory", "sg_eventbus", "sg_permissions" },
        search = { SDK .. "/packages" },
        player = { id = PLAYER, name = "Ada" },
        config = {
            resources = { sg_inventory = { slots = 12, maxWeight = 20 } },
        },
    })
end

local function refresh()
    view.state = sg:call("sg_inventory", "getState", "client") or view.state
    view.roles = sg:call("sg_permissions", "roles", "client") or {}
    view.refusal = sg:call("sg_inventory", "lastRefusal", "client")
    view.admin = false
    for _, r in ipairs(view.roles) do if r == "admin" then view.admin = true end end
end

function love.update(dt)
    sg:update(dt)
    view.poll = view.poll - dt
    if view.poll <= 0 then
        view.poll = 0.1
        refresh()
    end
end

function love.keypressed(key, scancode, isrepeat)
    if sg:keypressed(key, scancode, isrepeat) then return end
    if isrepeat then return end
    if key == "g" then
        -- The console may always give.
        sg:command(("giveitem %d %s %d"):format(PLAYER, ITEMS[love.math.random(#ITEMS)], love.math.random(1, 3)))
    elseif key == "t" then
        -- The same command typed by the player: PermissionsKit decides.
        sg:playerCommand(("/giveitem %d coin 5"):format(PLAYER))
    elseif key == "u" or key == "1" then
        sg:call("sg_inventory", "use", "client", 1)
    elseif key == "a" then
        sg:command(("perm %s %d admin"):format(view.admin and "revoke" or "grant", PLAYER))
    elseif key == "c" then
        sg:call("sg_inventory", "clear", "server", PLAYER)
    elseif key == "escape" then
        love.event.quit()
    end
    view.poll = 0
end

function love.textinput(text) sg:textinput(text) end

function love.quit() sg:shutdown() end

-- Drawing ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function setColor(c, a) love.graphics.setColor(c[1], c[2], c[3], a or 1) end

local function drawSlot(x, y, size, index, item)
    setColor(INK, item and 1 or 0.18)
    love.graphics.setLineWidth(item and 2 or 1)
    love.graphics.rectangle("line", x, y, size, size, 4, 4)
    if index == 1 then
        setColor(YELLOW)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill", x, y - 6, 34, 6)
    end
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.small)
    setColor(INK, 0.45)
    love.graphics.print(tostring(index), x + 7, y + 5)
    if not item then return end
    setColor(COBALT)
    love.graphics.circle("fill", x + size / 2, y + size / 2 - 6, 17)
    setColor(CREAM)
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.body)
    love.graphics.printf(item.label:sub(1, 1):upper(), x, y + size / 2 - 15, size, "center")
    setColor(INK)
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.small)
    love.graphics.printf(item.label, x + 4, y + size - 22, size - 8, "center")
    setColor(COBALT)
    love.graphics.printf("x" .. tostring(item.count), x, y + 5, size - 7, "right")
end

function love.draw()
    love.graphics.clear(CREAM[1], CREAM[2], CREAM[3])
    local state = view.state or { slots = 12, maxWeight = 20, weight = 0, items = {} }

    setColor(INK)
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.title)
    love.graphics.print("SCRIPT//GO", 40, 30)
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.body)
    setColor(INK, 0.65)
    love.graphics.print("InventoryKit, EventBus Kit and PermissionsKit, running inside LÖVE", 40, 70)

    -- Inventory grid: the client mirror the server pushes after every change.
    local bySlot = {}
    for _, it in ipairs(state.items or {}) do bySlot[it.slot] = it end
    local size, gap, cols = 88, 12, 4
    local slots = math.max(1, state.slots or 12)
    for i = 1, slots do
        local col, row = (i - 1) % cols, math.floor((i - 1) / cols)
        drawSlot(40 + col * (size + gap), 120 + row * (size + gap), size, i, bySlot[i])
    end

    -- Weight bar.
    local rows = math.ceil(slots / cols)
    local barY, barW = 120 + rows * (size + gap) + 8, cols * size + (cols - 1) * gap
    local ratio = (state.maxWeight or 0) > 0 and math.min(1, (state.weight or 0) / state.maxWeight) or 0
    setColor(INK, 0.12)
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill", 40, barY, barW, 10, 3, 3)
    setColor(ratio > 0.8 and YELLOW or COBALT)
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill", 40, barY, barW * ratio, 10, 3, 3)
    setColor(INK)
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.small)
    love.graphics.print(("%.1f / %.1f kg"):format(state.weight or 0, state.maxWeight or 0), 40, barY + 16)

    -- Keys and session.
    local x, y = 470, 120
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.body)
    setColor(INK)
    love.graphics.print("Keys", x, y)
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.small)
    local keys = {
        { "G", "give an item (console)" }, { "T", "/giveitem as the player" }, { "U", "use slot 1" },
        { "A", view.admin and "revoke admin" or "grant admin" }, { "C", "clear" }, { "`", "console" },
    }
    for i, k in ipairs(keys) do
        local ky = y + 6 + i * 22
        setColor(COBALT)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill", x, ky, 20, 18, 3, 3)
        setColor(CREAM)
        love.graphics.printf(k[1], x, ky + 2, 20, "center")
        setColor(INK, 0.8)
        love.graphics.print(k[2], x + 28, ky + 2)
    end
    y = y + 180
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.body)
    setColor(INK)
    love.graphics.print("Session", x, y)
    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.small)
    setColor(INK, 0.8)
    love.graphics.print("player " .. PLAYER .. " · roles: " .. (#view.roles > 0 and table.concat(view.roles, ", ") or "—"), x, y + 28)
    if view.refusal then
        love.graphics.print("last refusal: " .. tostring(view.refusal.action) .. " " .. tostring(view.refusal.reason), x, y + 48)
    end
    for i, name in ipairs({ "sg_eventbus", "sg_inventory", "sg_permissions" }) do
        local s = sg.host:resourceState(name)
        setColor(s == "started" and COBALT or YELLOW)
        love.graphics.circle("fill", x + 5, y + 78 + i * 18, 4)
        setColor(INK, 0.8)
        love.graphics.print(name .. " " .. s, x + 16, y + 70 + i * 18)
    end

    love.graphics.setFont(fonts.body)
    sg:draw()
end

MrpdMap = {}

MrpdMap.TRUE_CAPS = { 'dispatch', 'dispatchFeed', 'bolos', 'weapons', 'flagPlates', 'licenses', 'criminalRecords' }
MrpdMap.WRITES = { 'respond_dispatch' }
MrpdMap.SEARCH_MAX = 100

local function str(v)
  if type(v) == 'string' and v ~= '' then return v end
  if type(v) == 'number' then return tostring(v) end
  return nil
end

local function list(v)
  return type(v) == 'table' and v or {}
end

local function has(t, value)
  for _, v in ipairs(list(t)) do
    if v == value then return true end
  end
  return false
end

local function fullName(p)
  if type(p) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local first, last = str(p.firstName), str(p.lastName)
  if first and last then return first .. ' ' .. last end
  return first or last
end

function MrpdMap.isSsn(v)
  local s = str(v)
  if not s then return false end
  s = s:gsub('[%s%-]', '')
  return s:match('^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') ~= nil
end

local function digits(v)
  return (str(v) or ''):gsub('[%s%-]', '')
end

function MrpdMap.clean(v, max)
  local s = str(v)
  if not s then return nil end
  s = s:gsub('[%c]', ' '):gsub('%s+', ' '):gsub('^ ', ''):gsub(' $', '')
  if s == '' then return nil end
  return s:sub(1, max or MrpdMap.SEARCH_MAX)
end

function MrpdMap.parseSearch(query)
  local q = MrpdMap.clean(query)
  if not q then return nil end
  if MrpdMap.isSsn(q) then return { ssn = digits(q) } end
  local first, rest = q:match('^(%S+)%s+(.+)$')
  if first then return { first = first, last = rest } end
  return { last = q }
end

function MrpdMap.citizenCid(person)
  if type(person) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  return str(person.externalId) or str(person.ssn)
end

local function toLicenses(v)
  local out = {}
  for _, l in ipairs(list(v)) do
    if type(l) == 'table' then out[#out + 1] = { code = str(l.code), name = str(l.name), status = str(l.status) } end
  end
  return out
end

local function toWarrants(v)
  local out = {}
  for _, w in ipairs(list(v)) do
    if type(w) == 'table' then out[#out + 1] = { number = str(w.number), kind = str(w.kind), status = str(w.status) } end
  end
  return out
end

local function toVehicles(v)
  local out = {}
  for _, x in ipairs(list(v)) do
    if type(x) == 'table' then out[#out + 1] = { plate = str(x.plate), model = MrpdMap.model(x), color = str(x.color) } end
  end
  return out
end

function MrpdMap.model(v)
  if type(v) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local make, model = str(v.make), str(v.model)
  if make and model then return make .. ' ' .. model end
  return make or model
end

function MrpdMap.toProfile(result)
  if type(result) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local p = result.person
  if type(p) ~= 'table' then p = result end
  local cid = MrpdMap.citizenCid(p)
  if not cid then return nil end
  return {
    cid = cid,
    ssn = str(p.ssn),
    firstname = str(p.firstName),
    lastname = str(p.lastName),
    name = fullName(p),
    dob = str(p.dob),
    status = str(p.status),
    flags = list(p.flags),
    cautions = list(result.cautions),
    hits = list(result.hits),
    licenses = toLicenses(result.licenses),
    warrants = toWarrants(result.warrants),
    vehicles = toVehicles(result.vehicles),
  }
end

function MrpdMap.vehicleFlag(ret)
  if type(ret) ~= 'table' then return false, nil end
  for _, b in ipairs(list(ret.bolos)) do
    if type(b) == 'table' then return true, str(b.description) or 'BOLO' end
  end
  local v = ret.vehicle
  if type(v) == 'table' and has(v.flags, 'stolen') then return true, 'STOLEN' end
  return false, nil
end

function MrpdMap.toPlate(ret)
  if type(ret) ~= 'table' or type(ret.vehicle) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local v = ret.vehicle
  local owner = type(ret.owner) == 'table' and ret.owner or {}
  local person = type(owner.person) == 'table' and owner.person or nil
  local business = type(owner.business) == 'table' and owner.business or nil
  local flagged, reason = MrpdMap.vehicleFlag(ret)
  return {
    plate = str(v.plate),
    vin = str(v.vin),
    model = MrpdMap.model(v),
    color = str(v.color),
    registration = str(v.registration),
    insurance = str(v.insurance),
    owner = fullName(person) or (business and str(business.name)) or nil,
    ownerCid = MrpdMap.citizenCid(person),
    isFlagged = flagged,
    flagReason = reason,
  }
end

function MrpdMap.toWeapon(res)
  if type(res) ~= 'table' or type(res.firearm) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local f = res.firearm
  local owner = type(res.owner) == 'table' and res.owner or nil
  return {
    serial = str(f.serial),
    model = MrpdMap.model(f),
    type = str(f.type),
    status = str(f.status),
    isStolen = f.status == 'stolen',
    owner = fullName(owner),
    ownerCid = MrpdMap.citizenCid(owner),
  }
end

function MrpdMap.toBolo(b)
  if type(b) ~= 'table' or not str(b.id) then return nil end
  return {
    id = str(b.id),
    kind = str(b.kind),
    subject = str(b.subject),
    plate = str(b.plate),
    vehicle = str(b.vehicle),
    description = str(b.description),
    callNumber = str(b.callNumber),
    createdAt = str(b.createdAt),
    expiresAt = str(b.expiresAt),
  }
end

function MrpdMap.toBolos(bolos)
  local out = {}
  for _, b in ipairs(list(bolos)) do
    local m = MrpdMap.toBolo(b)
    if m then out[#out + 1] = m end
  end
  return out
end

function MrpdMap.flaggedPlates(bolos)
  local out, seen = {}, {}
  for _, b in ipairs(list(bolos)) do
    local plate = type(b) == 'table' and b.kind == 'vehicle' and str(b.plate)
    if plate and not seen[plate] then
      seen[plate] = true
      out[#out + 1] = { plate = plate, reason = str(b.description) or 'BOLO' }
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function where(location, postal)
  local l, p = str(location), str(postal)
  if l and p then return l .. ' (' .. p .. ')' end
  return l or p or ''
end

function MrpdMap.toDispatch(call)
  if type(call) ~= 'table' or not str(call.number) then return nil end
  return {
    id = str(call.number),
    number = str(call.number),
    title = str(call.nature) or str(call.number),
    priority = tonumber(call.priority),
    status = str(call.status),
    location = where(call.location, call.postal),
    description = str(call.description),
    createdAt = str(call.createdAt),
  }
end

function MrpdMap.toDispatches(calls)
  local out = {}
  for _, c in ipairs(list(calls)) do
    local m = MrpdMap.toDispatch(c)
    if m then out[#out + 1] = m end
  end
  return out
end

function MrpdMap.officerCid(unit, ctxCid)
  local cid = str(ctxCid)
  if cid then return cid end
  local d = type(unit) == 'table' and str(unit.discordId)
  return d and ('discord:' .. d) or nil
end

function MrpdMap.toOfficer(unit, ctxCid)
  if type(unit) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local dept = type(unit.department) == 'table' and unit.department or {}
  local status = type(unit.status) == 'table' and unit.status or {}
  return {
    cid = MrpdMap.officerCid(unit, ctxCid),
    name = str(unit.name),
    callsign = str(unit.callsign),
    department = str(dept.abbreviation),
    status = str(status.label) or str(status.code),
    onDuty = true,
  }
end

function MrpdMap.dispatchPush(kind, payload)
  if type(payload) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  local title
  if kind == 'panic' then
    title = 'PANIC ' .. (str(payload.callsign) or '')
  else
    local number = str(payload.number)
    if not number then return nil end
    title = number .. ' ' .. (str(payload.nature) or (kind == '911' and '911' or 'Call'))
  end
  title = title:gsub('%s+$', '')
  return { title = title, location = where(payload.location, payload.postal) }
end

function MrpdMap.memo(store, key, ttl, now, fetch)
  local e = store[key]
  if e and now - e.at < ttl then return e.value end
  local value = fetch()
  if value ~= nil then store[key] = { at = now, value = value } end
  return value
end

function MrpdMap.enabled(setting, resourceState)
  if setting == false or setting == 'off' then return false end
  if setting == true or setting == 'on' then return true end
  return resourceState == 'started' or resourceState == 'starting'
end

local function falsify(t, depth)
  local out = {}
  for k, v in pairs(t) do
    if type(v) == 'table' and depth < 4 then
      out[k] = falsify(v, depth + 1)
    elseif type(v) == 'boolean' then
      out[k] = false
    elseif type(v) ~= 'function' then
      out[k] = v
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function setTrue(t, key, depth)
  local found = false
  for k, v in pairs(t) do
    if k == key and type(v) ~= 'table' then
      t[k] = true
      found = true
    elseif type(v) == 'table' and depth < 4 and setTrue(v, key, depth + 1) then
      found = true
    end
  end
  return found
end

function MrpdMap.capabilities(defaults, writesOn)
  local caps = type(defaults) == 'table' and falsify(defaults, 1) or {}
  for _, key in ipairs(MrpdMap.TRUE_CAPS) do
    if not setTrue(caps, key, 1) then caps[key] = true end
  end
  if type(caps.writes) ~= 'table' then caps.writes = {} end
  for _, key in ipairs(MrpdMap.WRITES) do caps.writes[key] = writesOn ~= false end
  return caps
end

function MrpdMap.featureAllowed(key, writesOn)
  if type(key) ~= 'string' then return false end
  if key == 'respond_dispatch' then return writesOn ~= false end
  for _, k in ipairs(MrpdMap.TRUE_CAPS) do
    if k == key then return true end
  end
  return false
end

function MrpdMap.allow(store, key, limit, now, window)
  window = window or 60
  local e = store[key]
  if not e or now - e.at >= window then
    e = { at = now, n = 0 }
    store[key] = e
  end
  if e.n >= limit then return false end
  e.n = e.n + 1
  return true
end

function MrpdMap.callNumberIn(isCallNumber, ...)
  for i = 1, select('#', ...) do
    local v = select(i, ...)
    if type(v) == 'table' then v = v.number or v.id end
    if isCallNumber(v) then return v end
  end
  return nil
end

return MrpdMap

Mrpd = {}

local M = MrpdMap
local cfg = Config.mrpd or {}
local STALE_MS = 300000
local LOG_SECONDS = 60
local TTL = { units = 15, bolos = 30, calls = 10 }
local KINDS = { hasTerminalAccess = 'gate', hasFeature = 'gate', respondDispatch = 'write' }
local memos = { units = {}, bolos = {}, calls = {} }
local logged = {}
local windows = {}
local registered = false

local function clock()
  return GetGameTimer() / 1000
end

function Mrpd.resource()
  return type(cfg.resource) == 'string' and cfg.resource or 'prompt_mrpd_terminal'
end

function Mrpd.enabled()
  return cfg.enabled == true and M.enabled((Config.modules or {}).mrpd, GetResourceState(Mrpd.resource()))
end

function Mrpd.clear()
  memos.units, memos.bolos, memos.calls = {}, {}, {}
end

local function officer(src)
  src = tonumber(src)
  if not src then return nil end
  local p = State.peek(src)
  if type(p) ~= 'table' or type(p.discordId) ~= 'string' or type(p.account) ~= 'table' then return nil end
  if p.account.discordId ~= p.discordId then return nil end
  if type(p.checkedAt) ~= 'number' or GetGameTimer() - p.checkedAt > STALE_MS then return nil end
  local u = p.unit
  if type(u) ~= 'table' or type(u.department) ~= 'table' or u.department.type ~= 'LEO' then return nil end
  if u.canLookup ~= true then return nil end
  return p, src
end

local function acting(ctx)
  return officer(ctx.actingSrc)
end

local function allowed(src)
  return M.allow(windows, src, tonumber(cfg.lookupsPerMinute) or 20, clock())
end

local function ok(res)
  return type(res) == 'table' and res.status == 200 and type(res.data) == 'table'
end

local function people(p, query)
  query.discordId = p.discordId
  query.partial = query.ssn and 'false' or 'true'
  local res = api('GET', '/lookup/person', 'lookup', { query = query, as = p.account, retry = false })
  if not ok(res) then return nil end
  local out = {}
  for _, r in ipairs(type(res.data.results) == 'table' and res.data.results or {}) do
    local m = M.toProfile(r)
    if m then out[#out + 1] = m end
  end
  return out
end

local function firearms(p, serial)
  local res = api('GET', '/lookup/firearm', 'lookup', { query = { discordId = p.discordId, serial = serial }, as = p.account, retry = false })
  if not ok(res) then return nil end
  local out = {}
  for _, r in ipairs(type(res.data.results) == 'table' and res.data.results or {}) do
    local m = M.toWeapon(r)
    if m then out[#out + 1] = m end
  end
  return out
end

local function bolos()
  return M.memo(memos.bolos, 'active', TTL.bolos, clock(), function()
    local res = api('GET', '/bolos', 'lookup', { query = { active = 'true' }, retry = false })
    return ok(res) and type(res.data.bolos) == 'table' and res.data.bolos or nil
  end)
end

local function units()
  return M.memo(memos.units, 'LEO', TTL.units, clock(), function()
    local res = api('GET', '/units', 'units', { query = { type = 'LEO' }, retry = false })
    return ok(res) and type(res.data.units) == 'table' and res.data.units or nil
  end)
end

local function onDuty(ctx)
  local _, src = acting(ctx)
  if not src then return {} end
  local viewer, mode = State.viewer(src), State.isolation()
  local out = {}
  for _, u in ipairs(units() or {}) do
    if type(u) == 'table' and not Pure.isMasked(Pure.unitRef(u), viewer, mode) then
      local m = M.toOfficer(u, nil)
      if m then out[#out + 1] = m end
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function plateOf(v)
  local s = M.clean(v, 16)
  return s and s:upper() or nil
end

local handlers = {}

function handlers.hasTerminalAccess(_, src)
  return officer(src) ~= nil
end

function handlers.hasFeature(_, src, key)
  return officer(src) ~= nil and M.featureAllowed(key, true)
end

function handlers.getOfficerInfo(ctx, src)
  local p = officer(src)
  if not p then return nil end
  return M.toOfficer(p.unit, ctx.cid)
end

handlers.getOnDutyOfficers = onDuty
handlers.getRoster = onDuty

function handlers.searchCitizens(ctx, query)
  local p, src = acting(ctx)
  local q = M.parseSearch(query)
  if not p or not q or not allowed(src) then return {} end
  return people(p, q) or {}
end

function handlers.getCitizenByCid(ctx, cid)
  local p, src = acting(ctx)
  if not p then return nil end
  local ssn
  if M.isSsn(cid) then
    ssn = tostring(cid):gsub('[%s%-]', '')
  elseif ctx.cidSource then
    local other = State.peek(ctx.cidSource)
    local c = type(other) == 'table' and other.character
    if type(c) == 'table' and M.isSsn(c.ssn) then ssn = c.ssn end
  end
  if not ssn or not allowed(src) then return nil end
  local list = people(p, { ssn = ssn })
  return list and list[1] or nil
end

function handlers.lookupPlate(ctx, plate)
  local p, src = acting(ctx)
  local key = plateOf(plate)
  if not p or not key or not allowed(src) then return nil end
  local res = api('GET', '/lookup/vehicle', 'lookup', { query = { discordId = p.discordId, plate = key, partial = 'false' }, as = p.account, retry = false })
  if not ok(res) then return nil end
  local first = type(res.data.results) == 'table' and res.data.results[1]
  return first and M.toPlate(first) or nil
end

function handlers.getFlaggedPlates(ctx)
  if not acting(ctx) then return {} end
  return M.flaggedPlates(bolos())
end

function handlers.searchWeapons(ctx, query)
  local p, src = acting(ctx)
  local serial = M.clean(query)
  if not p or not serial or not allowed(src) then return {} end
  return firearms(p, serial) or {}
end

function handlers.getWeapon(ctx, serial)
  local p, src = acting(ctx)
  serial = M.clean(serial)
  if not p or not serial or not allowed(src) then return nil end
  local list = firearms(p, serial)
  return list and list[1] or nil
end

function handlers.getBolos(ctx)
  if not acting(ctx) then return {} end
  return M.toBolos(bolos())
end

function handlers.getDispatches(ctx)
  local p = acting(ctx)
  if not p then return {} end
  local calls = M.memo(memos.calls, p.discordId, TTL.calls, clock(), function()
    local res = api('GET', '/calls', 'calls', { query = { discordId = p.discordId }, as = p.account, retry = false })
    return ok(res) and type(res.data.calls) == 'table' and res.data.calls or nil
  end)
  return M.toDispatches(calls)
end

function handlers.respondDispatch(ctx, ...)
  local p, src = acting(ctx)
  if not p then return false, 'denied' end
  local number = M.callNumberIn(Pure.isCallNumber, ...)
  if not number then return false, 'invalid' end
  if not allowed(src) then return false, 'rate_limited' end
  local res = api('POST', '/calls/{number}/units', 'calls', { params = { number = number }, body = Pure.withPlayer(p.account, {}), as = p.account, retry = false })
  if type(res) == 'table' and res.status == 200 then
    memos.calls = {}
    return true
  end
  local problem = type(res) == 'table' and res.problem or nil
  return false, problem and problem.code or 'failed'
end

function handlers.getVehicleStats()
  return {}
end

function handlers.getFleetData()
  return { ok = false }
end

local function failed(method, err)
  local now = clock()
  local at = logged[method]
  if at and now - at < LOG_SECONDS then return end
  logged[method] = now
  print(('^1[statewide] MRPD %s: %s^7'):format(method, tostring(err)))
end

local function context(ctx)
  local out = {}
  if type(ctx) ~= 'table' then return out end
  out.actingSrc = tonumber(ctx.actingSrc)
  out.cidSource = tonumber(ctx.cidSource)
  out.cid = M.clean(ctx.cid, 64)
  return out
end

function Mrpd.call(method, ctx, ...)
  local handler = type(method) == 'string' and handlers[method] or nil
  if not handler then return nil end
  local res = table.pack(pcall(handler, context(ctx), ...))
  if res[1] then return table.unpack(res, 2, res.n) end
  failed(method, res[2])
  local kind = KINDS[method]
  if kind == 'gate' then return false end
  if kind == 'write' then return false, 'error' end
  return nil
end

function Mrpd.meta(defaults)
  local on = Mrpd.enabled()
  return { enabled = on, capabilities = on and M.capabilities(defaults, true) or nil }
end

exports('mrpd_meta', function(defaults)
  local caller = GetInvokingResource()
  if not caller or caller ~= Mrpd.resource() then return nil end
  return Mrpd.meta(defaults)
end)

exports('mrpd_call', function(method, ctx, ...)
  local caller = GetInvokingResource()
  if not caller or caller ~= Mrpd.resource() or not Mrpd.enabled() then return nil end
  return Mrpd.call(method, ctx, ...)
end)

local function fromServer(kind)
  return function(payload)
    local src = source
    if src ~= nil and src ~= '' and tonumber(src) ~= 0 then return end
    if not Mrpd.enabled() then return end
    memos.calls = {}
    local push = M.dispatchPush(kind, payload)
    if push then TriggerEvent('mrpd_terminal:dispatchReceived', push) end
  end
end

local function register()
  if registered then return end
  registered = true
  AddEventHandler('statewide:911', fromServer('911'))
  AddEventHandler('statewide:panic', fromServer('panic'))
  AddEventHandler('statewide:attached', fromServer('attached'))
  AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    windows[tonumber(source)] = nil
  end)
  AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(name)
    if name == Mrpd.resource() then Mrpd.clear() end
  end)
end

if cfg.enabled == true and (Config.modules or {}).mrpd ~= false then
  AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(name)
    if name == Mrpd.resource() and Mrpd.enabled() then register() end
  end)
  if Mrpd.enabled() then register() end
end

local STATEWIDE = 'statewide'

if not IsDuplicityVersion() then return end

local officers = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })

local function defaults()
  if type(DefaultCapabilities) == 'function' then
    local ok, res = pcall(DefaultCapabilities)
    return ok and res or nil
  end
  return DefaultCapabilities
end

local function closed(t)
  local out = {}
  for k, v in pairs(type(t) == 'table' and t or {}) do
    if type(v) == 'table' then
      out[k] = closed(v)
    elseif type(v) == 'boolean' then
      out[k] = false
    else
      out[k] = v
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function meta()
  if GetResourceState(STATEWIDE) ~= 'started' then return nil end
  local ok, res = pcall(function() return exports[STATEWIDE]:mrpd_meta(defaults()) end)
  if ok and type(res) == 'table' then return res end
  return nil
end

local function call(method, ctx, ...)
  local args = table.pack(...)
  return pcall(function() return exports[STATEWIDE]:mrpd_call(method, ctx, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)) end)
end

local function framework(name, ...)
  local f = rawget(_G, 'Framework')
  if type(f) ~= 'table' or type(f[name]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
  local ok, res = pcall(f[name], ...)
  if ok then return res end
  return nil
end

local function acting()
  return { actingSrc = officers[coroutine.running()] }
end

local function gate(method)
  return function(src, ...)
    officers[coroutine.running()] = src
    local ok, res = call(method, {}, src, ...)
    return ok and res == true
  end
end

local function read(method)
  return function(...)
    local ok, res = call(method, acting(), ...)
    if ok then return res end
    return nil
  end
end

local function write(method)
  return function(...)
    local ok, res, reason = call(method, acting(), ...)
    if not ok then return false, 'unavailable' end
    if res == true then return true end
    return false, reason or 'failed'
  end
end

local info = meta()

local Adapter = {
  id = 'statewide',
  label = 'Statewide CAD',
  priority = 50,
  capabilities = info and info.enabled == true and type(info.capabilities) == 'table' and info.capabilities or closed(defaults()),
}

function Adapter.detect()
  local m = meta()
  return m ~= nil and m.enabled == true
end

Adapter.hasTerminalAccess = gate('hasTerminalAccess')
Adapter.hasFeature = gate('hasFeature')

function Adapter.getOfficerInfo(src, ...)
  local ctx = acting()
  ctx.cid = framework('resolveIdentifier', src)
  local ok, res = call('getOfficerInfo', ctx, src, ...)
  if ok then return res end
  return nil
end

function Adapter.getCitizenByCid(cid, ...)
  local ctx = acting()
  ctx.cidSource = framework('identifierToSource', cid)
  local ok, res = call('getCitizenByCid', ctx, cid, ...)
  if ok then return res end
  return nil
end

Adapter.getOnDutyOfficers = read('getOnDutyOfficers')
Adapter.getRoster = read('getRoster')
Adapter.searchCitizens = read('searchCitizens')
Adapter.lookupPlate = read('lookupPlate')
Adapter.getFlaggedPlates = read('getFlaggedPlates')
Adapter.searchWeapons = read('searchWeapons')
Adapter.getWeapon = read('getWeapon')
Adapter.getBolos = read('getBolos')
Adapter.getDispatches = read('getDispatches')
Adapter.getVehicleStats = read('getVehicleStats')
Adapter.getFleetData = read('getFleetData')
Adapter.respondDispatch = write('respondDispatch')

RegisterPoliceAdapter(Adapter)

local HEAD_BONE = 31086
local RELEASE_MS = 25000
local shot

local function release(token)
  if not shot or (token and shot.token ~= token) then return end
  local s = shot
  shot = nil
  RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, true)
  SetCamActive(s.cam, false)
  DestroyCam(s.cam, false)
  if not s.hudHidden then DisplayHud(true) end
  if not s.radarHidden then DisplayRadar(true) end
end

local function pedOf(target)
  if target == GetPlayerServerId(PlayerId()) then return PlayerPedId() end
  local player = GetPlayerFromServerId(target)
  if player == -1 or not NetworkIsPlayerActive(player) then return nil end
  local ped = GetPlayerPed(player)
  if ped == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return nil end
  return ped
end

local function stage(ped)
  local head = GetPedBoneCoords(ped, HEAD_BONE, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
  local forward = GetEntityForwardVector(ped)
  local cam = CreateCamWithParams('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', head.x + forward.x * 1.1, head.y + forward.y * 1.1, head.z + 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 32.0, false, 2)
  PointCamAtCoord(cam, head.x, head.y, head.z - 0.12)
  SetCamActive(cam, true)
  RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, true)
  return cam
end

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:mugshot', function(p)
  if type(p) ~= 'table' or type(p.token) ~= 'string' or type(p.target) ~= 'number' then return end
  release()
  local ped = pedOf(p.target)
  if not ped then return TriggerServerEvent('statewide:mugshot', { token = p.token, ready = false }) end
  shot = { token = p.token, hudHidden = IsHudHidden(), radarHidden = IsRadarHidden() }
  shot.cam = stage(ped)
  DisplayHud(false)
  DisplayRadar(false)
  Wait(250)
  TriggerServerEvent('statewide:mugshot', { token = p.token, ready = true })
  local mine = shot
  SetTimeout(RELEASE_MS, function()
    if shot == mine then release() end
  end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:mugshotDone', function(token)
  if type(token) ~= 'string' then return end
  release(token)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('mugshot', function(data, cb)
  cb({})
  local ssn = type(data) == 'table' and data.ssn
  if type(ssn) ~= 'string' or not ssn:match('^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then return end
  ExecuteCommand(('%s %s'):format(Config.commands.mugshot.name, ssn))
end)

-- License gate for Inventory Pro. Defines the global `InvProLicense`.
--
-- On start, and every six hours, the server verifies its license key with the SCRIPT//GO API
-- (ScriptGo.licensing.verify). A valid answer is cached with its offline grace deadline, so a
-- network outage does not switch a paying server off until that deadline passes.
--
-- Honest limits: the server owner controls this machine, so a determined owner can patch any
-- client-side check. The gate exists to make the paid path the easy one and to give creators an
-- activation record, not to be unbreakable DRM.
InvProLicense = { state = "checking", reason = nil, checkedAt = nil, graceUntil = nil }

local PACKAGE = "kestrel//inventory-pro"
local RECHECK_MS = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000

-- "2026-12-01T10:00:00Z" (or with milliseconds) -> Unix seconds, UTC, without os.time's local-time trap.
local function isoToEpoch(s)
    if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local y, mo, d, h, mi, se = s:match("^(%d%d%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d)T(%d%d):(%d%d):(%d%d)")
    if not y then return nil end
    y, mo, d = tonumber(y), tonumber(mo), tonumber(d)
    -- Days from civil (Howard Hinnant).
    if mo <= 2 then y = y - 1 end
    local era = math.floor(y / 400)
    local yoe = y - era * 400
    local mp = (mo + 9) % 12
    local doy = math.floor((153 * mp + 2) / 5) + d - 1
    local doe = yoe * 365 + math.floor(yoe / 4) - math.floor(yoe / 100) + doy
    local days = era * 146097 + doe - 719468
    return days * 86400 + tonumber(h) * 3600 + tonumber(mi) * 60 + tonumber(se)
end
InvProLicense.isoToEpoch = isoToEpoch

local function setState(state, reason)
    local changed = InvProLicense.state ~= state
    InvProLicense.state, InvProLicense.reason = state, reason
    if changed then
        local msg = ("license %s%s"):format(state, reason and (" (" .. reason .. ")") or "")
        if state == "active" or state == "grace" then ScriptGo.log.info(msg) else ScriptGo.log.error(msg) end
        TriggerEvent("inventory_pro:license", state, reason)
    end
end

function InvProLicense.active()
    return InvProLicense.state == "active" or InvProLicense.state == "grace"
end

local function licenseKey()
    if not ScriptGo.capabilities.has("config") then return nil end
    local key = ScriptGo.config.get("license_key")
    if type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then return nil end
    return key
end

-- Runs from a thread: performs one verification and updates the state.
function InvProLicense.check()
    local key = licenseKey()
    if not key then
        setState("invalid", "no_license_key")
        return
    end
    if not ScriptGo.capabilities.has("licensing") then
        setState("invalid", "licensing_unavailable_here")
        return
    end
    local result, code = ScriptGo.licensing.verify({ licenseKey = key, package = PACKAGE })
    InvProLicense.checkedAt = ScriptGo.time.now()
    if result and result.valid then
        InvProLicense.graceUntil = isoToEpoch(result.offlineGraceUntil)
        ScriptGo.storage.set("license:last_valid", {
            status = result.status, offlineGraceUntil = result.offlineGraceUntil, checkedAt = InvProLicense.checkedAt,
        })
        setState("active", nil)
        return
    end
    if result and result.valid == false then
        -- A definitive answer from the API: no grace for a revoked or expired license.
        ScriptGo.storage.delete("license:last_valid")
        setState("invalid", result.reason or result.status or "invalid")
        return
    end
    -- Transport failure or API error: fall back on the cached grace window.
    local cached = ScriptGo.storage.get("license:last_valid")
    local graceUntil = cached and isoToEpoch(cached.offlineGraceUntil)
    if graceUntil and ScriptGo.time.now() < graceUntil then
        InvProLicense.graceUntil = graceUntil
        setState("grace", "api_unreachable:" .. tostring(code))
    else
        setState("invalid", "api_unreachable:" .. tostring(code))
    end
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        InvProLicense.check()
        Wait(RECHECK_MS)
    end

Mugshot = { pending = {}, STAGE_MS = 5000, CAPTURE_MS = 15000 }

local function settings()
  return Config.mugshot or {}
end

function Mugshot.mode()
  local c = settings()
  return Pure.mugshotMode(c.enabled, GetResourceState(c.resource or 'screenshot-basic'))
end

local function distance()
  return tonumber(settings().distance) or 3.0
end

function Mugshot.inReach(officer, suspect)
  return Pure.withinReach(State.readCoords(officer), State.readCoords(suspect), distance(), GetPlayerRoutingBucket(officer), GetPlayerRoutingBucket(suspect))
end

function Mugshot.suspect(src, target)
  if target.id then
    if target.id == src or not GetPlayerName(target.id) then return nil end
    return target.id
  end
  local others = {}
  for _, s in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
    local other = tonumber(s)
    if other ~= src then others[#others + 1] = { src = other, coords = State.readCoords(other), bucket = GetPlayerRoutingBucket(other) } end
  end
  return Pure.nearestPlayer(State.readCoords(src), others, distance(), GetPlayerRoutingBucket(src))
end

local function waitFor(entry, key, ms)
  local stop = GetGameTimer() + ms
  while entry[key] == nil and GetGameTimer() < stop do Wait(50) end
  return entry[key]
end

function Mugshot.capture(asked, suspect)
  local token = Pure.newServerId(math.random)
  local entry = { src = asked }
  Mugshot.pending[token] = entry
  TriggerClientEvent('statewide:client:mugshot', asked, { token = token, target = suspect })
  local image
  if waitFor(entry, 'ready', Mugshot.STAGE_MS) == true then
    local ok = pcall(function()
      exports[settings().resource or 'screenshot-basic']:requestClientScreenshot(asked, { encoding = 'jpg', quality = Pure.mugshotQuality(settings().quality) }, function(err, data)
        entry.image = (not err and type(data) == 'string') and data or false
      end)
    end)
    if ok then image = waitFor(entry, 'image', Mugshot.CAPTURE_MS) end
  end
  Mugshot.pending[token] = nil
  TriggerClientEvent('statewide:client:mugshotDone', asked, token)
  return image or nil
end

RegisterNetEvent('statewide:mugshot', function(p)
  local src = tonumber(source)
  if not src or src <= 0 or type(p) ~= 'table' or type(p.token) ~= 'string' then return end
  local entry = Mugshot.pending[p.token]
  if not entry or entry.src ~= src or entry.ready ~= nil then return end
  entry.ready = p.ready == true
end)

local function tooFar(src)
  Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_too_far', distance()), 'error')
end

local function book(src, args, name)
  if Mugshot.mode() ~= 'on' then return Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_off'), 'error') end
  local target = Pure.mugshotTarget(args[1])
  if not target then return Commands.usage(src, 'mugshot', name) end
  if target.id == src then return Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_self'), 'error') end
  local account = Identity.require(src)
  if not account then return end
  if not Commands.requireUnit(src) then return end
  if not Commands.cooldown(src, 'mugshot') then return end
  local suspect = Mugshot.suspect(src, target)
  if not suspect then return Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_none_near', distance()), 'error') end
  if not Mugshot.inReach(src, suspect) then return tooFar(src) end
  local suspectAccount = Identity.getAccount(suspect)
  if not suspectAccount then return Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_no_account'), 'error') end
  local body = Pure.withPlayer(account, { suspect = Pure.playerItem(suspectAccount), ssn = target.ssn })
  local res = api('POST', '/mugshots/tickets', 'lookup', { body = body, as = account, retry = false })
  if res.status ~= 201 or type(res.data) ~= 'table' or type(res.data.character) ~= 'table' then return Notify.problem(src, res) end
  local ticket, character = res.data.ticket, res.data.character
  local who = Pure.truncate(character.name or '?', 64)
  Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_taking', who), 'info')
  local image
  for _, side in ipairs(Pure.mugshotOrder(settings().client)) do
    if not Mugshot.inReach(src, suspect) then return tooFar(src) end
    image = Pure.mugshotImage(Mugshot.capture(side == 'suspect' and suspect or src, suspect), Pure.MUGSHOT_MAX_BASE64)
    if image then break end
  end
  if not image then return Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_failed'), 'error') end
  local upload = Pure.withPlayer(account, { ticket = ticket, characterId = character.id, image = image })
  local up = api('POST', '/mugshots', 'lookup', { body = upload, as = account, retry = false, deadline = 30 })
  if up.status ~= 200 or type(up.data) ~= 'table' then return Notify.problem(src, up) end
  if type(up.data.arrest) == 'table' then return Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_done_arrest', who), 'success') end
  Notify.player(src, L('mugshot_done', who), 'success')
end

if settings().enabled ~= false and settings().enabled ~= 'off' then Handlers.mugshot = book end

-- Inventory Pro, server side. Every premium entry point goes through `requireLicense`.
local hotbars = {} -- playerId -> { [1..5] = slot }

local function inv(name, ...)
    local pending, reason = Open77.exports.call("sg_inventory", name, ...)
    if not pending then return nil, reason end
    return pending:await()
end

local function requireLicense()
    if InvProLicense.active() then return true end
    return false, "not_licensed:" .. tostring(InvProLicense.reason or InvProLicense.state)
end

local function say(playerId, message, kind)
    if playerId == 0 or not ScriptGo.capabilities.has("ui") then return print(message) end
    ScriptGo.ui.notify(playerId, { type = kind or "info", title = "Inventory Pro", message = message })
end

-- Items are registered with InventoryKit once it is up (it is a declared dependency).
CreateThread(function()
    for _, def in ipairs(InvProCatalog.ITEMS) do
        local ok, why = inv("defineItem", def)
        if not ok then ScriptGo.log.warn("defineItem " .. def.name .. ": " .. tostring(why)) end
    end
end)

local function craft(playerId, recipeName)
    local licensed, why = requireLicense()
    if not licensed then return false, why end
    local recipe = InvProCatalog.RECIPES[recipeName]
    if not recipe then return false, "unknown_recipe" end
    for _, input in ipairs(recipe.inputs) do
        local have = inv("count", playerId, input.item) or 0
        if have < input.count then return false, "missing:" .. input.item end
    end
    -- Take the inputs, then give the output; give the inputs back if the output does not fit.
    local taken = {}
    for _, input in ipairs(recipe.inputs) do
        local ok, err = inv("remove", playerId, input.item, input.count)
        if not ok then
            for _, t in ipairs(taken) do inv("add", playerId, t.item, t.count) end
            return false, err
        end
        taken[#taken + 1] = input
    end
    local ok, err = inv("add", playerId, recipe.output.item, recipe.output.count)
    if not ok then
        for _, t in ipairs(taken) do inv("add", playerId, t.item, t.count) end
        return false, err
    end
    TriggerEvent("inventory_pro:crafted", playerId, recipeName)
    return true, recipe.output
end

local function bindHotbar(playerId, index, slot)
    local licensed, why = requireLicense()
    if not licensed then return false, why end
    index, slot = tonumber(index), tonumber(slot)
    if not index or index < 1 or index > InvProCatalog.HOTBAR_SIZE or index ~= math.floor(index) then return false, "invalid_hotbar_index" end
    if not slot or slot < 1 or slot ~= math.floor(slot) then return false, "invalid_slot" end
    hotbars[playerId] = hotbars[playerId] or {}
    hotbars[playerId][index] = slot
    ScriptGo.storage.set("hotbar:" .. tostring(ScriptGo.players.identifier(playerId)), hotbars[playerId])
    TriggerClientEvent("inventory_pro:hotbar", playerId, hotbars[playerId])
    return true
end

local function useHotbar(playerId, index)
    local licensed, why = requireLicense()
    if not licensed then return false, why end
    local bar = hotbars[playerId]
    if not bar then
        bar = ScriptGo.storage.get("hotbar:" .. tostring(ScriptGo.players.identifier(playerId))) or {}
        hotbars[playerId] = bar
    end
    local slot = bar[tonumber(index)]
    if not slot then return false, "hotbar_empty" end
    return inv("use", playerId, slot)
end

exports("status", function()
    return { state = InvProLicense.state, reason = InvProLicense.reason, graceUntil = InvProLicense.graceUntil, checkedAt = InvProLicense.checkedAt }
end)
exports("craft", craft)
exports("bindHotbar", bindHotbar)
exports("useHotbar", useHotbar)
exports("recipes", function()
    local out = {}
    for name, r in pairs(InvProCatalog.RECIPES) do out[#out + 1] = { name = name, output = r.output, inputs = r.inputs, rarity = InvProCatalog.rarityOf(r.output.item) } end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
    return out
end)

if ScriptGo.capabilities.has("commands") then
    RegisterCommand("craft", function(src, args)
        if src == 0 then return print("craft: run it in game") end
        local ok, result = craft(src, args[1])
        if ok then say(src, ("Crafted %d x %s"):format(result.count, result.item), "success")
        else say(src, "Crafting failed: " .. tostring(result), "error") end
    end, false)

    RegisterCommand("hotbar", function(src, args)
        if src == 0 then return print("hotbar: run it in game") end
        local ok, why = bindHotbar(src, args[1], args[2])
        say(src, ok and ("Hotbar %s -> slot %s"):format(args[1], args[2]) or ("Hotbar failed: " .. tostring(why)), ok and "success" or "error")
    end, false)

    RegisterCommand("invpro", function(src)
        local s = InvProLicense
        say(src, ("Inventory Pro: license %s%s"):format(s.state, s.reason and (" (" .. s.reason .. ")") or ""))
    end, false)
end

RegisterNetEvent("inventory_pro:useHotbar", function(index)
    local playerId = source
    local ok, why = useHotbar(playerId, index)
    if not ok then TriggerClientEvent("inventory_pro:refused", playerId, "hotbar", why) end
end)

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function() hotbars[source] = nil end)

Nat = {}

local cfg = Config.nat or {}
local resource = cfg.resource or 'framework'
local SELECT = 'SELECT `id`, `discord`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `dob`, `gender`, `level` FROM `characters` WHERE `id` = ? AND (`discord` = ? OR `discord` = ?) LIMIT 1'
local seen = {}
local generation = {}
local warned = {}
local started = false

local function warnOnce(key, line)
  if warned[key] then return end
  warned[key] = true
  print(('^3[statewide] %s^7'):format(line))
end

local function options()
  return { label = 'nat', map = cfg.departments, autoDuty = cfg.autoDuty ~= false }
end

local function query(sql, params)
  local p, settled = promise.new(), false
  local function settle(rows)
    if settled then return end
    settled = true
    p:resolve(rows)
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    exports.oxmysql:query(sql, params, settle)
  end)
  if not ok then return nil, err end
  SetTimeout(15000, function() settle(false) end)
  local rows = Citizen.Await(p)
  if type(rows) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'query failed' end
  return rows
end

function Nat.sessionKey(session)
  if type(session) ~= 'table' then return false end
  local charid = session.charid
  if charid == nil then charid = session.char_id end
  if charid == nil or charid == false then return false end
  return tostring(charid) .. '|' .. tostring(session.level), charid
end

function Nat.changed(src, charid)
  local gen = (generation[src] or 0) + 1
  generation[src] = gen
  if not charid then return Framework.apply(src, nil, options()) end
  local discord = Framework.discordOf(src)
  if not discord then return Notify.player(src, L('no_discord'), 'error') end
  local rows, err = query(SELECT, { charid, discord, 'discord:' .. discord })
  if generation[src] ~= gen then return end
  if not rows then
    warnOnce('query', ('nat module could not read the characters table: %s'):format(tostring(err)))
    return
  end
  if not rows[1] then return Framework.refused('nat', src, 'not_owner') end
  local character = Pure.normalizeNat(rows[1], cfg.dateOrder)
  if not character then return Framework.refused('nat', src, 'validation') end
  Framework.apply(src, character, options())
end

local function functions()
  local ok, fns = pcall(function() return exports[resource]:getServerFunctions() end)
  if ok and type(fns) == 'table' and Pure.callable(fns.getPlayer) then return fns end
  warnOnce('exports', ('nat module: %s has no getServerFunctions().getPlayer; the module is idle.'):format(resource))
  return nil
end

function Nat.poll()
  if not Modules.active.nat then return end
  if GetResourceState('oxmysql') ~= 'started' then
    warnOnce('oxmysql', 'nat module needs oxmysql started; the module is idle.')
    return
  end
  local fns = functions()
  if not fns then return end
  local players = GetPlayers()
  for i = 1, #players do
    local src = tonumber(players[i])
    local ok, session = pcall(fns.getPlayer, src)
    local key, charid = Nat.sessionKey(ok and session or nil)
    if seen[src] ~= key then
      seen[src] = key
      CreateThread(function()
        local fine, err = pcall(Nat.changed, src, charid)
        if not fine then print(('^1[statewide] nat module: %s^7'):format(tostring(err))) end
      end)
    end
  end
end

function Nat.start()
  if started then return end
  started = true
  CreateThread(function()
    while true do
      local ok, err = pcall(Nat.poll)
      if not ok then print(('^1[statewide] nat module: %s^7'):format(tostring(err))) end
      Wait(math.max(1, tonumber(cfg.pollSeconds) or 3) * 1000)
    end
  end)
end

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
  local src = tonumber(source)
  seen[src] = nil
  generation[src] = nil
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(stopped)
  if stopped == resource then seen = {} end
end)

Modules.resolve('nat', Nat.start, ('[statewide] nat module: not detected (%s is not started)'):format(resource))

local cfg = Config.phoneApp or {}
local LB = Config.lbPhone and Config.lbPhone.resource or 'lb-phone'
local IDENTIFIER = 'statewide'
local RESOURCE = GetCurrentResourceName()
local APP_SIZE_KB = 120
local REGISTER_DELAY_MS = 500
local TIMEOUT_MS = 10000
local PENDING_MAX = 4
local ID_MAX = 2147483647
local nextId, open = 0, 0
local pending = {}

local function lbCall(name, ...)
  local ok, a, b = pcall(function(...)
    local res = exports[LB]
    return res[name](res, ...)
  end, ...)
  if not ok then return false, nil, a end
  return true, a, b
end

local function settle(id, result)
  local cb = pending[id]
  if not cb then return end
  pending[id] = nil
  open = open - 1
  cb(result)
end

local function dropPending()
  for id in pairs(pending) do settle(id, { ok = false, messages = { { text = L('phone_timeout'), kind = 'error' } } }) end
end

local function addApp()
  if GetResourceState(LB) ~= 'started' then return end
  local called, added, err = lbCall('AddCustomApp', {
    identifier = IDENTIFIER,
    name = L('phone_app_name'),
    description = L('phone_app_description'),
    developer = 'Statewide',
    defaultApp = cfg.defaultApp ~= false,
    size = APP_SIZE_KB,
    images = {},
    ui = RESOURCE .. '/modules/phoneapp/ui/index.html',
    icon = 'https://cfx-nui-' .. RESOURCE .. '/modules/phoneapp/ui/icon.png',
    fixBlur = true,
    onClose = dropPending,
  })
  if not called or added == false then print(L('phoneapp_add_failed', tostring(err))) end
end

local function addLater()
  CreateThread(function()
    Wait(REGISTER_DELAY_MS)
    addApp()
  end)
end

if (Config.modules or {}).phoneapp ~= false and (Config.modules or {}).phoneapp ~= 'off' then
  if GetResourceState(LB) == 'started' then addLater() end

  AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(name)
    if name == LB then addLater() end
  end)

  AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(name)
    if name == RESOURCE and GetResourceState(LB) == 'started' then lbCall('RemoveCustomApp', IDENTIFIER) end
  end)

  RegisterNUICallback('phoneBoot', function(_, cb)
    cb({ lb = LB })
  end)

  RegisterNUICallback('phone', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false, messages = { { text = L('phone_bad_args'), kind = 'error' } } }) end
    local args, why = Pure.validatePhoneAction(data.action, data.args)
    if args and not why.urgent and open >= PENDING_MAX then return cb({ ok = false, messages = { { text = L('busy'), kind = 'error' } } }) end
    if not args then return cb({ ok = false, messages = { { text = L(why == 'unknown_action' and 'phone_unknown' or 'phone_bad_args'), kind = 'error' } } }) end
    nextId = nextId % ID_MAX + 1
    local id = nextId
    pending[id] = cb
    open = open + 1
    TriggerServerEvent('statewide:phone', { id = id, action = data.action, args = args })
    SetTimeout(TIMEOUT_MS, function()
      settle(id, { ok = false, messages = { { text = L('phone_timeout'), kind = 'error' } } })
    end)
  end)

  RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:phone', function(id, result)
    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return end
    settle(id, result)
  end)

  RegisterNetEvent('statewide:client:phonePush', function(data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or GetResourceState(LB) ~= 'started' then return end
    lbCall('SendCustomAppMessage', IDENTIFIER, data)
  end)
end

-- VIP perks, server side.
--
-- The operator created a perk with the key "vip" in the SCRIPT//GO dashboard, linked this server to
-- their account and gave it the link token (the host setting scriptgo_server_token). From there:
--
--   * when a player joins, the script asks whether they have the perk (ScriptGo.perks.has: the
--     answer comes from SCRIPT//GO, the source of truth, and is cached by the host);
--   * while the server runs, it is told when a perk is granted or removed (a purchase, a refund,
--     the end of a period) and applies that at once;
--   * a player without the perk can be given a purchase link tied to their identifier.
--
-- What "having VIP" does is this script's business: here it is a table and a log line. Nothing in
-- this file talks to a payment provider.
local PERK = "vip"

local vip = {} -- player id -> true while that player is connected and has the perk

local function setting(key)
    if not ScriptGo.capabilities.has("config") then return nil end
    return ScriptGo.config.get(key)
end

local function apply(player, on, why)
    if player == nil then return end
    if (vip[player] == true) == on then return end
    vip[player] = on or nil
    ScriptGo.log.info(("SGPERK %s player=%s perk=%s (%s)"):format(on and "applied" or "withdrawn", tostring(player), PERK, tostring(why)))
    if ScriptGo.capabilities.has("ui") then
        ScriptGo.ui.notify(player, {
            type = on and "success" or "info", title = "VIP",
            message = on and "Your VIP perk is active." or "Your VIP perk has ended.",
        })
    end
end

AddEventHandler("onPlayerConnected", function(player)
    local has, info = ScriptGo.perks.has(player, PERK)
    ScriptGo.log.info(("SGPERK join player=%s identifier=%s %s=%s"):format(tostring(player), tostring(ScriptGo.players.identifier(player)), PERK, tostring(has)))
    apply(player, has, has and "held at join" or tostring(info))
end)

AddEventHandler("onPlayerDisconnected", function(player)
    vip[player] = nil
end)

-- `player` is the connected player with that identifier, or nil when they are not on this server.
ScriptGo.perks.on("granted", function(player, key, info)
    ScriptGo.log.info(("SGPERK granted identifier=%s perk=%s reason=%s"):format(info.identifier, key, tostring(info.reason)))
    if key == PERK then apply(player, true, info.reason) end
end)

ScriptGo.perks.on("removed", function(player, key, info)
    ScriptGo.log.info(("SGPERK removed identifier=%s perk=%s reason=%s"):format(info.identifier, key, tostring(info.reason)))
    if key == PERK then apply(player, false, info.reason) end
end)

exports("has", function(player, key)
    local has, info = ScriptGo.perks.has(player, key or PERK)
    if has then return true, info.expiresAt, info.source end
    return false, info
end)

exports("isVip", function(player) return vip[player] == true end)

-- A purchase link for one player: the page it opens names the perk, the seller and the player, and
-- sends them to the operator's own store.
exports("link", function(player, key)
    return ScriptGo.perks.purchaseLink(player, key or PERK)
end)

-- Demonstration and end-to-end runs: the setting "watch" (a list of player identifiers) makes the
-- script report, twice a second, what it would answer for each of them, and "print_links" makes it
-- ask for a purchase link whenever one of them does not have the perk.
CreateThread(function()
    local watch = setting("watch")
    if type(watch) ~= "table" or #watch == 0 then return end
    local last = {}
    while true do
        for _, identifier in ipairs(watch) do
            local has, info = ScriptGo.perks.has(identifier, PERK)
            local line
            if has then
                line = "held expires=" .. tostring(info.expiresAt or "never")
            else
                line = "not_held (" .. tostring(info) .. ")"
            end
            if last[identifier] ~= line then
                last[identifier] = line
                ScriptGo.log.info(("SGPERK state identifier=%s perk=%s %s"):format(identifier, PERK, line))
                if not has and info == "not_held" and setting("print_links") == true then
                    local url, why = ScriptGo.perks.purchaseLink(identifier, PERK)
                    ScriptGo.log.info(("SGPERK link identifier=%s perk=%s %s"):format(identifier, PERK, url or ("refused (" .. tostring(why) .. ")")))
                end
            end
        end
        Wait(500)
    end
end)

-- RCC source attribution

-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

PhoneApp = {}

local cfg = Config.phoneApp or {}
local INTERVAL_MS = math.max(250, tonumber(cfg.requestIntervalMs) or 500)
local ID_MAX = 2147483647
local last, busy, seen, watching, shown = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}

local function failure(key, ...)
  return Pure.phoneResult({ { text = L(key, ...), kind = 'error' } })
end

local function problem(res)
  return Pure.phoneResult({ { text = Pure.problemMessage(res and res.problem, Locale), kind = 'error' } })
end

local function captured(src, fn, ...)
  local messages, data = Notify.capture(src, fn, ...)
  return Pure.phoneResult(messages, data)
end

local function push(src, data)
  if seen[src] then TriggerClientEvent('statewide:client:phonePush', src, data) end
end

local function answer(res, shape)
  if res.status ~= 200 or type(res.data) ~= 'table' then return problem(res) end
  return Pure.phoneResult({}, shape(res.data))
end

local RUN = {}

RUN.me = function(src)
  local p = State.peek(src)
  if not p then
    State.refresh(src)
    p = State.peek(src)
  end
  local c = p and p.character
  return Pure.phoneResult({}, {
    onDuty = p ~= nil and p.unit ~= nil,
    unit = Pure.phoneViewUnit(p and p.unit),
    character = c and { name = Pure.truncate((c.firstName or '') .. ' ' .. (c.lastName or ''), 80), ssn = c.ssn } or nil,
  })
end

RUN.characters = function(_, _, account)
  local res = api('GET', '/characters', 'civilian', { query = { discordId = Pure.playerSlot(account) }, as = account, retry = false })
  return answer(res, function(data) return Pure.phoneViewCharacters(data.characters) end)
end

RUN.setActive = function(src, args)
  return captured(src, Actions.setciv, src, args.ssn)
end

RUN.profile = function(_, args, account)
  local res = api('GET', '/characters/{ssn}/profile', 'civilian', { params = { ssn = args.ssn }, query = { discordId = Pure.playerSlot(account) }, as = account, retry = false })
  local result = answer(res, Pure.phoneViewProfile)
  if result.ok and not result.data then return failure('phone_failed') end
  return result
end

RUN.my911 = function(src, _, account)
  local res = api('GET', '/players/{discordId}/911', 'civilian', { params = { discordId = Pure.playerSlot(account) }, as = account, retry = false })
  return answer(res, function(data)
    local calls = Pure.phoneView911(data.calls)
    local numbers = {}
    for i = 1, #calls do numbers[calls[i].number] = true end
    watching[src] = numbers
    return calls
  end)
end

RUN.call = function(src, _, account)
  State.refresh(src)
  local p = State.peek(src)
  local number = p and p.unit and p.unit.callNumber
  if not Pure.isCallNumber(number) then return Pure.phoneResult({}, nil) end
  local res = api('GET', '/calls/{number}', 'calls', { params = { number = number }, query = { discordId = Pure.playerSlot(account) }, as = account, retry = false })
  return answer(res, Pure.phoneViewCall)
end

RUN.statusCodes = function(_, _, account)
  local res = api('GET', '/status-codes', 'units', { query = { discordId = Pure.playerSlot(account) }, as = account, retry = false })
  return answer(res, function(data) return Pure.phoneViewStatusCodes(data.codes) end)
end

RUN.status = function(src, args)
  return captured(src, Actions.status, src, args.code)
end

RUN.panic = function(src)
  local ok, why, left = Commands.enter(src)
  if not ok then return why == 'cooldown' and failure('cooldown', left) or failure('busy') end
  local fine, result = pcall(captured, src, Actions.panic, src, 'panic')
  Commands.leave(src)
  if not fine then error(result, 0) end
  return result
end

RUN.plate = function(src, args)
  return captured(src, Actions.plate, src, args.plate)
end

RUN.name = function(src, args)
  return captured(src, Actions.name, src, args.first, args.last)
end

local function run(src, action, args, spec)
  local account = Identity.getAccount(src)
  if not account then return failure('no_discord') end
  if spec.officer then
    local p = State.peek(src)
    if not (p and p.unit) then return failure('not_on_duty') end
  end
  return RUN[action](src, args, account)
end

local function reply(src, id, result)
  TriggerClientEvent('statewide:client:phone', src, id, result)
end

local function onPhone(msg)
  local src = tonumber(source)
  if not src or src <= 0 or not Modules.active.phoneapp then return end
  if type(msg) ~= 'table' then return end
  local id = msg.id
  if math.type(id) ~= 'integer' or id < 1 or id > ID_MAX then return end
  local args, spec = Pure.validatePhoneAction(msg.action, msg.args)
  local urgent = args ~= nil and spec.urgent == true
  if not urgent then
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if busy[src] or (last[src] and now - last[src] < INTERVAL_MS) then return reply(src, id, failure('busy')) end
    last[src] = now
  end
  if not args then return reply(src, id, failure(spec == 'unknown_action' and 'phone_unknown' or 'phone_bad_args')) end
  if not urgent then busy[src] = true end
  seen[src] = true
  CreateThread(function()
    local ok, result = pcall(run, src, msg.action, args, spec)
    if not urgent then busy[src] = nil end
    if not ok then
      print(('^1[statewide] phone app: %s^7'):format(result))
      result = failure('phone_failed')
    end
    reply(src, id, result)
  end)
end

local function fromServer(fn)
  return function(payload)
    if not Pure.isServerSource(source) or not Modules.active.phoneapp then return end
    fn(payload)
  end
end

local function callChanged(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= 'table' or not Pure.isCallNumber(payload.number) then return end
  for src, numbers in pairs(watching) do
    if numbers[payload.number] then push(src, { type = 'my911' }) end
  end
end

local function callOpened(payload)
  callChanged(payload)
end

local OFFICER_PUSHES = { attached = true, callClosed = true, forcedOff = true }

local function officerSink(src, name)
  if Modules.active.phoneapp and OFFICER_PUSHES[name] then push(src, { type = 'call' }) end
end

local function unitChanged(src, unit)
  if not Modules.active.phoneapp or not seen[src] then return end
  local view = Pure.phoneViewUnit(unit)
  local key = Pure.phoneUnitKey(view)
  if shown[src] == key then return end
  shown[src] = key
  push(src, { type = 'unit', unit = view, onDuty = unit ~= nil })
end

local function characterChanged(src)
  if Modules.active.phoneapp then push(src, { type = 'character' }) end
end

function PhoneApp.register()
  RegisterNetEvent('statewide:phone', onPhone)
  AddEventHandler('statewide:callOpened', fromServer(callOpened))
  AddEventHandler('statewide:callClosed', fromServer(callChanged))
  AddEventHandler('statewide:attached', fromServer(callChanged))
  AddEventHandler('statewide:detached', fromServer(callChanged))
  Notify.addSink(officerSink)
  State.onUnitChange(unitChanged)
  State.onCharacterChange(characterChanged)
  AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local src = tonumber(source)
    if not src then return end
    last[src], busy[src], seen[src], watching[src], shown[src] = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  end)
end

PhoneApp.run = run

local lbphoneOff = ErsMap.mode((Config.modules or {}).lbphone, 'started') == 'off'
Modules.resolve('phoneapp', PhoneApp.register, lbphoneOff and L('phoneapp_absent', Config.lbPhone.resource) or false)
