-- BeamMP adapter: SCRIPT//GO resources inside one BeamMP server plugin (BeamMP-Server 3.x, Lua 5.3).
--
--   local adapter, api = loadAdapter()(scriptgo, { pluginDir = ..., config = ..., logSink = ... })
--
-- Everything here goes through the host's own Lua API: MP.* (events, timers, players, chat,
-- notifications), FS.* (directories, listing, rename) and Util.* (logging), plus the standard io
-- library BeamMP opens for plugins (file reads and writes) and io.popen/os.execute for curl.
--
-- BeamMP specifics:
--   - Plugins are server-side; there is no client half here (BeamNG.drive client mods are out of
--     scope), so only the server side of a resource runs.
--   - BeamMP player ids start at 0; SCRIPT//GO reserves 0 for the console. A BeamMP id `n` is the
--     SCRIPT//GO player `n + 1`, both ways, everywhere in this adapter.
--   - MP.CreateTimer() is the monotonic clock (seconds as a 32-bit float, so it is rebased every
--     1000 s to keep sub-millisecond precision).
--   - BeamMP's own Http.CreateConnection(...):Get() discards the response and has no POST, so
--     ScriptGo.http (and licensing) runs curl in the background and polls its result files on
--     each tick: a request never blocks the plugin's Lua state.
return function(scriptgo, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local json = scriptgo.json
    local cfg = opts.config or {}
    local pluginDir = (opts.pluginDir or "Resources/Server/scriptgo"):gsub("\\", "/")
    local dataDir = (type(cfg.dataDir) == "string" and cfg.dataDir or (pluginDir .. "/data")):gsub("\\", "/")
    local isWindows = package and package.config and package.config:sub(1, 1) == "\\"

    local adapter = {
        environment = "beammp",
        adapterVersion = "beammp-0.1.0",
        sides = { server = true },
        capabilities = {
            events = true, logging = true, storage = true, players = true, permissions = true,
            commands = true, config = true, ui = true, http = false, licensing = false, presence = false,
        },
        notifications = {},
    }
    local api = { json = json, dataDir = dataDir }

    -- Files ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function readFile(path)
        local f = io.open(path, "rb")
        if not f then return nil end
        local text = f:read("*a")
        f:close()
        return text
    end

    local function writeFile(path, text)
        local f, err = io.open(path, "wb")
        if not f then return false, err end
        f:write(text)
        f:close()
        return true
    end

    local function ensureDir(dir)
        if FS.Exists(dir) then return true end
        local ok, err = FS.CreateDirectory(dir)
        if not ok then return false, err end
        return true
    end

    api.readFile, api.writeFile, api.ensureDir = readFile, writeFile, ensureDir
    adapter.readFile = readFile

    -- FS.ListFiles / FS.ListDirectories list one level, names only, or nil when the folder is missing.
    adapter.listFiles = function(root)
        local out = {}
        local function walk(dir, prefix)
            local files = FS.ListFiles(dir) or {}
            for _, name in ipairs(files) do out[#out + 1] = prefix .. (tostring(name):gsub("\\", "/")) end
            for _, name in ipairs(FS.ListDirectories(dir) or {}) do
                name = tostring(name):gsub("\\", "/")
                if name:sub(1, 1) ~= "." then walk(dir .. "/" .. name, prefix .. name .. "/") end
            end
        end
        walk(root, "")
        table.sort(out)
        return out
    end

    -- Clock ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local timer = MP.CreateTimer()
    local base = 0
    adapter.now = function()
        local t = timer:GetCurrent()
        if t > 1000 then
            base = base + t
            timer:Start()
            t = 0
        end
        return base + t
    end

    -- Logging ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local LOG = { debug = "LogDebug", info = "LogInfo", warn = "LogWarn", error = "LogError" }
    adapter.log = function(level, origin, msg)
        local fn = Util[LOG[level] or "LogInfo"] or print
        fn("[scriptgo] " .. tostring(origin) .. " " .. tostring(msg))
        if opts.logSink then opts.logSink({ level = level, origin = origin, message = msg }) end
    end

    -- Storage: one JSON document per resource side, <dataDir>/storage/<key>.json, written to a
    -- temporary file and renamed over the old one so a crash never leaves half a document.
    local function storageFile(key) return dataDir .. "/storage/" .. tostring(key):gsub("[^%w_%.%-]", "_") .. ".json" end
    adapter.storage = {
        load = function(key) return readFile(storageFile(key)) end,
        save = function(key, text)
            local ok, err = ensureDir(dataDir .. "/storage")
            if not ok then
                adapter.log("error", "storage", "cannot create " .. dataDir .. "/storage: " .. tostring(err))
                return
            end
            local final = storageFile(key)
            local tmp = final .. ".tmp"
            local wrote, werr = writeFile(tmp, text)
            if not wrote then
                adapter.log("error", "storage", "cannot write " .. tmp .. ": " .. tostring(werr))
                return
            end
            local renamed = FS.Rename(tmp, final)
            if not renamed then
                -- Some platforms refuse to rename over an existing file: replace it in two steps.
                FS.Remove(final)
                if not FS.Rename(tmp, final) then writeFile(final, text) end
            end
        end,
    }

    -- Players ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function beamId(id)
        if type(id) ~= "number" or id < 1 or id ~= math.floor(id) then return nil end
        return math.floor(id) - 1
    end
    api.toScriptGo = function(pid) return pid + 1 end
    api.toBeamMP = beamId

    local function nameOf(id)
        local pid = beamId(id)
        if not pid then return nil end
        local name = MP.GetPlayerName(pid)
        if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
        return name
    end

    adapter.players = {
        list = function()
            local ids = {}
            for pid in pairs(MP.GetPlayers() or {}) do
                if type(pid) == "number" then ids[#ids + 1] = pid + 1 end
            end
            table.sort(ids)
            return ids
        end,
        name = nameOf,
        -- beammp:<account id> for players logged in to BeamMP; guests (when the server allows
        -- them) have no account, so they get a name-based identifier that is not stable.
        identifier = function(id)
            local pid = beamId(id)
            local name = nameOf(id)
            if not pid or not name then return nil end
            local ids = MP.GetPlayerIdentifiers(pid)
            if type(ids) == "table" and ids.beammp ~= nil and tostring(ids.beammp) ~= "" then
                return "beammp:" .. tostring(ids.beammp)
            end
            return "beammp-guest:" .. name:lower():gsub("[^%w_%-]", "_")
        end,
        -- The player's address, for player match only (docs/spec/player-match.md). Not visible to
        -- scripts, never logged. BeamMP's Lua has no HMAC: it is read only in address mode
        -- (scriptgo_presence_addr, default off), where the core sends it normalised to SCRIPT//GO.
        address = function(id)
            local pid = beamId(id)
            if not pid then return nil end
            local ids = MP.GetPlayerIdentifiers(pid)
            return type(ids) == "table" and type(ids.ip) == "string" and ids.ip or nil
        end,
    }

    -- Permissions: BeamMP has no server-side roles, so grants come from scriptgo.json, keyed by
    -- identifier ("beammp:<account id>") or, for players logged in to BeamMP, by player name:
    -- { "permissions": { "beammp:123456": ["*"], "Ada": ["command.giveitem", "shop.*"] } }.
    local grants = type(cfg.permissions) == "table" and cfg.permissions or {}
    local function granted(list, privilege)
        if type(list) ~= "table" then return false end
        for _, p in ipairs(list) do
            if p == "*" or p == privilege then return true end
            if type(p) == "string" and p:sub(-2) == ".*" and privilege:sub(1, #p - 1) == p:sub(1, -2) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    adapter.permissions = {
        has = function(id, privilege)
            local pid = beamId(id)
            if not pid or not nameOf(id) then return false end
            local ident = adapter.players.identifier(id)
            if ident and granted(grants[ident], privilege) then return true end
            if not MP.IsPlayerGuest(pid) and granted(grants[nameOf(id)], privilege) then return true end
            return false
        end,
    }

    -- Config: scriptgo.json { "resources": { "<name>": { key: value } }, "convars": { key: value } }.
    adapter.config = {
        get = function(resourceName, key)
            if resourceName == nil then
                local v = (type(cfg.convars) == "table" and cfg.convars or {})[key]
                return v
            end
            local r = (type(cfg.resources) == "table" and cfg.resources or {})[resourceName]
            return type(r) == "table" and r[key] or nil
        end,
    }

    -- Notifications: MP.SendNotification (a toast in the BeamMP client UI), or a chat line on
    -- servers that predate it. -1 reaches every player.
    adapter.ui = {
        notify = function(target, payload)
            adapter.notifications[#adapter.notifications + 1] = { target = target, payload = payload }
            local title = payload.title or payload.resource or "notice"
            local line = "[" .. tostring(title) .. "] " .. tostring(payload.message or "")
            local pid = target == -1 and -1 or beamId(target)
            if pid == nil then return end
            if MP.SendNotification then
                MP.SendNotification(pid, line)
            else
                MP.SendChatMessage(pid, line)
            end
        end,
    }

    -- HTTP: curl in the background ------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function hasCurl()
        if not io.popen then return false end
        local ok, p = pcall(io.popen, isWindows and "curl --version 2>NUL" or "curl --version 2>/dev/null")
        if not ok or not p then return false end
        local out = p:read("*a") or ""
        p:close()
        return out:find("^curl") ~= nil
    end

    local httpOn = cfg.http ~= false and os.execute ~= nil and hasCurl()
    adapter.capabilities.http = httpOn
    adapter.capabilities.licensing = httpOn
    -- Player match: /link over HTTP; presence reports only in address mode (no HMAC here).
    adapter.capabilities.presence = httpOn

    local allowed = nil
    if type(cfg.httpAllowedHosts) == "table" then
        allowed = {}
        for _, h in ipairs(cfg.httpAllowedHosts) do allowed[tostring(h):lower()] = true end
    end
    local function hostOf(url) return (tostring(url):match("^%a[%w+.-]*://([^/:?#]+)") or ""):lower() end

    local pending, seq, httpDir = {}, 0, dataDir .. "/http"
    local runId = tostring(os.time()) .. "-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))

    local function shq(s)
        if isWindows then return '"' .. tostring(s):gsub("%%", "%%%%") .. '"' end
        return "'" .. tostring(s):gsub("'", "'\\''") .. "'"
    end
    local function native(p) return isWindows and p:gsub("/", "\\") or p end

    local function finish(id, response)
        local r = pending[id]
        pending[id] = nil
        for _, f in ipairs({ r.req, r.body, r.head, r.err, r.code, r.script }) do os.remove(f) end
        local ok, err = pcall(r.done, response)
        if not ok then adapter.log("error", "http", "response handler raised: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end

    local function parseHead(text)
        local status, headers = 0, {}
        -- The last response block wins (an interim 100 Continue comes first).
        for line in (text or ""):gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
            local code = line:match("^HTTP/%S+%s+(%d%d%d)")
            if code then
                status, headers = tonumber(code), {}
            else
                local k, v = line:match("^([^:]+):%s*(.-)%s*$")
                if k then headers[k:lower()] = v end
            end
        end
        return status, headers
    end

    -- Called on every tick: completes the requests whose curl has finished.
    api.pump = function(now)
        for id, r in pairs(pending) do
            local codeText = readFile(r.code)
            local exitCode = codeText and tonumber(codeText:match("(%d+)"))
            if exitCode then
                local status, headers = parseHead(readFile(r.head))
                if exitCode ~= 0 or status == 0 then
                    local why = exitCode == 28 and "timeout" or "http_failed"
                    finish(id, { status = 0, body = "", headers = {}, error = why })
                else
                    finish(id, { status = status, body = readFile(r.body) or "", headers = headers })
                end
            elseif now and now > r.deadline then
                finish(id, { status = 0, body = "", headers = {}, error = "timeout" })
            end
        end
    end

    if httpOn then
        adapter.http = {
            request = function(req, done)
                local url = tostring(req.url or "")
                if not url:match("^https?://") then return done({ status = 0, body = "", error = "invalid_url" }) end
                if allowed and not allowed[hostOf(url)] then return done({ status = 0, body = "", error = "host_not_allowed" }) end
                local okDir, derr = ensureDir(httpDir)
                if not okDir then return done({ status = 0, body = "", error = "http_failed: " .. tostring(derr) }) end
                seq = seq + 1
                local stem = httpDir .. "/" .. runId .. "-" .. seq
                local r = {
                    req = stem .. ".req", body = stem .. ".body", head = stem .. ".head", err = stem .. ".err",
                    code = stem .. ".code", script = stem .. (isWindows and ".cmd" or ".sh"), done = done,
                }
                local seconds = math.max(1, math.floor((req.timeoutMs or 10000) / 1000))
                local parts = { "curl -s -S -m " .. seconds, "-X " .. shq(req.method or "GET") }
                for k, v in pairs(req.headers or {}) do
                    local h = tostring(k) .. ": " .. tostring(v)
                    if h:find('["\r\n]') then return done({ status = 0, body = "", error = "invalid_header" }) end
                    parts[#parts + 1] = "-H " .. shq(h)
                end
                if url:find('["\r\n]') then return done({ status = 0, body = "", error = "invalid_url" }) end
                if req.body ~= nil then
                    writeFile(r.req, tostring(req.body))
                    parts[#parts + 1] = "--data-binary @" .. shq(native(r.req))
                end
                parts[#parts + 1] = "-o " .. shq(native(r.body))
                parts[#parts + 1] = "-D " .. shq(native(r.head))
                parts[#parts + 1] = shq(url)
                local curl = table.concat(parts, " ") .. " 2>" .. shq(native(r.err))
                local script
                if isWindows then
                    -- The exit code lands in .code last: its presence means curl has finished.
                    -- (Redirection first: "echo 0>file" would redirect handle 0.)
                    script = "@echo off\r\n" .. curl .. "\r\n>" .. shq(native(r.code) .. ".tmp") .. " echo %ERRORLEVEL%"
                        .. "\r\nmove /y " .. shq(native(r.code) .. ".tmp") .. " " .. shq(native(r.code)) .. " >NUL\r\n"
                else
                    script = curl .. "\necho $? > " .. shq(r.code .. ".tmp") .. " && mv " .. shq(r.code .. ".tmp") .. " " .. shq(r.code) .. "\n"
                end
                writeFile(r.script, script)
                r.deadline = adapter.now() + seconds + 15
                pending[seq] = r
                if isWindows then
                    os.execute('start "" /B cmd /C "' .. native(r.script) .. '" >NUL 2>NUL')
                else
                    os.execute("sh " .. shq(r.script) .. " >/dev/null 2>&1 &")
                end
            end,
        }
    end

    api.pendingHttp = function()
        local n = 0
        for _ in pairs(pending) do n = n + 1 end
        return n
    end

    return adapter, api
end

-- SCRIPT//GO for BeamMP: runs SCRIPT//GO (and portable OPEN//77) resources inside one BeamMP server
-- plugin, Resources/Server/scriptgo/. BeamMP runs every top-level .lua file of a plugin folder in
-- the plugin's own Lua 5.3 state; this is the only one. The core lives in core/, the adapter in lib/.
--
-- Resources are folders with a scriptgo.lua (or open77.lua) manifest, found in
--   <this plugin>/resources/<name>/   and every folder listed in scriptgo.json "resourceDirs".
-- Every resource whose manifest has `auto_start true` (the default) starts when the plugin loads,
-- dependencies first. Only the server side of a resource runs: there is no client half here.
--
-- Optional <this plugin>/scriptgo.json:
--   { "resources": { "<name>": { "key": "value" } }, "convars": { "key": "value" },
--     "permissions": { "beammp:<account id>": ["*"], "<player name>": ["command.give"] },
--     "start": ["<name>", ...], "dataDir": "<folder>", "http": false, "httpAllowedHosts": ["api.example.com"] }
-- "start", when present, replaces auto-start with an explicit list.
--
-- Chat: resource commands work as chat commands (/giveitem ...); the chat line is then not
-- broadcast. Server console: `scriptgo` lists the resources, `scriptgo start|stop|restart <name>`
-- manages one, and any resource command can be typed there (it runs as the console, source 0).
local function read(path)
    local f = io.open(path, "rb")
    if not f then return nil end
    local text = f:read("*a")
    f:close()
    return text
end

-- BeamMP names the chunk after the file, relative to the server folder and without "@".
local pluginDir = rawget(_G, "SCRIPTGO_BEAMMP_DIR")
if type(pluginDir) ~= "string" then
    local src = (debug and debug.getinfo and debug.getinfo(1, "S").source) or ""
    pluginDir = src:gsub("^@", ""):gsub("\\", "/"):match("^(.*)/[^/]+$") or "Resources/Server/scriptgo"
end
pluginDir = pluginDir:gsub("\\", "/")

local loadChunk = loadstring or load
local function loadModule(path, name)
    local text = read(path)
    if not text then error("[scriptgo] missing " .. path .. ": build the plugin with `node sdk/adapters/beammp/build.mjs`") end
    return assert(loadChunk(text, "@" .. name))
end

-- A hot reload re-runs this file in the same state (BeamMP's plugin monitor): stop the old host first.
local previous = rawget(_G, "ScriptGoBeamMP")
if type(previous) == "table" and previous.shutdown then previous.shutdown("reload") end

local scriptgo = loadModule(pluginDir .. "/core/init.lua", "scriptgo/init.lua")(pluginDir .. "/core/", read)
local json = scriptgo.json

local cfg = {}
do
    local text = read(pluginDir .. "/scriptgo.json")
    if text then
        local ok, value = pcall(json.decode, text)
        if ok and type(value) == "table" then cfg = value
        else Util.LogError("[scriptgo] scriptgo.json is not valid JSON; using defaults") end
    end
end

local logs = {}
local adapter, api = loadModule(pluginDir .. "/lib/adapter.lua", "scriptgo/beammp/adapter.lua")()(scriptgo, {
    pluginDir = pluginDir,
    config = cfg,
    logSink = function(entry)
        logs[#logs + 1] = entry
        if #logs > 5000 then table.remove(logs, 1) end
    end,
})

local host = scriptgo.newHost({ adapter = adapter })

-- Discovery ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local searchDirs = { pluginDir .. "/resources" }
for _, d in ipairs(type(cfg.resourceDirs) == "table" and cfg.resourceDirs or {}) do
    searchDirs[#searchDirs + 1] = tostring(d):gsub("\\", "/")
end

local function hasManifest(root) return read(root .. "/scriptgo.lua") ~= nil or read(root .. "/open77.lua") ~= nil end

local function locate(name)
    for _, dir in ipairs(searchDirs) do
        local root = dir .. "/" .. name
        if hasManifest(root) then return root end
    end
    return nil
end

local function addWithDeps(root)
    local res, err = host:addResource(root)
    if not res then
        if err and err:find("already loaded") then return true end
        return nil, err
    end
    for _, dep in ipairs(res.manifest.dependencies) do
        if not host:getResource(dep.name) then
            local depRoot = locate(dep.name)
            if depRoot then
                local ok, derr = addWithDeps(depRoot)
                if not ok then return nil, derr end
            end
        end
    end
    return res
end

local discovered, names = {}, {}
for _, dir in ipairs(searchDirs) do
    for _, name in ipairs(FS.ListDirectories(dir) or {}) do
        name = tostring(name):gsub("\\", "/")
        local root = dir .. "/" .. name
        if not discovered[name] and hasManifest(root) then
            discovered[name] = root
            names[#names + 1] = name
        end
    end
end
table.sort(names)
for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local ok, err = addWithDeps(discovered[name])
    if not ok then adapter.log("error", "plugin", name .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
end

-- Start ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local verify = type(cfg.verify) == "table" and cfg.verify or nil
local verifyName = verify and verify.resource or nil
local verifyWith = verify and verify.with or nil
local withStarted, withWhy = false, nil

if verifyName then
    -- Verify runs start the resource under test (and its dependencies) only, then the example
    -- resource named by verify.with, if any (the package's README example).
    local ok, why = host:getResource(verifyName) and host:start(verifyName)
    if not ok then adapter.log("error", "plugin", "verify: " .. verifyName .. " did not start: " .. tostring(why)) end
    if ok and verifyWith then
        if host:getResource(verifyWith) then
            withStarted, withWhy = host:start(verifyWith)
        else
            withWhy = "not found"
        end
    end
elseif type(cfg.start) == "table" then
    for _, name in ipairs(cfg.start) do
        local ok, why = host:start(name)
        if not ok then adapter.log("error", "plugin", name .. " did not start: " .. tostring(why)) end
    end
else
    for name, result in pairs(host:startAll()) do
        if result ~= "started" then adapter.log("error", "plugin", name .. " did not start: " .. tostring(result)) end
    end
end

-- Verify mode ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- scriptgo.json "verify": { "resource": "<name>", "seconds": 3, "report": "<file>", "with": "<name>",
-- "exit": true }. After `seconds` the plugin writes a report with the same schema as the other
-- hosts (relative paths are inside this plugin's folder) and, unless exit is false, shuts the
-- server down with BeamMP's exit().
local verifyStarted = adapter.now()
local verifyDone = false

local function writeVerifyReport()
    local checks = {}
    local function check(name, ok, message)
        checks[#checks + 1] = { name = name, status = ok and "passed" or "failed", message = message or "" }
    end
    local res = host:getResource(verifyName)
    local m = res and res.manifest
    check("manifest_valid", m ~= nil, m and (m.name .. " " .. m.version) or "resource not found or manifest invalid")
    if m then
        local declared = #m.environments == 0
        for _, e in ipairs(m.environments) do if e == "beammp" then declared = true end end
        check("environment_declared", declared, table.concat(m.environments, ", "))
        local missing = {}
        for _, dep in ipairs(m.dependencies) do
            if not host:getResource(dep.name) then missing[#missing + 1] = dep.name end
        end
        check("dependencies_resolved", #missing == 0, table.concat(missing, ", "))
        local state = host:resourceState(verifyName)
        check("starts", state == "started", state)
        local side = res.sides and res.sides.server
        for _, e in ipairs(m.serverExports or {}) do
            check("export:" .. e, side ~= nil and side.exports[e] ~= nil, "")
        end
        if verifyWith then
            check("readme_example", withStarted == true, withStarted == true and (verifyWith .. " started") or tostring(withWhy))
        end
    end
    local errors = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(logs) do if e.level == "error" then errors[#errors + 1] = e end end
    check("no_runtime_errors", #errors == 0, errors[1] and (tostring(errors[1].origin) .. " " .. tostring(errors[1].message)) or "")
    -- SGCHECK lines a resource printed become checks, as in `scriptgo verify`.
    local selfCount, done, lines = 0, false, {}
    for _, e in ipairs(logs) do
        local msg = tostring(e.message)
        lines[#lines + 1] = ("[%s] %s %s"):format(e.level, tostring(e.origin), msg)
        local verdict, cname, detail = msg:match("SGCHECK (%u+) (%S+)%s*(.*)$")
        if verdict == "PASS" or verdict == "FAIL" then
            selfCount = selfCount + 1
            checks[#checks + 1] = { name = "self:" .. cname, status = verdict == "PASS" and "passed" or "failed", message = detail or "" }
        end
        if msg:find("SGCHECK DONE", 1, true) then done = true end
    end
    if selfCount > 0 and not done then check("self:done", false, "SGCHECK DONE never printed: the self-checks did not finish") end

    local failed = 0
    for _, c in ipairs(checks) do if c.status == "failed" then failed = failed + 1 end end
    local major, minor, patch = MP.GetServerVersion()
    local report = {
        package = m and m.name or verifyName, version = m and m.version or "", environment = "beammp",
        status = failed == 0 and "verified" or "failing",
        runtimeVersion = ("BeamMP-Server %s.%s.%s"):format(tostring(major), tostring(minor), tostring(patch)),
        adapterVersion = adapter.adapterVersion, luaVersion = scriptgo.compat.version,
        durationMs = math.floor((adapter.now() - verifyStarted) * 1000),
        checks = checks, log = table.concat(lines, "\n"),
        evidence = { seconds = verify.seconds or 3, os = MP.GetOSName and MP.GetOSName() or nil },
    }
    local name = verify.report or ("scriptgo-verify-" .. verifyName .. ".json")
    local path = (name:match("^%a:[/\\]") or name:match("^/")) and name or (pluginDir .. "/" .. name)
    local ok, err = api.writeFile(path, json.encode(report))
    if not ok then adapter.log("error", "plugin", "verify: cannot write " .. path .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
    Util.LogInfo(("[scriptgo] verify %s: %s (%d checks, %d failed)"):format(report.package, report.status, #checks, failed))
end

-- Engine wiring --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BeamMP calls handlers by global function name. A client can trigger any non-reserved server event
-- by name, so the tick handler ignores calls that carry arguments (timer events carry none).
local TICK_EVENT = "scriptgo_tick"
local stopped = false

function ScriptGo_Tick(...)
    if stopped or select("#", ...) > 0 then return end
    local now = adapter.now()
    api.pump(now)
    host:tick(now)
    if verifyName and not verifyDone and now - verifyStarted >= (tonumber(verify.seconds) or 3) then
        verifyDone = true
        writeVerifyReport()
        if verify.exit ~= false and type(exit) == "function" then exit() end
    end
end

function ScriptGo_onPlayerJoin(pid)
    if stopped then return end
    host:playerJoin(api.toScriptGo(pid), MP.GetPlayerName(pid))
end

function ScriptGo_onPlayerDisconnect(pid)
    if stopped then return end
    host:playerDrop(api.toScriptGo(pid), "left")
end

-- Resource commands typed in chat: the line is consumed (returning 1 stops BeamMP broadcasting it).
function ScriptGo_onChatMessage(pid, name, message)
    if stopped or type(message) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local command = message:match("^%s*/(%S+)")
    if not command or not host.commands[command:lower()] then return nil end
    local ok, why = host:executeCommand(api.toScriptGo(pid), (message:gsub("^%s*/", "")))
    if not ok then
        local text = why == "not_allowed" and ("You are not allowed to use /" .. command .. ".") or ("/" .. command .. ": " .. tostring(why))
        MP.SendChatMessage(pid, text)
    end
    return 1
end

-- Server console: `scriptgo [start|stop|restart <resource>]`, and resource commands as the console.
function ScriptGo_onConsoleInput(input)
    if stopped or type(input) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local word = input:match("^%s*(%S+)")
    if not word then return nil end
    if word:lower() == "scriptgo" then
        local action, target = input:match("^%s*%S+%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*$")
        if not action then
            local lines = {}
            for _, rname in ipairs(host.order) do
                local r = host:getResource(rname)
                lines[#lines + 1] = ("%s %s  %s"):format(rname, r.manifest.version, host:resourceState(rname))
            end
            return #lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or "No SCRIPT//GO resources."
        end
        if not host:getResource(target) then return "Unknown resource " .. target .. "." end
        if action == "stop" or action == "restart" then host:stop(target, "command") end
        if action == "start" or action == "restart" then
            local ok, why = host:start(target)
            if not ok then return target .. " did not start: " .. tostring(why) end
        end
        return target .. ": " .. host:resourceState(target)
    end
    if not host.commands[word:lower()] then return nil end
    local ok, why = host:executeCommand(0, input)
    return ok and ("ran " .. word:lower()) or tostring(why)
end

function ScriptGo_onShutdown()
    if stopped then return end
    stopped = true
    host:stopAll()
end

MP.RegisterEvent(TICK_EVENT, "ScriptGo_Tick")
MP.RegisterEvent("onPlayerJoin", "ScriptGo_onPlayerJoin")
MP.RegisterEvent("onPlayerDisconnect", "ScriptGo_onPlayerDisconnect")
MP.RegisterEvent("onChatMessage", "ScriptGo_onChatMessage")
MP.RegisterEvent("onConsoleInput", "ScriptGo_onConsoleInput")
MP.RegisterEvent("onShutdown", "ScriptGo_onShutdown")
-- 25 ms is the shortest interval BeamMP accepts without a warning; Wait(0) resumes on the next tick.
MP.CreateEventTimer(TICK_EVENT, math.max(25, tonumber(cfg.tickMs) or 25))

-- Players already on the server (a hot reload) join the new host.
for pid, name in pairs(MP.GetPlayers() or {}) do
    if type(pid) == "number" then host:playerJoin(api.toScriptGo(pid), name) end
end

ScriptGoBeamMP = {
    host = host,
    adapter = adapter,
    api = api,
    logs = logs,
    shutdown = function(reason)
        if stopped then return end
        stopped = true
        MP.CancelEventTimer(TICK_EVENT)
        host:stopAll()
        adapter.log("info", "plugin", "stopped (" .. tostring(reason) .. ")")
    end,
}

adapter.log("info", "plugin", ("SCRIPT//GO %s on %s, %d resources, http %s"):format(
    scriptgo.VERSION, scriptgo.compat.version, #host.order, adapter.capabilities.http and "on" or "off"))

-- A FAKE BeamMP-Server process for the CLI's unit tests: it lets `verifyBeamMP` (packages/cli/src/
-- lib/beammp.ts) drive a process end to end (start, report, console `exit`, cleanup) without the
-- real server. It runs the plugin on the MOCK BeamMP API (mock_beammp.lua) and listens on nothing.
-- Never a verification: the real run needs BeamMP-Server and the owner's AuthKey.
--
--   lua53 fake_server.lua <serverFolder>
local run = assert(arg[1], "usage: fake_server.lua <serverFolder>"):gsub("\\", "/")
local here = (debug.getinfo(1, "S").source:gsub("^@", ""):gsub("\\", "/"):match("^(.*)/")) or "."
local mock = dofile(here .. "/mock_beammp.lua")

local function read(path)
    local f = io.open(path, "rb")
    if not f then return nil end
    local t = f:read("*a")
    f:close()
    return t
end

-- One line, so that the runner's log filter (lines naming BeamMP-Server) keeps it.
io.stdout:write("[INFO] FAKE BeamMP-Server v0.0.0 (unit test, not BeamMP), key length "
    .. #(os.getenv("BEAMMP_AUTH_KEY") or "") .. ", port override " .. tostring(os.getenv("BEAMMP_PORT")) .. "\n")
io.stdout:flush()
local plugin = run .. "/Resources/Server/scriptgo"
assert((loadstring or load)(assert(read(plugin .. "/main.lua")), plugin .. "/main.lua"))()
io.stdout:write("[INFO] ALL SYSTEMS STARTED SUCCESSFULLY, EVERYTHING IS OKAY\n")
io.stdout:flush()

local cfg = read(plugin .. "/scriptgo.json") or ""
local report = plugin .. "/" .. (cfg:match('"report"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') or "scriptgo-verify-report.json")
local function sleep(ms)
    local untilT = os.clock() + ms / 1000
    while os.clock() < untilT do end
end
local waited = 0
while not read(report) and waited < 60000 do
    sleep(25)
    mock.advance(25)
    waited = waited + 25
end
-- The console: wait for `exit`, as BeamMP's does.
for line in io.lines() do
    if line:match("^%s*exit%s*$") then
        mock.trigger("onShutdown")
        io.stdout:write("[INFO] Shutdown.\n")
        os.exit(0)
    end
end
os.exit(0)

-- CC: Tweaked adapter (environment "cctweaked"): SCRIPT//GO resources on one ComputerCraft computer
-- in a Minecraft world. The server side and the local client (player 1, whoever is at the
-- computer's terminal) both run on the computer, as on LÖVE and Neovim; network events between them
-- are looped back through the value codec by the core.
--
--   local adapter = dofile("/scriptgo/adapter.lua")(scriptgo, options)   -- sg.lua does it
--
-- options:
--   config       { permissions = { ["1"] = { "*" } }, resources = { name = { key = value } },
--                  convars = { name = value }, http = false }      (/scriptgo/config.json)
--   dataDir      folder of <key>.json storage files (default /scriptgo/data)
--   out          function(line, colour) that shows a line on the terminal (default print)
--   localPlayerId  the player whose notifications reach the terminal (default 1)
--   logLevel, quiet, logSink   as the other adapters; adapter.lines keeps the last 500 lines
--
-- What CC: Tweaked provides and how it maps:
--   clock        os.clock(): the computer's uptime, advanced by server ticks (20 per second)
--   wall clock   os.epoch("utc"): os.time() is the in-game hour on CC: Tweaked, not Unix time
--   files        fs (the computer's own disk, limited by the server's computer_space_limit)
--   HTTP         the http API, asynchronous: http.request now, http_success / http_failure later.
--                The server owner's [[http.rules]] decide which hosts answer.
--   licensing    deliberately off (see sdk/adapters/cctweaked/README.md, "Licensing").
return function(scriptgo, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local cfg = opts.config or {}
    local json = scriptgo.json
    local dataDir = (opts.dataDir or "/scriptgo/data"):gsub("/+$", "")
    local localPlayerId = opts.localPlayerId or 1
    local out = opts.out or function(line) print(line) end

    local function readFile(path)
        local h = fs.open(path, "rb")
        if not h then return nil end
        local text = h.readAll() or ""
        h.close()
        return text
    end

    local function writeFile(path, text)
        local dir = fs.getDir(path)
        if dir ~= "" and not fs.exists(dir) then fs.makeDir(dir) end
        local h, err = fs.open(path, "wb")
        if not h then return false, err end
        h.write(text)
        h.close()
        return true
    end

    local adapter = {
        environment = "cctweaked",
        adapterVersion = "cctweaked-" .. scriptgo.VERSION,
        sides = { server = true, client = true },
        capabilities = {},
        now = function() return os.clock() end,
        wallTime = function() return math.floor(os.epoch("utc") / 1000) end,
        notifications = {},
        lines = {},
        dataDir = dataDir,
        readFile = readFile,
        writeFile = writeFile,
    }
    for _, c in ipairs(scriptgo.capabilities.ALL) do adapter.capabilities[c] = true end
    -- Player perks are not switched on here (for the reason licensing is off); the registry says the same (capabilities.lua).
    adapter.capabilities.perks = false
    -- Player match follows perks (nobody to match, or no HTTP): off as well.
    adapter.capabilities.presence = false

    -- Logging --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local logLevel = { debug = 0, info = 1, warn = 2, error = 3 }
    local minLevel = logLevel[opts.logLevel or "info"] or 1
    local COLOURS = { warn = colours and colours.orange, error = colours and colours.red }
    function adapter.log(level, origin, msg)
        if opts.logSink then opts.logSink(level, origin, msg) end
        if (logLevel[level] or 1) < minLevel then return end
        local line = ("[%s] %s %s"):format(level, origin, tostring(msg))
        local lines = adapter.lines
        lines[#lines + 1] = line
        if #lines > 500 then table.remove(lines, 1) end
        if not opts.quiet then out(line, COLOURS[level]) end
    end

    -- Files ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Files under a resource root, relative and with forward slashes (script globs).
    function adapter.listFiles(root)
        local found = {}
        local function walk(dir, prefix)
            for _, name in ipairs(fs.list(dir)) do
                local p = fs.combine(dir, name)
                if fs.isDir(p) then
                    if name:sub(1, 1) ~= "." then walk(p, prefix .. name .. "/") end
                else
                    found[#found + 1] = prefix .. name
                end
            end
        end
        if fs.isDir(root) then walk(root, "") end
        table.sort(found)
        return found
    end

    adapter.storage = {
        load = function(key) return readFile(dataDir .. "/" .. key .. ".json") end,
        save = function(key, text)
            local ok, err = writeFile(dataDir .. "/" .. key .. ".json", text)
            -- A full disk (computer_space_limit) is the usual cause.
            if not ok then adapter.log("error", "cctweaked", "storage write failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
        end,
    }

    -- Notifications: a line on the terminal for the local player (or everyone), always logged.
    local NOTE_COLOURS = { error = colours and colours.red, warning = colours and colours.orange, warn = colours and colours.orange, success = colours and colours.lime }
    adapter.ui = {
        notify = function(target, payload)
            local list = adapter.notifications
            list[#list + 1] = { target = target, payload = payload }
            if #list > 100 then table.remove(list, 1) end
            local title = payload.title and (tostring(payload.title) .. ": ") or ""
            local text = title .. tostring(payload.message or "")
            if opts.logSink then opts.logSink("info", "ui:" .. tostring(payload.resource) .. "->" .. tostring(target), text) end
            -- nil is the local client's own notification (a client-side call).
            if target == nil or target == -1 or target == localPlayerId then
                out("* " .. text, NOTE_COLOURS[tostring(payload.type)] or (colours and colours.yellow))
            end
        end,
    }

    -- config.permissions = { ["1"] = { "*" }, ["2"] = { "command.give", "shop.*" } }
    local perms = cfg.permissions or {}
    adapter.permissions = {
        has = function(playerId, privilege)
            local list = perms[tostring(playerId)]
            if type(list) ~= "table" then return false end
            for _, p in ipairs(list) do
                if p == "*" or p == privilege then return true end
                if p:sub(-2) == ".*" and privilege:sub(1, #p - 1) == p:sub(1, -2) then return true end
            end
            return false
        end,
    }

    -- config.resources = { name = { key = value } }; convars from config.convars, then the
    -- computer's own settings (`set <key> <value>` in the shell).
    adapter.config = {
        get = function(resourceName, key)
            if resourceName == nil then
                local v = (cfg.convars or {})[key]
                if v ~= nil then return v end
                if settings and settings.get then return settings.get(key) end
                return nil
            end
            local r = (cfg.resources or {})[resourceName]
            return r and r[key]
        end,
    }

    -- HTTP -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- CC: Tweaked answers a request with an event naming its URL only. Each request gets a unique
    -- fragment (#sg-<n>): the fragment is never sent to the server, and the event gives it back,
    -- so answers to the same URL cannot be swapped.
    local pending, seq = {}, 0
    if cfg.http == false then
        adapter.httpUnavailable = "disabled by config"
    elseif type(http) ~= "table" or type(http.request) ~= "function" then
        adapter.httpUnavailable = "the http API is disabled on this server (http.enabled in computercraft-server.toml)"
    end
    -- Licensing stays off on purpose, even with HTTP: see README.md, "Licensing".
    adapter.capabilities.licensing = false
    if adapter.httpUnavailable then
        adapter.capabilities.http = false
    else
        adapter.httpMode = "the CC: Tweaked http API (asynchronous, the server's http.rules apply)"
        adapter.http = {
            request = function(req, done)
                seq = seq + 1
                local url = tostring(req.url):gsub("#.*$", "") .. "#sg-" .. seq
                local headers = {}
                for k, v in pairs(req.headers or {}) do headers[k] = tostring(v) end
                local ok, err = http.request({
                    url = url, method = req.method or "GET", body = req.body, headers = headers,
                    binary = true, redirect = false, timeout = (req.timeoutMs or 10000) / 1000,
                })
                if ok == false then
                    done({ status = 0, body = "", error = "http_failed: " .. tostring(err) })
                    return
                end
                pending[url] = done
            end,
        }
    end

    local function answer(done, handle)
        local status = handle.getResponseCode and handle.getResponseCode() or 0
        local body = handle.readAll and handle.readAll() or ""
        local headers = handle.getResponseHeaders and handle.getResponseHeaders() or {}
        handle.close()
        done({ status = status, body = body or "", headers = headers })
    end

    -- sg.lua hands every CC event here; true when it was an answer to one of our requests.
    function adapter.onEvent(name, a, b, c)
        if name ~= "http_success" and name ~= "http_failure" then return false end
        local done = pending[a]
        if not done then return false end
        pending[a] = nil
        if name == "http_success" then
            answer(done, b)
        elseif type(c) == "table" then
            answer(done, c) -- an HTTP error status still has a response
        else
            done({ status = 0, body = "", error = "http_failed: " .. tostring(b) })
        end
        return true
    end

    function adapter.pendingRequests()
        local n = 0
        for _ in pairs(pending) do n = n + 1 end
        return n
    end

    function adapter.shutdown()
        for url, done in pairs(pending) do
            pending[url] = nil
            done({ status = 0, body = "", error = "http_failed: the host stopped" })
        end
    end

    adapter.json = json
    return adapter
end

-- SCRIPT//GO on a CC: Tweaked computer: runs SCRIPT//GO resources (and portable OPEN//77 ones).
--
--   scriptgo/sg            start the resources, then a console on the terminal
--   scriptgo/sg verify     verify mode for `scriptgo verify --env cctweaked` (reads /scriptgo/verify.json)
--
-- Layout on the computer's disk (`node sdk/adapters/cctweaked/build.mjs` builds it):
--   /scriptgo/core/          the SCRIPT//GO core
--   /scriptgo/adapter.lua    the cctweaked adapter
--   /scriptgo/resources/<name>/   resources (scriptgo.lua or open77.lua manifest)
--   /scriptgo/config.json    optional: { "resources": {...}, "convars": {...},
--                            "permissions": { "1": ["*"] }, "start": ["name"], "http": false }
--   /scriptgo/data/          storage, one JSON file per resource side
--
-- Console: a resource command runs as player 1 (whoever is at the terminal); `status`, `start`,
-- `stop`, `restart <name>`, `log`, `help` and `exit` drive the host. Ctrl+T also stops it.
local args = { ... }
local ROOT = "/scriptgo"
local TICK = 0.05 -- one server tick

local function readFile(path)
    local h = fs.open(path, "rb")
    if not h then return nil end
    local text = h.readAll() or ""
    h.close()
    return text
end

local coreDir = ROOT .. "/core/"
local coreText = readFile(coreDir .. "init.lua")
if not coreText then
    printError("SCRIPT//GO: the core is missing from " .. coreDir .. " (build the computer folder with sdk/adapters/cctweaked/build.mjs)")
    return
end
local scriptgo = assert(load(coreText, "@scriptgo/init.lua"))(coreDir, readFile)
local json = scriptgo.json
local makeAdapter = assert(load(assert(readFile(ROOT .. "/adapter.lua")), "@scriptgo/adapter.lua"))()

local verifyMode = args[1] == "verify"

local cfg = {}
do
    local text = readFile(ROOT .. "/config.json")
    if text then
        local ok, value = pcall(json.decode, text)
        if ok and type(value) == "table" then cfg = value else printError("SCRIPT//GO: config.json is not valid JSON; using defaults") end
    end
end

-- Terminal: the output scrolls above a one-line prompt (interactive mode only).
local parent = term.current()
local width, height = term.getSize()
local outWin, promptWin
if not verifyMode then
    term.clear()
    outWin = window.create(parent, 1, 1, width, height - 1)
    promptWin = window.create(parent, 1, height, width, 1)
end
local function out(line, colour)
    if not outWin then return end
    local previous = term.redirect(outWin)
    if colour and term.isColour() then term.setTextColour(colour) end
    print(line)
    term.setTextColour(colours.white)
    term.redirect(previous)
    if promptWin then promptWin.restoreCursor() end
end

local logs = {}
local adapter = makeAdapter(scriptgo, {
    config = cfg, out = out, quiet = verifyMode,
    logSink = function(level, origin, msg)
        logs[#logs + 1] = { level = level, origin = origin, message = tostring(msg) }
        if #logs > 3000 then table.remove(logs, 1) end
    end,
})
local player = { id = 1, name = "Terminal" }
local host = scriptgo.newHost({ adapter = adapter, localPlayer = player })

-- Discovery ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local resourceDir = ROOT .. "/resources"

local function locate(name)
    local root = resourceDir .. "/" .. name
    if fs.exists(root .. "/scriptgo.lua") or fs.exists(root .. "/open77.lua") then return root end
    return nil
end

local function addWithDeps(root)
    local res, err = host:addResource(root)
    if not res then
        if err and err:find("already loaded") then return true end
        return nil, err
    end
    for _, dep in ipairs(res.manifest.dependencies) do
        if not host:getResource(dep.name) then
            local depRoot = locate(dep.name)
            if depRoot then
                local ok, derr = addWithDeps(depRoot)
                if not ok then return nil, derr end
            end
        end
    end
    return res
end

local names = {}
if fs.isDir(resourceDir) then
    for _, name in ipairs(fs.list(resourceDir)) do
        if locate(name) then names[#names + 1] = name end
    end
end
table.sort(names)
for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    local ok, err = addWithDeps(locate(name))
    if not ok then host:log("error", name .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
end

-- The loop: ticks the host every server tick and hands CC events (HTTP answers) to the adapter.
local ticks = 0
local running = true
local function hostLoop(untilClock)
    local timer = os.startTimer(TICK)
    while running do
        local ev = table.pack(os.pullEventRaw())
        if ev[1] == "timer" and ev[2] == timer then
            ticks = ticks + 1
            host:tick(adapter.now())
            if untilClock and adapter.now() >= untilClock then return end
            timer = os.startTimer(TICK)
        elseif ev[1] == "terminate" then
            running = false
        else
            adapter.onEvent(ev[1], ev[2], ev[3], ev[4])
        end
    end
end

local function shutdownHost()
    host:playerDrop(player.id, "quit")
    host:stopAll()
    host:tick(adapter.now())
    adapter.shutdown()
end

-- Verify mode ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- /scriptgo/verify.json: { "resource": name, "seconds": 3, "report": "/scriptgo-report.json",
-- "with": exampleName, "shutdown": true }. Writes a CompatibilityRun (the same shape as every other
-- host) and turns the computer off. Checks: manifest_valid, environment_declared,
-- dependencies_resolved, starts, export:<name>, readme_example (with "with"), no_runtime_errors,
-- self:<name> for each `SGCHECK PASS|FAIL <name>` line (self:done when SGCHECK DONE never came),
-- then tests (the resource's test_script files on the in-memory harness, on this computer's Lua).
local function verify()
    local startedEpoch = os.epoch("utc")
    local v = json.decode(assert(readFile(ROOT .. "/verify.json"), "verify.json is missing"))
    local checks = {}
    local function check(name, ok, message)
        checks[#checks + 1] = { name = name, status = ok and "passed" or "failed", message = tostring(message or "") }
        return ok
    end

    local res = host:getResource(v.resource)
    local m = res and res.manifest
    check("manifest_valid", m ~= nil, m and (m.name .. " " .. m.version) or "resource not found or manifest invalid")
    local started = false
    if m then
        local declared = #m.environments == 0
        for _, e in ipairs(m.environments) do if e == "cctweaked" then declared = true end end
        check("environment_declared", declared, table.concat(m.environments, ", "))
        local missing = {}
        for _, dep in ipairs(m.dependencies) do
            if not host:getResource(dep.name) then missing[#missing + 1] = dep.name end
        end
        check("dependencies_resolved", #missing == 0, table.concat(missing, ", "))
        local ok, why = host:start(v.resource)
        check("starts", ok == true, ok and "started" or why)
        if ok then
            local side = host:getResource(v.resource).sides.server
            for _, e in ipairs(m.serverExports or {}) do
                check("export:" .. e, side ~= nil and side.exports[e] ~= nil, "")
            end
            if v.with then
                local wok, wwhy = false, "not found"
                if host:getResource(v.with) then wok, wwhy = host:start(v.with) end
                check("readme_example", wok == true, wok and (v.with .. " started") or wwhy)
            end
            host:playerJoin(player.id, player.name)
            started = true
        end
    end

    local seconds = tonumber(v.seconds) or 3
    local runClock = os.clock()
    if started then hostLoop(os.clock() + seconds) end
    local runSeconds = os.clock() - runClock
    if started then shutdownHost() end

    local errors = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(logs) do if e.level == "error" then errors[#errors + 1] = e end end
    if started then
        check("no_runtime_errors", #errors == 0, errors[1] and (errors[1].origin .. " " .. errors[1].message) or "")
    end
    local lines, selfCount, done = {}, 0, false
    for _, e in ipairs(logs) do
        lines[#lines + 1] = ("[%s] %s %s"):format(e.level, e.origin, e.message)
        local verdict, cname, detail = e.message:match("SGCHECK (%u+) (%S+)%s*(.*)$")
        if verdict == "PASS" or verdict == "FAIL" then
            selfCount = selfCount + 1
            checks[#checks + 1] = { name = "self:" .. cname, status = verdict == "PASS" and "passed" or "failed", message = detail or "" }
        end
        if e.message:find("SGCHECK DONE", 1, true) then done = true end
    end
    if selfCount > 0 and not done then check("self:done", false, "SGCHECK DONE never printed: the self-checks did not finish") end

    -- The resource's test_script files, as `scriptgo test` runs them (in-memory harness).
    local testsRan = false
    if m and started then
        if #m.testScripts > 0 then
            local testing = scriptgo.testing
            local suite = testing.suite()
            local function addAll(h, dir)
                local r, err = h.host:addResource(dir)
                if not r then
                    if err and err:find("already loaded") then return true end
                    return nil, err
                end
                for _, dep in ipairs(r.manifest.dependencies) do
                    if not h.host:getResource(dep.name) and locate(dep.name) then
                        local ok, derr = addAll(h, locate(dep.name))
                        if not ok then return nil, derr end
                    end
                end
                return r
            end
            local function loadHarness(o)
                o = o or {}
                -- os.time() is the in-game hour here: the harness gets the adapter's wall clock.
                if o.wallTime == nil and not o.adapter then o.wallTime = adapter.wallTime end
                local h = testing.harness(o)
                local ok, err = addAll(h, res.root)
                if not ok then error(err, 2) end
                for _, extra in ipairs(o.with or {}) do
                    local eok, eerr = addAll(h, locate(extra) or extra)
                    if not eok then error(eerr, 2) end
                end
                if o.start ~= false then
                    local sok, why = h:start(m.name)
                    if not sok then error("start failed: " .. tostring(why), 2) end
                    for _, extra in ipairs(o.with or {}) do h:start(extra:match("([^/\\]+)$")) end
                end
                return h
            end
            local loaded, loadErr = true, nil
            for _, rel in ipairs(m.testScripts) do
                local text = readFile(res.root .. "/" .. rel)
                if not text then loaded, loadErr = false, "cannot read " .. rel break end
                local env = setmetatable({
                    test = suite.test, it = suite.it, describe = suite.describe, expect = testing.expect,
                    load = loadHarness, scriptgo = scriptgo, RESOURCE = m.name, ROOT = res.root,
                }, { __index = _G })
                local fn, err = scriptgo.compat.loadWithEnv(text, "@" .. m.name .. "/" .. rel, env)
                if not fn then loaded, loadErr = false, err break end
                local ok, rerr = pcall(fn)
                if not ok then loaded, loadErr = false, rerr break end
            end
            testsRan = true
            if not loaded then
                check("tests", false, loadErr)
            else
                local result = suite.run(function(name, ok, err)
                    lines[#lines + 1] = (ok and "  ok   " or "  FAIL ") .. name
                    if not ok then lines[#lines + 1] = "       " .. tostring(err) end
                end)
                check("tests", result.failed == 0, ("%s: %d passed, %d failed (%s)"):format(m.name, result.passed, result.failed, scriptgo.compat.version))
            end
        else
            checks[#checks + 1] = { name = "tests", status = "skipped", message = "no test_script" }
        end
    end

    local failed = 0
    for _, c in ipairs(checks) do if c.status == "failed" then failed = failed + 1 end end
    local caps = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(scriptgo.capabilities.ALL) do if host.capabilities[c] then caps[#caps + 1] = c end end
    local stored = fs.isDir(adapter.dataDir) and fs.list(adapter.dataDir) or {}
    table.sort(stored)
    -- _HOST is "ComputerCraft <version> (Minecraft <version>)" inside Minecraft.
    local hostString = tostring(_HOST)
    local ccVersion = hostString:match("^ComputerCraft (%S+)") or "?"
    local mcVersion = hostString:match("%(Minecraft ([^)]+)%)")
    local evidence = {
        { kind = "host", path = hostString },
        { kind = "interpreter", path = scriptgo.compat.version },
        { kind = "computer", path = ("#%d, %s terminal %dx%d"):format(os.getComputerID(), term.isColour() and "colour" or "monochrome", width, height) },
        { kind = "ticks", path = ("%d host ticks from os.startTimer over %.2f s of computer time"):format(ticks, runSeconds) },
        { kind = "resources", path = table.concat(host.order, ", ") },
        { kind = "capabilities", path = table.concat(caps, ", ") },
        { kind = "http", path = adapter.httpMode or ("unavailable: " .. tostring(adapter.httpUnavailable)) },
        { kind = "storage", path = adapter.dataDir .. ": " .. (#stored > 0 and table.concat(stored, ", ") or "nothing written") },
        { kind = "disk_free", path = tostring(fs.getFreeSpace("/")) .. " bytes" },
    }
    if testsRan then evidence[#evidence + 1] = { kind = "tests", path = "test_script files on the in-memory harness, on this computer's Lua" } end

    local ranAt = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    local report = {
        runId = ("%s@%s:cctweaked:%s"):format(m and m.name or tostring(v.resource), m and m.version or "unknown", ranAt),
        package = m and m.name or tostring(v.resource), version = m and m.version or "unknown", environment = "cctweaked",
        status = failed == 0 and "verified" or "failing",
        runtimeVersion = "CC: Tweaked " .. ccVersion .. (mcVersion and (", Minecraft " .. mcVersion) or ", no Minecraft"),
        adapterVersion = adapter.adapterVersion, luaVersion = scriptgo.compat.version,
        ranAt = ranAt, durationMs = math.floor(os.epoch("utc") - startedEpoch),
        log = table.concat(lines, "\n"), checks = checks, evidence = evidence,
    }
    local target = v.report or "/scriptgo-report.json"
    local tmp = target .. ".tmp"
    local h = assert(fs.open(tmp, "wb"))
    h.write(json.encode(report))
    h.close()
    if fs.exists(target) then fs.delete(target) end
    fs.move(tmp, target)
    print(("SCRIPT//GO verify %s: %s (%d checks, %d failed)"):format(report.package, report.status, #checks, failed))
    if v.shutdown ~= false then os.shutdown() end
end

if verifyMode then
    verify()
    return
end

-- Interactive mode -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if type(cfg.start) == "table" then
    for _, name in ipairs(cfg.start) do
        local ok, why = host:start(name)
        if not ok then host:log("error", name .. " did not start: " .. tostring(why)) end
    end
else
    for name, result in pairs(host:startAll()) do
        if result ~= "started" then host:log("error", name .. " did not start: " .. tostring(result)) end
    end
end
host:playerJoin(player.id, player.name)
out(("SCRIPT//GO %s on %s: %d resource(s). Type help."):format(scriptgo.VERSION, tostring(_HOST), #host.order), colours.lightBlue)

local HELP = "status | start <name> | stop <name> | restart <name> | log | exit | <resource command>"
local history = {}
local function console()
    while running do
        term.redirect(promptWin)
        promptWin.clear()
        promptWin.setCursorPos(1, 1)
        write("sg> ")
        local ok, line = pcall(read, nil, history)
        term.redirect(parent)
        if not ok then
            running = false
            return
        end
        line = (line or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("^/", "")
        if line ~= "" then
            history[#history + 1] = line
            local verb, rest = line:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)$")
            if verb == "exit" or verb == "quit" then
                running = false
                return
            elseif verb == "help" then
                out(HELP)
            elseif verb == "status" then
                for _, name in ipairs(host.order) do
                    out(("%-20s %-8s %s"):format(name, host:getResource(name).manifest.version, tostring(host:resourceState(name))))
                end
            elseif verb == "log" then
                for i = math.max(1, #adapter.lines - (height - 3)), #adapter.lines do out(adapter.lines[i]) end
            elseif (verb == "start" or verb == "stop" or verb == "restart") and rest ~= "" and host:getResource(rest) then
                if verb ~= "start" then host:stop(rest, "console") end
                if verb ~= "stop" then
                    local sok, why = host:start(rest)
                    if not sok then out(rest .. " did not start: " .. tostring(why), colours.red) end
                end
                out(rest .. ": " .. tostring(host:resourceState(rest)))
            else
                local cok, why = host:executeCommand(player.id, line)
                if not cok then
                    out(why == "not_allowed" and ("You are not allowed to use " .. verb .. ".") or (verb .. ": " .. tostring(why)), colours.red)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

parallel.waitForAny(function() hostLoop(nil) end, console)
shutdownHost()
term.redirect(parent)
term.clear()
term.setCursorPos(1, 1)
print("SCRIPT//GO stopped.")

        local fn, err = loadstring(text, name)
        if not fn then error(err, 2) end
        setfenv(fn, env)
        return fn
    end
    local fn, err = load(text, name, "t", env)
    if not fn then error(err, 2) end
    return fn
end

-- opts: json (encode/decode/null), server (default true), resource, convars, players
-- ({ ["1"] = { name, identifiers = { "license:..." } } }), aces ({ ["1|perm"] = true }),
-- metadata ({ version = { "1.0.0" }, scriptgo_permission = { ... } }), files, resources
-- ({ other = { state = "started", exports = { name = fn } } }), http (fn(url, method, data, headers,
-- options) -> status, body, headers, errorData), clock (GetGameTimer value), osTime.
function M.new(opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local server = opts.server ~= false
    local own = opts.resource or "stub_res"
    local w = {
        calls = {}, kvp = {}, printed = {}, finds = {}, openFinds = 0,
        clock = opts.clock or 4200,
    }

    local function record(name, ...)
        w.calls[#w.calls + 1] = { name = name, args = { n = select("#", ...), ... } }
    end

    -- Every call of a native, in order; `w.called(name)` answers the list for one native.
    function w.called(name)
        local out = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(w.calls) do if c.name == name then out[#out + 1] = c.args end end
        return out
    end

    local env = {
        assert = assert, error = error, ipairs = ipairs, next = next, pairs = pairs, pcall = pcall,
        rawequal = rawequal, rawget = rawget, rawset = rawset, select = select, setmetatable = setmetatable,
        getmetatable = getmetatable, tonumber = tonumber, tostring = tostring, type = type, unpack = rawget(_G, "unpack"),
        _VERSION = "Lua 5.4", string = string, table = table, math = math, coroutine = coroutine,
    }
    env._G = env
    env.json = { encode = opts.json.encode, decode = opts.json.decode, null = opts.json.null }
    if server then env.os = { time = function() return opts.osTime or 1800000000 end } end

    env.print = function(...)
        local parts = {}
        for i = 1, select("#", ...) do parts[i] = tostring((select(i, ...))) end
        w.printed[#w.printed + 1] = table.concat(parts, "\t")
    end

    -- shared: IS_DUPLICITY_VERSION, GET_CURRENT_RESOURCE_NAME, GET_RESOURCE_STATE
    env.IsDuplicityVersion = function() return server end
    env.GetCurrentResourceName = function() return own end
    env.GetResourceState = function(name)
        record("GetResourceState", name)
        if name == own then return "started" end
        local r = opts.resources and opts.resources[name]
        return r and (r.state or "started") or "missing"
    end

    -- shared: GET_NUM_RESOURCE_METADATA, GET_RESOURCE_METADATA, LOAD_RESOURCE_FILE
    local metadata = opts.metadata or {}
    env.GetNumResourceMetadata = function(res, key)
        record("GetNumResourceMetadata", res, key)
        return res == own and metadata[key] and #metadata[key] or 0
    end
    env.GetResourceMetadata = function(res, key, index)
        record("GetResourceMetadata", res, key, index)
        local list = res == own and metadata[key]
        return list and list[index + 1] or nil
    end
    env.LoadResourceFile = function(res, path)
        record("LoadResourceFile", res, path)
        return res == own and opts.files and opts.files[path] or nil
    end

    -- shared: GET_CONVAR(varName, default_)
    env.GetConvar = function(name, default)
        record("GetConvar", name, default)
        local v = opts.convars and opts.convars[name]
        if v == nil then return default end
        return v
    end

    -- shared: GET_RESOURCE_KVP_STRING, SET_RESOURCE_KVP, DELETE_RESOURCE_KVP, START_FIND_KVP,
    -- FIND_KVP, END_FIND_KVP. Values are strings; a missing key answers nil.
    env.GetResourceKvpString = function(key)
        record("GetResourceKvpString", key)
        return w.kvp[key]
    end
    env.SetResourceKvp = function(key, value)
        record("SetResourceKvp", key, value)
        assert(type(key) == "string" and type(value) == "string", "stub: SET_RESOURCE_KVP takes (char*, char*)")
        w.kvp[key] = value
    end
    env.DeleteResourceKvp = function(key)
        record("DeleteResourceKvp", key)
        w.kvp[key] = nil
    end
    env.StartFindKvp = function(prefix)
        record("StartFindKvp", prefix)
        local keys = {}
        for k in pairs(w.kvp) do if k:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then keys[#keys + 1] = k end end
        if #keys == 0 then return -1 end
        -- Unsorted on purpose: the shim sorts.
        table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return a > b end)
        w.finds[#w.finds + 1] = { keys = keys, i = 0 }
        w.openFinds = w.openFinds + 1
        return #w.finds
    end
    env.FindKvp = function(handle)
        local f = w.finds[handle]
        f.i = f.i + 1
        return f.keys[f.i]
    end
    env.EndFindKvp = function(handle)
        record("EndFindKvp", handle)
        w.openFinds = w.openFinds - 1
    end

    -- server: GET_GAME_TIMER (a game native of the same name on the client)
    env.GetGameTimer = function() return w.clock end

    -- server: GetPlayers() (scheduler.lua: ids as strings), GET_PLAYER_NAME(char* playerSrc),
    -- GET_PLAYER_IDENTIFIER_BY_TYPE(char*, char*), GetPlayerIdentifiers (scheduler.lua),
    -- IS_PLAYER_ACE_ALLOWED(char* playerSrc, char* object)
    local players = opts.players or {}
    local function src(name, value)
        assert(type(value) == "string", "stub: " .. name .. " takes a char* playerSrc, got " .. type(value))
        return value
    end
    if server then
        env.GetPlayers = function()
            record("GetPlayers")
            local out = {}
            for id in pairs(players) do out[#out + 1] = id end
            table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a > b end)
            return out
        end
        env.GetPlayerName = function(s)
            record("GetPlayerName", s)
            local p = players[src("GetPlayerName", s)]
            return p and p.name or nil
        end
        env.GetPlayerIdentifierByType = function(s, kind)
            record("GetPlayerIdentifierByType", s, kind)
            local p = players[src("GetPlayerIdentifierByType", s)]
            for _, ident in ipairs(p and p.identifiers or {}) do
                if ident:sub(1, #kind + 1) == kind .. ":" then return ident end
            end
            return nil
        end
        env.GetPlayerIdentifiers = function(s)
            record("GetPlayerIdentifiers", s)
            local p = players[src("GetPlayerIdentifiers", s)]
            return p and p.identifiers or {}
        end
        env.IsPlayerAceAllowed = function(s, object)
            record("IsPlayerAceAllowed", s, object)
            return (opts.aces or {})[src("IsPlayerAceAllowed", s) .. "|" .. object] == true
        end
        env.TriggerClientEvent = function(name, target, ...) record("TriggerClientEvent", name, target, ...) end
        -- scheduler.lua: PerformHttpRequest(url, cb, method, data, headers, options), then
        -- cb(status, body, headers, errorData). The stub answers synchronously.
        env.PerformHttpRequest = function(url, cb, method, data, headers, options)
            record("PerformHttpRequest", url, method, data, headers, options)
            cb((opts.http or function() return 0, nil, {}, "stub: no http answer" end)(url, method, data, headers, options))
        end
    else
        env.TriggerServerEvent = function(name, ...) record("TriggerServerEvent", name, ...) end
    end

    env.AddEventHandler = function(name, fn) record("AddEventHandler", name, fn) return { name = name } end
    env.RemoveEventHandler = function(h) record("RemoveEventHandler", h) end
    env.RegisterNetEvent = function(name, fn) record("RegisterNetEvent", name, fn) end
    env.TriggerEvent = function(name, ...) record("TriggerEvent", name, ...) end

    -- deferred.lua: promise.new(), p:resolve(v), states 0 pending, 3 resolved, 4 rejected.
    env.promise = {
        new = function()
            local p = { state = 0 }
            function p.resolve(_, v) if p.state == 0 then p.state, p.value = 3, v end end
            function p.reject(_, v) if p.state == 0 then p.state, p.value = 4, v end end
            return p
        end,
    }
    env.Citizen = {
        Await = function(p)
            if p.state == 0 then error("stub: Citizen.Await on a pending promise", 2) end
            if p.state == 4 then error(p.value, 2) end
            return p.value
        end,
    }

    -- scheduler.lua: exports[resource][name] raises "No such export <name> in resource <resource>"
    -- and answers function(self, ...).
    env.exports = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_, res)
            return setmetatable({}, {
                __index = function(_, name)
                    local r = opts.resources and opts.resources[res]
                    local fn = r and r.exports and r.exports[name]
                    if not fn then error("No such export " .. name .. " in resource " .. res, 2) end
                    return function(_, ...) return fn(...) end
                end,
            })
        end,
    })

    w.env = env

    function w.load(text, name)
        return loadIn(text, name or "=scriptgo_shim.lua", env)()
    end

    -- Runs fn as a scheduler thread (the stub has no scheduler: Wait is not provided).
    function w.run(fn, ...)
        local co = coroutine.create(fn)
        local function finish(ok, ...)
            if not ok then error((...), 3) end
            return ...
        end
        return finish(coroutine.resume(co, ...))
    end

    return w
end

return M
